Nyanzvi mukuvakwa kwemaguta dzinoti guta reHarare rakavakirwa panzvimbo isina kunaka sezvo riri munzvimbo inofamba nemvura inopinda muLake Chivero, izvo zvinoita kuti mvura iyi isvibe zvakanyanya.
Pari zvino guta reHarare rinoda mari inosvika mamiriyoni matatu emadhora semari yekutenga mishonga yekuchenesa mvura pamwedzi wega wega.

Mutungamiri weMDC, Va Nelson Chamisa, vatumira mashoko avo kuruzhinji rwevanhu vemuZimbabwe vachivakorokotedza pakusvika kwaita Zimbabwe makore makumi mana yawana kuzvitonga.
VaChamisa vati vari kuziva kushupika kuri kuita veruzhinji munyika panguva iyo nyika yakatarisana nedambudziko rechirwere Coronavirus, uye vachimanikidzwa kugara mudzimba senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere ichi, icho chabata vanhu makumi maviri nevana muZimbabwe, uye kuuraya vanhu vatatu.
Chirwere ichi chabata vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni maviri nemazana maviri nemakumi mapfumbamwe ezviuru, uye kuuraya vanhu vanodarika zviuru zana nemakumi mashanu nezvinomwe.
VaChamisa vati zvakakosha kuti nyika itarise kwayakabva, uye zvakaitika mumakore makumi mana apfuura, senzira yekuvaka hwaro hweremangwana renyika.

Ukuwo mumiriri weHarare East, VaTerence Mukupe, uye vari nhengo yeZanu PF, vashamisa paramende apo vakumbira hurumende kuti irange vakomana vebhora nekuvavharira muchitokokisi chemasoja mushure mekunge vabudiswa mumakwikwi ari kuitirwa kuGabon.
"Taifunga kuti mushure mekuvapa yakanaka, vaifanirwa kutamba zvaitarisirwa zvekuti vakunde. Sevanhu vari kurwadziwa, tiri kuti sehurumende haigoni here kuvaranga sezvinoitwa kune dzimwe nyika kana vatambi vachinge vanyadzisa nyika," vadaro VaMukupe.
Imwe nhengo yeZanu PF inomirira Buhera South, VaJoseph Chinotimba, vatiwo maWarriors akapihwa $85,000 pamunhu kuitira kuti vanotamba zvinodadisa kuGabon. Vati vanofanirwa kudzosa imwe mari yacho.
"Iri kupi mari yacho? Vanofanirwa kuidzora," vadaro VaChinotimba.
Asi gurukota rezvemitambo, VaMakhosini Hlongwani, vati izvi hazvisi kuzoitika sezvo zvisiri pamutemo.
VaHlongwani vakumbira ruregerero kunyika yese nekutadza kwakaita maWarriors vakati vave kutogadzirira makwikwi eAfcon anotevera.
"Senyika, hatina mutemo wekuchengetedza vatambi venhabvu mumabharaki emauto," VaHlonwani vaudza paramende.
Asi vamwewo vakaita saVaInnocent Gonese veMDC inotungamirwa naVaMorgan Tsvangirai, vati hurumende yakaratidza rusarura nekupa maWarriors mari yakawanda chose apo vakaenda kuAfcon asi ikanyima kana kupa timu yema Mighty Warriors, iyo yakapihwa mari shoma apo yakaenda kuAfcon yemadzimai pamwe nekuenda kuRio Olympics.
MaWarriors akaita mangange neAlgeria mumutambo wekutanga 2-2, ikarohwa neSenegal 2-0, uye mumutambo wekupedzisira ikarohwa neTunisia 4-2.

VaDeda vanoti vari kurwadziwa zvikuru nehupenyu hwekutambura hunogarwa nevatambi vemuno nekuti mari yavanowana yemuhoro ishoma shoma nemhaka yekuoma kwezvehupfumi munyika.

Mutungamiri weZCTU, VaPeter Mutasa, vaudza vatori venhau kuti zvakaitwa nehurumende nemusi weMuvhuro zvinoratidza kuti haina kuvimbika uye iri kubata vanhu kumeso kana ichiti inokoshesa TNF asi iyo ichitora danho rakakosha kudai isina kutaura nedzimwe ngengo dzeTNF.
VaMutasa vati zvinoshamisa kuti gurukota rezvemari, VaMthuli Ncube, vakatora danho iri asi nyaya iyi yange iri kufanirwa kutaurwa nezvayo pamusangano weTNF uye uchaitwa muHarare mangwana.

VaMutasa vati neChitatu vari kuenda kumusangano weTNF kunoudza hurumende nekusafara kwavo nedanho iri uye kuti vacharatidzra kana hurumende ikasaterera zviri kudiwa nevashandi.

Heather anoti kuziva zvimhingamupinyi zvinosangana nevanhukadzi vechidiki mune zvemitambo kusanganisira kusambhadharwa zvakakwana, ndiko kwakapa chikwata chavo shungu dzekutanga chirongw chekuti vawanise vanasikana vechidiki vari kuita zvemitambo masanitary pads ekuti vashandise panguva yavo yekutevera.

Pari zvino, chirongwa ichi chakanangana nekubatsira vechidiki vanoita zvemitambo vari paIndlovu Youth Centre mumusha unogara veruzhinji weTshabalala uko kunove kwakatangira chikwata cheNobuntu makore matanhatu apfuura. Asi vanoti vanoda kuti chirongwa ichi chikure.

Heather anotsigirawo maonero ekuti vanhukadzi vanofanirwa kukwanisa kuwana masanitary pads pachena sezvinoitwawo macondom.

Sezvo pasati pawanikwa mushonga wekudzivirira kana kurapa chirwere cheCoronavirus, nyanzvi munyaya dzehutano dzinoti chirwere ichi chikasakundwa, chinogona kuita hukasha hunodarika chirwere chefuruwenza icho chakauraya vanhu vanodarika mamiriyoni makumi mashanu pasi rose kubva muna 1918 kusvika muna 1920.
Coronavirus yabata vanhu vanodarika miriyoni imwe chete nemazana mana ezviuru pasi rose, uye yauraya vanhu vanodarika zviuru makumi masere nezviviri kubva zvayatanga kuChina gore rapera.
Senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwechirwere ichi, vanhu vanodarika mabhiriyoni mana pasi rose havasi kuenda kumabasa, vachiswera vari mudzimba dzavo.
Bazi rezvehutano nekuchengetwa kwakanaka kwevana rinoti huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 hwakwira kusvika pamakumi matatu nevasere zvichitevera kuwanikwa kwakaitwa munhu mumwe chete aine chirwere ichi muHarare nemusi weChina.
Bazi iri razivisawo kuti vafa nechirwere ichi vachiri vana munyika yose, uye vapona kubva kuchirwere ichi vari gumi nevatatu.
Izvi zvinobuda panguva iyo mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vari kutarisirwa kuzivisa nezvekuti vari kuwedzera mazuva here kana kubvisa mutemo unorambidza kufambafamba kwevanhu, kana kuti lockdown, uyo vakaderedza kuenda pachinhanho chepiri, kana kuti Level 2 masvondo maviri adarika.
Mutemo uyu uri kutarisirwa kupera nemusi weSvondo.
Johns Hopkins University yemuAmerica inoti vanhu vabatwa nechirwere ichi pasi rose vadarika mamiriyoni mana nemazana mana ezviuru (4.4 million) uye vafa nechirwere ichi vasvika pazviuru mazana matatu nezvitatu nemazana matatu nemakumi masere nevapfumbamwe (303 389).
Gweta uye vari chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chiri ku Britain, Doctor Simba Mavaza, vanoti kukwira kwehuwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 nemunhu mumwe chete kunoratidza kuti chirwere ichi hachisati chadzika midzi munyika.
Dctor Mavaza vanoti izvi zvinogona kunge zviri kukonzerwa nenyaya yekuti vanhu vari kutevedzera kurudziro yekuti vazvichengetedze, kana matanho ari kutorwa nehurumende ekuchengetedza kwavo voga vose vanenge vaponda munyika vachibva kunze.
Panyaya yekuti mutungamiri wenyika owedzera here kana kubvisa mazuva ekusafambafamba kwevanhu, Doctor Mavaza vanoti vanofunga kuti VaMnangagwa vachavhura makambani ose uye kubvumidza vanhu kufambafamba sezvo pakatoiswa kare matanho anofanirwa kuteverwa nevemakambani mukuona kuti vashandi vavo vakadzivirirwa kubva kuchirwere ichi.

Mutungamiri wesangano reAdvocates4Earth, VaLenin Tinashe Chisaira, vaudza vatori venhau kuti sangano ravo harisi kufara nemararamiro ari kuita mhuka zvikurusei kuHwange National Park uko kwavanoti mhuka dzakawanda dziri kufa nenzara pamwe nenyota zvakonzerwa nekusanaya zvakanaka kwemvura gore rino kubudikidza nekushanduka kwemamiriro ekunze.
VaChisaira vati havasi kufara kuti magweta avo pamwe nevesangano rinoona nezvekuchetedzwa kwekodzero dzemhuka kuti dzisaitirwa hutsinye reZimbabwe National Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals, vakarambidzwa nebazi rehurumende reZimParks svondo rapera kuongorora mararamiro ari kuita mhuka kuHwange National Park.
Nekuda kwekufa nenzara kwavanoti kuri kuita mhuka, VaChisaira vati vave kuronga kufamba kubva kuHarare kuenda kuHwange vachipemha mari ichashandiswa mukutengera mhuka dziri kufa idzi chikafu.
Vane ruzivo nezviri kuitika vanoti pane nzou dzinodarika makumi mashanu neshanu dzakawanikwa dzakafa nepamusana pekushaya mvura nechikafu.
Nzou idzi dzinonzi dzakatanga kufa muna Gunyana.
VaChisaira vanotiwo mhuka dziri kutadza kugara zvakanaka mune dzimwe nzvimbo dzinochengeterwa kubudikidza nemabasa ari kuitwa nevanhu anosanganisira kucherwa kwezvicherwa.
Zvichakadai, imwe nyanzvi inoongorora nyaya dzemhuka, VaEvans Ndadzungira, vatiwo havasi kufara nekutengeswa kuri kuitwa nzou dzichiri diki nehurumende kunyika dzakaita seChina vachiti mhuka idzi dzine mukana wekufa kana dzichinge dzaenda kunyika idzi.
Hatina kukwanisa kunzwa divi reZimParks sezvo mutauriri wesangano iri, VaTinashe Farawo, sezvo vati vari kunze kwenyika.
Hatinawo kukwanisa kubata vakafanobata chigaro chegurukota rinoona nezvekushanyirwa kwenyika, VaSimangaliso Ndlovu, pamwe negurukota rinoona nezvemigodhi, VaWinston Chitando, kuti tinzwe divi rehurumende panyaya iyi sezvo vanga vasiri kudaira nharembozha dzavo.

Nzou dzinonzi dzauraya vanhu vanodarika makumi maviri vari munzvimbo dziri pedyo neHwange National Park gore rino chete.

Izvi zvinotevera kuchema chema kwevamwe vanhu kuti munzvimbo dzavo muri kupisa zvakanyanya.
VaZinyemba vakurudzira veruzhinji kuti vamwe mvura yakawanda panguva iyo kunze kuri kupisa parizvino. Vaenderera mberi vachiti kune dzimwe nzvimbo nhasi kwambo pfunha pfunha mvura zvaita kuti pave nedonhodzo shoma.
"Tinokurudzira veruzhinji kuti vanwe mvura zhinji sezvo kunze kuri kupisa asi pari zvino hatingati iheat wave sezvo iyi ichiitika kwema zuva mashanu zvichidarika," VaZinyemba vaudza Studio 7.

Doctor Tax vanoenderera mberi vachiti sangano ravo rakatora danho rekubatsirana neZimbabwe mukurwa hondo yekubviswa kwezvirango izvi nokuti ndizvo zviri kuita kuti zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvidye nhoko dzezvironda.

“Tine dambudziko rekuti vamwe vanouya kumusangano vachiti vari kuzopinda basa, aiwa kuno hakusi kwekutsvaga basa asi kushandira nyika, saka vane pfungwa iyi tinoti ngwarirai nekuti nguva yavepedyo.”

Zimbabwe yabatana nepasi rose mukucherechedza zuva revakaremara, reInternational Day of Persons with Disabilities, vakaremara vachiti kunyange vachicherechedza zuva iri, hapana zvikuru zviri kuitwa nehurumende kurerutsa hupenyu hwavo.
Nhengo yesangano revakaremara reNational Council of Disabled Persons of Zimbabwe, uye vakaremara, Amai Farai Cherera, vanoti zuva iri izuva rakakosha zvikuru kuvanhu vakaremara sezvo riri zuva rekutarisa budiriro munyaya dzevakaremara, matambudziko avanosangana nawo, uye kuti ndezvipi zvavakakwanisa kuita zvakabudirira.
Vanoti chikuru chakasangana nevakaremara mugore rapera ra2016 hurombo pamwe nekutarisirwa pasipasi neveruzhinji, asi vanotarisiwo kuti zvinhu zvichashanduka nekuvepowo kwehurumende itsva yaVaEmmerson Mnangagwa.
Bato reMDC-T, ratumirawo mashoko ekuti rinobatanawo nepasi rose uye zuzhinji rwevana veZimbabwe mukucherechedza zuva revakaremara iri.
Mutauriri webato iri VaObert Gutu, mumashoko avo kuvatori venhau, vati sebato rinorwira hutongo hwejekerere, MDC-T inoshushikana zvikuru nemabatirwo evanhu vakaremara.
Vati sebato, itarisiro yavo yekuti vakaremara vasasemwa uye kusarurwa, kungava kuzvikoro, kudzimba kana kumabasa, sezvo vakawanda vakaremara vakaratidza kuti vanoziva nekugona zvose zvinoitwa nevamwe kuburikidza nekubudirira kwavo mune zvakasiyanasiyana.
Zvichakadaro, mamwe masangano anomirira vanhu vakaremera akatambira nemufaro kudomwa kwaVaJoshua Malinga sachipanganzano kumutungamiriri wenyika panyaya dzevakaremera, achiti anovimba kuti izvi zvichabatsira kugadzirisa matambudziko avanosangano nawo zuva nezuva.
Munyori wesangano reLawyers with Disabilitiues Association of Zimbabwe, VaAbraham Mateta, vanoti VaMalinga munhu agara achirwira kodzero dzevakaremera kwenguva yakareba uye vanotarisira kuti vachaita basa ravo nemazvo muhurumende.
Vati zvinofadza kuti VaMnangagwa vakadoma munhu akaremera pachinzvimbo ichi vachiti izvi zvinobatsira chose nekuti vanonzwisisa zvinonesta vanhu vakarememera munyika.
VaMateta vaudza Studio 7 kuti vanotarisirwa kuti kudomwa kwaVaMalinga kuchaitawo kuti vanhu vakaremera munyika vafarire kupinda munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika.
Vaenderera mberi vachiti vanotarisira kuti VaMalinga vachashanda nesimba kuona kuti mutemo weDisabled Persons Act watevedzwa pamwe nekuona kuti padomwa mukuru anoona nezvevakaremera mubazi rezvevashandi nekuchengetedzwa kwakanaka kwwevanhu.
Mukuru we sangano reCentre for Disability and Development, VaMasimba Kuchera vaudza Studio 7 kuti vanovimba kuti kudomwa kwaVaMalinga kuchaunza shanduko vachiti kunyange hazvo hurumende yaVaMugabe yaive nanachipangamazano panyaya dzevakaremera hapana chakabuda panguva yehutongo hwavo.

VaMasaraure vanoti kana hurumende yakaramba yakaomesa musoro, vanozoenda kumatare edzimhosva kuti amise kuvhurwa kwezvikoro uku, uko vanoti kunoisa hupenyu hwevana pamwe nehwevarairidzi panjodzi.

Dingindira regore rino, rekuti "Women and Diabetes-our right to a healthy future", rakanangana nehutano hwemadzimai, ayo anonzi naAmai Gutu ndiwo anonyanyobatwa nechirwere ichi.
Chirwere cheshuga chinonzi chimwe chezvirwere zvisingatapuriranwe zviri kunetsa mupasi rose.
MuZimbabwe vanhu vanodarika miriyoni nechidimbu vanonzi vari kurarama nechirwere ichi, uye vamwe vakawanda havasati vavhenekwa kana vainachowo.
Mupasi rose madzimai vanoda kusvika mamiriyoni mazana maviri vanonzi nesangano reInternational Diabetes Association vari kurarama nechirwere cheshuga, huwandu hunotarisirwa kuti huchakwira kusvika pamamiriyoni mazana matatu mugore ra 2040.
Amai Gutu vanoti sangano ravo richaita mhemberero dzegore rino svondo rinouya, apo vachari cherechedza nemitambo takasiyanasiyana pamwe nekuvheneka vanhu pachena.
Nhengo dzebato reMDC inotungamirirwa naVaNelson Chamisa mudunhu reMashonaland West yadoma VaChamisa kuti vatungamire bato kubva pakongiresi uye VaCharlton Hwende kuti vakwikwidze chinzvimbo chemunyori mukuru.
Dunhu iri radomawo Muzvare Mpariwa, VaMorgan Komichi naVaTendai Biti kuti vave vatevedzeri vaVaChamisa.
Kusvika parizvino bato reMDC raita makongiresi munzvimbo dzinoti Matebeleland South, Matebeland North, Midlands, Mashonaland West neUnited States.
Parizvino dunhu reMashonaland East riri pakati pekuita kongiresi yavo. Vachitaura nhasi muChinhoyi mutauriri webato iri VaJacob Mafume vanoti makongiresi avo ari kufamba zvakanaka.
VaRalph Magunje ndivo vasarudzwa kuve sachigaro wedunhu vakunda VaWilson Makanyaire.
VaMagunje vanoti vachagadzirisa zvose zvavakakanganisa uye vachashanda nenhengo dzose mudunhu.

Panyaya yekudomwa pakongiresi VaMafume vanoti zvinogona kuitika chete kana vanhu vose vanechekuita nechinzvimbo chiri kukwikwidzwa vawirirana.
Kusvika parizvino VaChamisa chete ndivo vadomwa pachinzvimbo chemutungamiri webato uye nhengo shanu dzinoti VaKomichi, VaBiti, Muzvare Mpariwa, VaWelshman Ncube naAmai Lilian Tiomvous vakadomwa kuve vatevedzeri vemutungamiri webato.

Vamwe vagari vemuChitungwiza vanoshandisa musika weGuzha uri paChikwanha, pasi peManyame Rural District Council, vari kunyunyuta nekusagadziriswa kwedambudziko remvura inonzi iri kujenga pamusika uyu.
Vanoshandisa musika uyu vanoti izvi zviri kuvaisa munjodzi huru yekubatwa nezvirwere zvinosanganisira zvemanyoka nemalaria sezvo hutunga huri kunzi hwave kuberekeranawo mumvura iyi, iyo vanoti inonhuhwa.
Mumwe mugari wemuChitungwiza anoshandisawo musika uyu, VaFarai Muza, vanoti dambudziko iri rave nemakore anogona kudarika matatu risina kugadziriswa, kunyange hazvo vachigara vachiyeuchidza kanzuru yeManyame nezvaro.
VaMuza vanoti mvura iri kujenga iyi iri kukanganisa vemisika zvekuti vamwe vanotoshanda vakatsika mumvura iyi ichivasvika mumabvi.
"Nekunaya kwave kuita mvura drain riya rabva razara mvura manje zvekuti chirwere che cholera chave kutotarisirwa kuti chichabva ipapo. Apa ndipo panowanikwa ma fruits and vegetables ese ano supplier Chitungwiza chese nenzvimbo dzakaita sananaDema. saka unoona kuti kanzuru yakundikana chose kuti inge ichitora matanho," VaMuza vanodaro.
Mukuru weManyame Rural District Council, Doctor Farirai Guta, vanoti kanzuru yavo iri kuziva nezvedambudziko iri uye iri mushishi yekurigadzirisa, kunyange hazvo iri kusanganawo nematambudziko semamwe makanzuru ose.
"Dambudziko tinogona kuva tichiriziva zvedu nezvaro but, paGuzha pane mabasa akawanda atiri kushanda nezvawo. Tine project yekuisa tara paGuzha, ndofunga takatomboisa tara ipo pa area yemusika, hatisati tanyopedza zvedu," Doctor Guta vanodaro.
Vanoti sezvo vachiri mushishi yekugadzirisa nzvimbo iyi, zvemugero unorasa mvura vaironga kuzongozviita kana vapedza basa racho rose.
"Kungoti zvinhu zviri kunetsawo mazuvano nemawaniro atiri kuitawo mari but, chirongwa chekugadzirisa musika tinacho. Ivo vangangochema zvavo vanhu but vakaona kuti panotove ne shed yatiri mubishi kuvaka izvozvi yevarimi."
Doctor Guta vari kukurudzirawo vanoshandisa musika uyu kuti vange vachibhadharawo mitero yavo kuitira kuti kanzuru inge ichiwana mari yekushandisa mumabasa akaita sekugadiridza nzvimbo dzinoshandiswa neveruzhinji.
"Tinenge tichikurudzirawo kunyanya ivo fanika vemisika kuti kanzuru ishande zvakanaka tinenge tichitoraramawo navo panyaya dzemari neyi, neyi neyi. Tine dambudziko rekuti vamwe havasi kuti supporter in terms of kubhadhara mitero yavo vane ma tables pamusika ipapo."

Komisheni inoona nezvekodzero dzevanhu yeZimbabwe Human Rights Commission, inoti iri kushushikana nehuwandu hwevanhu vaongororwa kana vaine chirwere che COVID-19 munyika kusvika pari zvino.
Komisheni iyi inoti vanhu zana nemakumi mapfumbamwe nevana vanozi vainge vaongororwa kusvika musi wa30 Kurume, vaive vashoma zvikuru pachitariswa zviuru zvevanhu zvakapinda munyika kubva pakatanga chirwere ichi kuChina gore rapera.
Mugwaro rayakaburitsa neChitatu, Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission inotiwo iri kukurudzira hurumende kuti ipe dzidziso pamusoro peCoronavirus mundimi dzakasiyanasiyana, kusanganisirawo mutauro wemaoko kana kuti Sign Language, senzira yekuti veruzhinji vabatsirikane.
Komisheni iyi inotiwo hurumende iri kunonoka kuita kuti kuongororwa kwevanhu kuti vane hutachiwana here kana kuti kwete kuitwe mumatunhu ose emunyika, kwete kuti kungoitwa muHarare chete.

Nyaya yekudzimwa kwemagetsi inonzi inoita kuti vamwe varwere varare vachitonhorwa vasina hembe sezvo vachityirwa kuti vanozvisungirira apo vanenge vari mumipanda yakatsaurwa.

VaMangena, avo vari kumiririrwa nemagweta ekambani yeHatinahama and Associates, vanoda kuti vaimvove vashandi vemakambi iyi vana pamwe nemutori wenhau weZimbabwe Broadcasting Corporation, Chamunorwa Murava, uyo akaburitsa nyaya iyi apo yakaitika muparamende mwedzi miriri yapfuura, pamwe neZBC yacho, vavaripe miriyoni yemadhora ekuAmerica vachiti vakasvibisa zita ravo apo vakapa humbowo kukomiti yezvekurima apo vaitaura chikiribidi chaiitwa nekambani yePremier Tobacco pakutenga fodya.
Mumwe wevashandi ava, Amai Lydia Chinyauruka, vaudza komiti yezvekurima kuti vave kusungiswa naVaMangena zvichitevera kumira kwavakaita papmberi pekomiti iyi.
Amai Chinyauruka vati ivo, VaTawanda Murape, VaShepard Kudhinga, VaTendai Mavu naMurava ndivo vari kuendeswa kumatare naVaMangena.

Vakawanikwa vaine mhosva vanogona kukandwa mujeri neparamende.
VaMangena vane zvikamu makumi maviri kubva muzana zvehupfumi mukambani yePremier, uye VaMurumbi vane zvikamu makumi masere kubva muzana mukambani iyi.
Mune imwewo nyaya mukuru wekambani yeTobacco Sales Floor, Amai Marry Machingaidze, vaudza komiti yaVaWadyajena kuti huwandu nemutengo wefodya iri kutengeswa gore rino huri pasi chose kana zvichienzaniswa negore rapfuura.
Vati semuenzaniso vanokwanisa kutenga zviuru makumi maviri nezvina zvemabhero pazuva, asi mwaka uno vari kutenga mabhero zviuru gumi nezvitatu chete.
Vatiwo mwaka wapfuura mutengo wepakati nepakati wefodya waive $2.79 asi gore rino uri pa$1.85 pakirogiramu.
Amai Machingaidze vatiwo mhando yefodya mwaka uno iri pasi uye vatiwo varimi vanofanira kupihwa rutsigiro rwemari nezvimwe zvikwanisiro kuitira kuti varime fodya yemhando yepamusoro.

Mune imwewo nyaya, paramende iri kuongorora hukama pakati pekambani yeEthical Leaf Tobacco, Premier Leaf Zimbabwe pamwe neTSF.
Ethical Leaf Tobacco ikambani inobatsira varimi nemari, mbeu fotireza nezvimwe ichizoti vatengese fodya yavo kuTSF uko inotorwa nePremier Leaf International inoitengesa kunze kwenyika.

Dare remakurukota rave kuzeya bhiri rekuvandudza kurapwa kweveruzhinji munyika, rePublic Health Management Act Ammendement Bill, kuti rizoende kuparamende uko nhengo dzeparamende dzati dzichapasisa bhiri iri nekukasika kuti veruzhinji vawane hutano hunokodzera.
Izvi zvaziviswa nemunyori mukuru mubazi rezvehutano nekuchengetedzwa kwevana, Dr Gerald Gwinji, avo vati bazi ravo rakatora makore akawanda kugadzirisa mutemo uyu nekuti raida kuona kuti zvese zvinonetsa vanhu zvagadziriswa.
Vati mutemo uyu wakagadzirwa mugore ra1924 uye pave nezvirwere zvakawanda zvavepo kubvira panguva iyi, uye mutemo uyo wave kugadziriswa kuti ufambirane nenguva.
Sachigaro vekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvehutano, Dr. Ruth Labode, vaudza Studio 7 kuti zvinofadza kuti hurumende yave kugadzirisa mutemo uyu kuti ufambirane nezviri kuitika mazuvano.
Mutemo wePublic Health Act sezvauri, haubvumidze vanachiremba nanamukoti kuti varape vechidiki vanenge vaine zvirwere zvepabonde kunyange hazvo paine humbowo hwekuti vechidiki vakawanda munyika vave kuita zvepabonde vasati vasvika pazera rino bvumidzwa kuita izvi.
Dr. Labode vati kuvandudzwa kwemutemo uyu kuchagadzirisa izvi pamwe nedzimwe nyaya dzakaita sekuti vana amai vakazvitakura vano fanirwa kubatsirwa pachena muzvipatara zvehurumende.
Imwe nyaya inotarisirwa kugadziriswa nemutemo uyu inyaya yekupa mari kunyaya dzehutano munyika.
Pari zvino zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka munyika panyaya dzehutano sezvo hurumende iri kutadza kuisa mari inokwana kunyaya dzehutano, izvo zvave kukonzera kuti vakawanda munyika vashaye mishonga nezvimwe zvikwanisiro muzvipatara zveveruzhinji.
Vamwewo vanowana munyika kusanganisira mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe, mhuri yavo, makurukota pamwe nevamwe vakuru-vakuru muhurumende, havachina chivimbo nezvipatara zvemunyika zvekuti vave kuno rapwa kunyika dzakaita seSingapore, India neSouth Africa.

Nyika iri kurangarira nyanzvi yekunyora mitambo, zvedzidzo netsika, VaStephen Chipfunyise, avo vakashaya neMuvhuro muHarare.
VaChipfunyise, avo vanga vave nemakore makumi manomwe ekuberekwa, vakashaya mushure mekunetseka nechirwere chegomarara.
Vakambowewo munyori mubazi rezvedzidzo, mitambo netsika, uye vaitungamira pamwe nekushanda nemasangano ezvemitambo netsika akawanda kusvika mukushaya kwavo.
VaChipfunyise vakazvarwa mugore ra 1948 kuShurugwi, vakazodzidza kuZambia vasati vaenda kuAmerica kunoita zvidzidzo zvepamusoro, uko vakazobuda neMasters’ Degree mune zvemitambo.
Kubva muna 1978 kusvika 1981 vakazove mukuru wezvetsika muhurumende yeZambia, vachizosiya vachive mudzidzisi paUniversity of Zimbabwe muna 1983.
Mugore rimwechete iroro, vakave mukuru wezvemitambo mubazi revechidiki, mitambo netsika muhurumende yeZimbabwe kusvika muna 1988, vakazobva vave kunoshanda semutewedzeri wemunyori muhofisi yemutewedzeri wemutungamiri wenyika.
Muna 1989, VaChipfunyise vakaumba chikwata cheCHIPAWO (Children‘s Performing Arts Workshop) icho chinobatsira vechidiki kusimudzira matarenda avo mune zvemitambo nemimhanzi.
Muna 1995 kusvika muna 2000, VaChipfunyise vakave munyori mukuru mubazi rezvedzidzo, mitambo netsika.
Kubva muna 2000, vakave chipangamazano mune zvemitambo netsika kusvika mukuzoshaya kwavo.
Vakavewo maneja mukuru weKingstons Entertainment (Pvt) Ltd kubva muna 2004 kusvika muna 2010.
Sahwira waVaChipfunyise, uye achiitawo zvemitambo, Daves Guzha, anoti VaChipfunyise vari kutarisirwa kuradzikwa muHarare neChishanu.
Guzha anoti VaChipfunyise vasiya vana vatatu vanoti David, Chipo naMartha, avo vavakaita nemudzimai wavo wekutanga Amai Tisa Chipfunyise, avo vakashaya muna 2004.
Pamusoro pevana vavo vatatu, VaChipfunyise vanonzi vanga vachibatsirawo vamwe vana vakawanda vanobva mumhuri yavo, pamwe nevamwe vanobva kumatunhu akasiyanasiyana emunyika vavanga vachibhadharira mari dzechikoro.

Vakawanda vanoti vari kumuka nguva dzemashambanzou kuitira kuti vaone mutambo uyu vari pamba kana mumabhawa umo vamwe varidzi vazvipira kuvhura kusvika mutambo uyu wapera.
Kunyange hazvo kune dzimwe nyika veruzhinji vasiri kutenderana kuti ari kukunda ndiyani, izvi zvakasiyana zvikuru nemuZimbabwe sezvo veruzhinji vari kuti Mayweather anokunda sezvo ari iye wavanonyanyoziva.

Mutambo uyu hausi kutenderwa kubhejerwa muZimbabwe asi vazhinji vari kukandirana mari pachavo vachiratidzana masimba evavanofunga kuti ndiye achakunda.

Mubatanidzwa weSizinda Community Garden une nhengo zana negumi nevasere.
Gadheni iri riri pahekita imwe chete nechidimbu, uye nhengo imwe chete yemubatanidzwa uyu ine nzvimbo yekurima mibhedha gumi neminomwe yezvirimwa zvakasiyana-siyana, kusanganisira muriwo pamwe nemadomasi.
Ambuya Dube vanoti gadheni iri risati ravepo, vanhu vari mumubatanidzwa uyu vairarama hupenyu hwekudya nhoko dzezvironda, asi ikozvino vanoti vave kurarama hupenyu huri nani.
Gadheni reSizinda rakatangwa mugore ra2015 uye rinodiridzirwa nepombi inoshandisa magetsi anobva kuzuva.
Pombi iyi inokwanisa kupomba marita emvura zviuru zvipfumbamwe paawa imwe chete, uye mvura iyi inochengeterwa mutangi remvura riripo.
Kucherwa kwemugodhi pamwe nepombi yemvura zvakaita zviuru zvinomwe zvemadhora.
Gadheni iri rakakomberedzwa nefenzi uye mugadheni umu pane nzvimbo yakavakirwa danga rehuku.
Pakashandiswa mari inosvika madhora zviuru makumi matatu nezvishanu zvemadhora kuti zvose zviri pagadheni iri zvivepo.

Imwezve nhengo yeSizinda Community Garden ndemumwe mukadzi akangozvidoma nezita rekuti Amai Banda. Amai Banda vanoti vasati vave kuita zvegadheni izvi, vaitambura zvekusvika pakupererwa nezano rekuti vowana kupi rubatsiro.

Asi izvi hazvisi kutambirwa nemufaro nevamwe vanoti kuita hurongwa hwakadai, zvakafanana nekupa vanasikana ava chitambi chekuti vaite zvepabonde pamadiro.

SAFAIDS iri kuita chirongwa ichi kwegore rese pasi pedingindira rekuti HER Choice, uye chine donzvo rekuti hurumende ibvumidze vanasikana vanotangira pamakore gumi kuti vange vachiwana zvikwanisiro izvi, zvakaita sema contraceptives nezvimwe.

Mumwewo mukoma wevechidiki ari muhurongwa hweSAFAIDS, VaRunyararo Muzwaba, vanotiwo vakapinda muchirongwa ichi nepamusana pematambudziko anosanganikwa nawo nevechidiki vanoita zvepabonde vasina kuzvidzivirira.

Dr Ebenezar vanoti vanosanganawo nevarapwi vavanhu vatsemuka mazino mutsaona nevaye vane mazino asina kumira mumutsetse nemamwe.
Imwe nyanzvi yehutano hwemazino, Dr Tariro Manyanga, vanoti zvinokurudzirwa kuti munhu wese anofanirwa kuongororwa mazino ake chero pasina ari kurwadza.
Dr Manyanga vanoti vabereki vanofanira kudzidzisa vana nezvehutano hwemazino pavanotanga kubuda zino rekutanga kuitira kuti vakure vaine tsika yokuchengetedza mazino aya.
Dr Manyanga vanoti kunyange hazvo kiriniki iyi iine hunyanzvi hwekuumba mazino anonzi madentures, ayo anokwanisa kupfekerwa pamavende, ma dentures aya anodhura zvekuti vanhu vashoma vanokwanisa kuutenga.
Dr Manyanga vanoti zvakakosha kuti munhu agare akachengetedza hutano hwemazino ake kuitira kuti agare akasimba, uye aine hutano hwakanaka.
Imwe nyanzvi yehutano hwemazino pakiriniki iyi, VaPetros Magaso, vanoti kanzuru yeHarare inoona vanhu vanooya kuzorapwa mazino vanodarika makumi mashanu kumakiriki matatu anosanganisira makiriniki ekuKuwadzana nekuMabvuku uye pane hurongwa hwekuvhura imwe kiriniki yemazino paTariro Clinic kuHopley.
Caps United yakatadzisa Dynamos kutora hutungamiri hwemakundano eCastle Lager Premier Soccer League mushure mekurova chikwata change chichipisa ichi neSvondo.
NeSvondo vatsigiri veDynamos vakabuda muRufaro Stadium vachichema mushure mekunge chikwata chavo charohwa 1-0 neCaps United ndokutadziswa kuenda panhongonya yeCastle Lager Premier Soccer League kekutanga mwaka uno.
Kechipiri makore maviri akateverana Dembare yakarohwa nechibodzwa kubva kuna Dominic Chungwa uyo akakanda zvekare munhandare imwe cheteyo gore rapera apo maGreen Machine akarova maGlamour Boys 1-0.
Chungwa aive asipo apo Makepekepe akarohwa 2-0 neDynamos masvondo matatu apfuura mushure mekumbomiswa nevePremier Soccer League nemhaka yemayellow kadhi ake aive adarika akatarwa nemutemo.
Asi nezuro, Chungwa ndiye akapatsanura zvikwata zviviri izvi kunyange hazvo Caps United ingadai yakakunda nezvibodzwa zvakawandisa dai vakashandisa mikana yakawandisisa yavakawana.
Mutevedzeri wemurairidzi weCaps United Fungai Kwashi anoti maGreen Machine aikodzera kukunda sezvo vaive pamsuroro peDembare kubva mutambo uchitanga kusvika kumagumo kwawo
Dynamos iyo yaive isina vatambi vayo vana Denvar Mukamba, Lincoln Zvasiya, Tichaona Chipunza na Christian Epoupa yaitatarika zvinotyisa asi mumwe mutsigiri wayo Muzvare Nyaradzai Nyikadzino vanoti nemamiriro aive akaita zvinhu chikwata chavo chakaita nepese pachinogona asi zvakaramba.
Dynamos iri kuramba iri pachidanho chechitatu, ichitevera FC Platinum neChicken Inn iyo iri kutungamira gungano iri.
MaGreen Machine ave pachinhanho chechinomwe nemapoinzi makumi matatu nemashanu.
Asi Fungai Kwashi mutevedzeri wemurairidzi weCaps United anobvuma kuti zvemukombe weligi zvaramba achiwedzera iye kuti vari kutarisira kutora mukombe weChibuku Super Cup uyo varikutanga kutamba ne Ngezi Platinum Stars svondo rino munharaunda yekutanga.
Makwikwi eChibuku Super Cup aya akatanga svondo rino apo Bantu Rovers yakarova Tsholotsho Pirates 3-1, Yadah ikakunda Hwange 1-0 mumitambo yakatambirwa muMandava Stadium neMugovera.
Yadah yave kusangana neChicken Inn munharaunda yekutanga, Bantu Rovers ichibandanawo ne How Mine.
Totarisa mitambo yeEnglish Premier League …
Zvikwata zvemuguta reManchester, Manchester City neManchester United zvakakanda zvibodzwa gumi mumitambo yazvo yekupera kwesvondo.
Manchester City yakabvarura Watford 6-0 ndokuenda pamusoro peEnglish Premier Soccer League ichitora chinzvimbo change chiine Manchester United kunyange hazvo zvikwata izvi zvine mapoinzi akaenzana nezvibodzwa zvakaenzana zvekare.
Zvikwata zviviri izvi zvine mapoinzi gumi nematatu kubva mumitambo mishanu asi Manchester City ndiyo yave pamusoro sezvo izwi rekuti City ndiro rinotanga kuchitevera United.
United yacho yakazvambaradza Everton 4-0 nezvibodzwa zvakabva kuna Antonio Valencia, Henrik Mkhitaryan, Lumelo Lukaku na Antony Martial ndokupinda mumapoinzi gumi nematatu kubva mumitambo mina.

Real Madrid yave pachinhanho chechina mushure mekushanya ndokunorova Real Sociadad 3-1 nezuro ndokupinda mumapoinzi masere.
Asi chikwata chine mukombe weLa Liga ichi chakasiiwa neBarcelona nemapoinzi mana mushure mekunge Barcelona yacho yakafambawo ndokunorova Getafe 2-1.
Barcelona yatora mapoinzi ese mumitambo mina yavatamba asi vane maponzi maviri chete pamusoro peSevilla iyo iri pachinhancho chechipiri uyezve isati yambokundwawo zvekare kubvira makundano aya atanga.
Asi zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka mumisha yeMalaga neDeportivo La Coruna idzo dzisina kana poindi imwechete mushure mekurohwa mumitambo yese mina yavatamba pari zvino.
Dunhu reNew York muAmerica ndiro ririkuona hudzamu hukuru hwechirwere checoronavirus kupfuura mamwe nematunhu ose muAmerica.
Kutaura kuno, kunyange hazvo huwandu hwevarwere nevarikufa hwave kudzika, dunhu reNew York rarasikirwa nevanhu vanopfuura zviuru makumi maviri nezvisere (28,000) asi vanhu vachingori kubatwa nekufa nechirwere ichi kupfuura mune mamwe matunhu muAmerica.
Gavhuna wedunhu reNew York, VaAndrew Cuomo, vakakumbira rubatsiro kubva kune vanamukoti navanachiremba nevamwe vari mubasa rezvehutano, kusanganisa vari pamudyandigere, kuti vaende kuNew York kunobatsira dunhu iri mukurapa nekuchengeta varwere vane Coronavirus.
Vazhinji kubva kumatunhu akasiyanasiyana vakazvinzwa vakaenda kuno batsira varwere vane coronavirus mudunhu reNew York.
Umwe wevakanzwa chikumbiro chaGavhuna Cuomo chizvarwa cheZimbabwe, Muzvare Chiwoneso Mpofu, uyo panguva iyo akange achishanda mudunhu re Ohio, muno muAmerica.
Muzvare Mpofu anoti panguva yaakange achifanirwa kunyorerana chibvumirano chebasa chitsva nechipatara chaaishandira kuOhio, akaona zvakakodzera kuenda kuNew York, uko kuchakangotarisana nedambudziko rechirwere che coronavirus, achiti ruzivo rwake rwurikudiwa zvakanyanya nevarwere ava kuNew York.
Muzvare Mpofu anoti kuve mukoti haisi nyaya yekutsvaka mari asi kuti chinhu chinenge chagara chiri muhana yemunhu.
Studio 7 yabata Muzvare Chiwoneso Mpofu kuti vatitsanangurire kuti sei vakafunga zvekupinda munzvimbo irikufiwa nevanhu vazhinji, pamwe chete nevanamukoti.
Vamiriri venyika dziri European Union muZimbabwe dzinoti France, Germany, Greece, Netherlands, Romania, Sweden neUnited Kingdom, vakabatana nevamiriri venyika dzinoti Canada, Australia neAmerica, vaburitsa gwaro rinoshoropodza kushandiswa kwechisimba mukutyorwa kwekodzero dzevanhu muZimbabwe.
Vamiriri ava vanoti hurumende yeZimbabwe yakashandisa chisimba, mukutyora kodzero dzevanhu pamwe neshungurudza vanhu munguva yekuratidzira kwakaitwa musi wa16 Nyamnavhuvhu, uye mushure mekuratidzira uku.
Gwaro raburitswa iri rinoti nyika idzi dziri kushushikana zvikuru nekushungurudzwa, kurohwa pamwe nekutyorwa kwekodzero dzevatungamiri vemasangano evashandi, vemapato anopikisa, uye vemasangano akazvimirira.
Vamiriri venyika idzi vari kukurudzira hurumende yeZimbabwe kuti iremekedze kodzero dzekuungana kwevanhu pamwe nekuti varatidzire, uyewo kukurudzira vemapato ezvematongerwo enyika kuti vasiyane netsika yekutyisidzira vamwe kana kukurudzira mhirizhonga kana kuparadza midziyo nezvivakwa.
Asi hurumende, kuburikidza nebazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, inoti inoshamiswa kwazvo nedanho ratorwa nenyika idzi rekupindira munyaya dzeZimbabwe panyaya yekuratidzira kwainoti kwaive kunze kwemutemo kwakaitika musi wa 16 Nyamavhuvhu, 2019.
Munyori webazi rezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, VaNick Mangwana, vaburitsawo mashoko anoti gwaro renyika dzekumawirira iri harina kuda kutaurawo pamusoro pemutongo wakapiwa nedare redzimhosva repamusoro, reHigh Court pamusoro penyaya yekuratidzira iyi.
VaMangwana vanoti mutongo wedare repamusoro unoreva kuti hapana zvimwe zvaizokwaniswa kuitwa mushure mazvo.
VaMangwana vanoti Zimbabwe yakazvipira kuona kuti yagadzirisa zvinodiwa kuti munyika muve nekugadzikana mune zveupfumi nezvematongerwo enyika.
Nyanzvi mune zvematongerwo enyika, Doctor Victor Chimhutu, avo vanodzidzisa pa Bergen University ku Norway, vanoti zvinhu zvavanotarisirawo kuti nyika dzinodyidzana neZimbabwe dzinge dzichiisawo ziso pane zvinenge zvichiitika muZimbabwe.
Doctor Chimhutu vanoti chinonyanyotambudza ndechekuti kutyorwa kwekodzero dzevanhu kuri kutonyanyisa munguva yehurumende yaVaEmmerson Mnangagwa kana zvichienzaniswa nenguva yehutongo hwaVaRobert Mugabe.
Asi vanoongorora zvematongerwo enyika vari nhengo yeZanu PF, VaGadzira Chirumhanzu, vanoti zvinozivikanwa kuti vachena venyika dzekumawirira ava vagara vachida kushungurudza Africa, uye kuba hupfumi kubva munyika idzi, saka vachida kupindira munyaya dzenyika dzemuAfrica.
VaChirumhanzu vanoti chinovashamisa ndechekuti vachena ivava ndivo vanoda kudzidzisa Zimbabwe pamusoro pekodzero dzevanhu, kwete kuti Zimbabwe itungamire yoga munyaya dzekodzero dzevana vayo.
Masangano anomirira vanotengesa mumigwagwa nemabhizimisi madiki ari kushushikana kuti makanzuru ari kuramba achiputsa misika nezvitoro zvinonzvi zvakavakwa zviri kunze kwemutemo kunyange hazvo dare repamusoro rakapa mutongo wekuti izvi zvimbomiswa mwedzi wapfuura.
Mutungamiriri wesangano reZimbabwe Chamber of Informal Economy, Amai Lorraine Sibanda, vanoti zviri kuitwa nehurumende nemakanzuru hazvina kunaka.
Vanoti gwara rakanaka ndere kuti hurumende nemakanzuru vagare pasi nevanotengesa mumigwagwa pamwe nevamabhizimisi madiki kuti vatsvage kuti vangashande sei pasina kuputsirana zvivakwa.
Mukuru wesangangano reVendors Initiative for Social and Economic Transformation, VaSamuel Wadzai, vaudza Studio7 kuti danho rekuputsa zvivakwa harisi danho rinobatsira nyika asi kuti rinoparadza raramo yevanhu vakawanda avo vanorarama neekutengesa mumigwagwa.
Vatiwo vanotarisira kuti vemakanzuru nevemuhurumende vachagadzira nzvimbo itsva dzekutengesera nekukasika semaputsiro avari kuita misika.
Mwedzi wapfuura, dare repamusoro rakatambira chikumbiro chekuti vagari vekuChitungwiza neEpworth vamire kuputsirwa misika nezvitoro zvinonzi zvakavakwa zvisiri pamutemo.
Asi mugwaro ravakanyorera makanzuru ese munyika svondo rino, munyori webazi rekukutongwa kwematunhu, VaZvinechimwe Churu, vakati makanzuru anofanira kuramba achiputsa zvivakwa nemisika yese yakavakwa zviri kunze kwemutemo uye makunzuru aya anofanira kugadzira pekutengesera pakanaka pasingaparadzire hutachiona hwecoronavirus, uho hunokonzera chirwere cheCovid-19.
VaChuru vakati dare repamusoro rakati chiziviso chavo chekutanga chaive pamutemo nekudaro makanzuru anofanira kuramba achienderera mberi nebasa rekugadzira nzvimbo dzekutengesera dzakanaka.
Asi mukuru weChitungizwa Resident Trust kana kuti Chitrest, Muzvare Alice Kuvheya vaudza Studio 7 kuti sangano ravo harisi kufara nedanho rehurumende.
Vaenderera mberi vachiti vazhinji muChitungwiza vave kufa nenzara zvichitevera kupazwa kwemisika yavo.
Gweta reChitrest, Dr Tarisai Mutangi, vaudza Studio 7 chiziviso chehurumende ndechekuti makanzuru avake kana kugadzirisa nzvimbo dzekutengesera chitevedza mutemo.
Vati panofanira kuputswa chivakwa, kanzuru inofanira kuzivisa munhu kuti akwanise kubvisa zvinhu zvake kwete kuita zvekumupwanyirwa.
Vatiwo pari zvino nyika yakavharwa uye vanhu havakwanise kuenda kumisika nekudaro makanzuru anofanira kumira kusvika nyika yavhurwa zvakare.
Mutauririri wekanzuru weHarare, VaMichael Chideme, vaudza Studio7 kuti vari kuenderera mberi nechirongwa chavo chekuputsa zvivakwa zvisiri pamutemo. Vati nhasi chaiko vange vari mumusha weAvondale. Vatiwo kanzuru yavo iri kugadzirawo zvimbo dzekutengesera dzakachena.
Pari zvinho nyika yakavharwa senzira yekudzivirira kupararira kwehutachiona hweCoronavirus, uho hunokonzera chirwere cheCovid-19.
Kunyange hazvo zvimwe zvitoro nemamwe mabhizimisi zvakavhurwa, misika haisati yavhurwa.
Mukuru wesangano reConfederation of Zimbabwe Retailers VaDenford Mutashu, vanoti kushaikwa kwehupfu nekutengeswa kwaho pamukoto mucherechedzo mukuru wekusamira zvakanaka kwehupfumi munyika.  Vachitaura neStudio7 mushure memusangano waitwa nesangano reGrain Millers Association of Zimbabwe nevatapi venhau muBulawayo, VaMutashu vati kuvepo kwevanhu vakawanda vanoita zvemabhizimisi vakazvimirira vega vakawanda vacho vachiita izvi zvisiri pamutemo - kana kuti informal sector, kuri kuita kuti vemabhizimisi ezvitoro zvikuru vatatarike.
Vati hurumende inofanirwa kugadzirisa mamiriro ehupfumi nekukasika vachiti kana izvi zvikasaitika vamwe vezvitoro zvikuru ava vachatadza kuramba vachishanda.  VaMutashu varamba nyaya yekuti vezvitoro zvikuru ndivo vari kukonzera kushaikwa kwehupfu vachinzi vanohutengesa pamukoto vachiti kushikwa kwehupfu kuripo kuri kukonzerwa nekuti hupfu hwacho hausi kuwanikwa.
VaMutashu vati nekuda kwekuti mafuta emotokari ari kugara achikwira nguva dzose, izvi zvinorevawo kuti mutengo wehupfu unofanirwa kugara uchiwedzerwawo zvakaringana.
Mukuru weGrain Millers Association of Zimbabwe, GMAZ, VaTafadzwa Musarara, vati sangano ravo rakapiwa mvumo nehurumende pakupera kwaMbudzi kuti ritenge chibage kubva kunze kwenyika vakati izvi zvichabatsira kuderedza kushomeka kwehupfu mukati memasvondo mashoma ari kutevera.
VaMusarara vabvuma kuti vamwe vanogaya hupfu nevamwewo vanotengesa vari kukonzera kushaikwa kwehupfu nekuti vanohutengesa pamukoto asi vati kuti dambudziko iri ripere, munyika munofanirwa kuve nehupfu hwakawanda.
Munyori mukuru wesangano reBulawayo United Residents Association, Amai Louisa Mangisi, avo vange vari pamusangano uyu, vati vanotarisira kuti danho riri kutorwa nesangano reGMAZ richabatsira kupedza dambudziko rekushaikwa kwehupfu.
Apo VaMutashu vanga vachitaura nevatori venhau, vanhu vakawanda vanga vakamira pamutsetse wekutenga hupfu muBulawayo.
Mutengo wehupfu wakambokwira zvikuru mushure mekunge hurumende yabvisa mari yainosa pamutengo wehupfu kuitira kuti husanyanya kukwira, asi yakazodzorerazve mari iyi pakutanga kwaMbudzi.
Nekuda kwekusanaya zvakanaka kwemvura munyika, nyika yakatarisana nedambudziko rekushaikwa kwechikafu kunyanya chibage icho chinogadzirisa hupfu chinove chikafu chinonyanya kudyiwa neveruzhinji munyika.
Mukuru wedunhu reGauteng muJohannesburg, VaDavid Makhura, vakazivisa neChipiri kuti nekufamba kwenguva, dunhu ravo richadzika mutemo unorambidza vekune dzimwe nyika kutanga mabhizimisi mudunhu ravo, sezvo izvi zviri kutadzisa zvizvarwa zvemuSouth Africa, kuti zviwanewo chekubata.
VaMakhura vakataura mashoko aya mudare ravo redunhu, apo vakange vachipindura mibvunzo yaibva kune dzimwe nhengo dzedare ravo.
Vanoona nezvekodzero dzavanhu vanoti mashoko akataurwa naVaMakhura anokonzeresa kuti pave neruvengo pakati pevanobva kunze kwenyika nezvizvarwa zvemuSouth Africa.
Mumwe muzvinabhizimusi muSouth Africa neZimbabwe, VaBrighton Sangore, vanoti mashoko akadai anobata zvizvarwa zvisiri zvemuSouth Africa, agara achitaurwa kwenguva yakareba muSouth Africa.
Sachigaro weHuman Rights Watch kuchamhembe kweAfrica, VaDewa Mavhinga, vanoti mashoko akadai haafanirwe kunge achibva pamuromo pemunhu anonyarikana saVaMakhura.
VaMavhinga vanoti mashoko aVaMakhura anotyora kodzero dzevanhu uye handicho chaive chido chevaimbove mutungamiri weSouth Africa, mushakabvu Nelson Mandela.
Sachigaro wesangano reZimbabwe Exiles Forum, VaGabriel Shumba, vanotiwo mashoko aVaMakhura anotyora mitemo yenyika, iyo isina rusarura pakuvambwa kwemabhizinesi.
VaShumba vanoti kana vekunze vachivhura mabhizimusi muSouth Africa, vanenge vachibatsira kusimudzira hupfumi hwenyika iyi.
VaShumba vanoti VaMakhura vanofanirwa kukumbira ruregerero kuzvizvarwa zvose zvekune dzimwe nyika zviri muSouth Africa.
VaShumba vanoti sangano reZimbabwe Exiles Forum riri kuita hurukuro nemamwe masangano akasiyanasiyana, senzira yekugadzirisa matambudziko akatarisana nezvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri muSouth Africa.
Mashoko aVaMakhura anouya mushure mokunge zvitoro zvezvizvarwa zvekunze kweSouth Africa zvapazwa nekupiswa, ukuwo vatyairi vemagonyeti vachimbunyikidzwa kodzero dzavo, vamwe vachimanikidzwa kusiya basa nesangano rinozviti All Truck Drivers Foundation.
Sangano reHuman Rights Watch rinoti vanhu mazana maviri vafa mumhirizhonga yemuSouth Africa kubva muna Kurume gore rapera, vazhinji vavo vari vatyairi vanobva kune dzimwe nyika.
Mamwe matunhu muAmerica akaita seFlorida, Georgia neNorth Carolina anonzi anogona kuwirwa nedambudziko guru redutumupengo remvura nemhepo riri kuzivikanwa nekuti Hurricane Irma.
Kunzvimbo idzi kune zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe izvo zvinoti zviri kugara zvakagadzirira sezvo vakuru vemakanzuru nehurumende vari kuti vanhu vanogona kuudzwa chero nguva kuti vatize mudzimba dzavo kuti vasarasikirwe nehupenyu.
Dutumupengo idzva riri kutarisirwa iri ririkuuya apo rimwe rinonzi Hurricane Harvey risati ranyatsopera. Dutumupengo iri rakarova ku matunhu eTexas neLousiana.
Dutumupengo reIrma rakavhuvhuta muzvitsuwa zveBermuda, St. Martin neBritish Virgin Islands uye rinonziwo rakatouraya vanhu vasere.
Nyanzvi dzezvemamiriro ekunze dzinoti dziri kutarisirwa kusvika mu Florida nemusi weMugovera kana weSvondo. Vanhu vazhinji vanonzi vari kusiya misha yavo mu Florida vachienda kune dzimwe nzvimbo.
VaPromise Sande, chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chine mabhizimusi muguta reOrlando kuFlorida, vanoti vanhu vari mubishi rekugadzirira kuti vasavhiringwa nedutumupengo iri.
“Vari kuti ivo dutumupengo iri rinotarisirwa kusvika ku Miami, muno muFlorida, nemusi weSaturday rozosvikawo kunzvimbo dzakaita sanaOrlando, pamwe nemusi weSvondo."
Vanoenderera mberi vachiti, "Kutaura kwatirikuita izvozvi tinotori panguva yekumanya manya tichivhara dzimba nemapuranga aye anonzi ma’boards’ kuitira kuti dzimba dzisakuvadzwa zvakanyanya,” vaSande vakaudza Studio 7, vachipamidzirazve vachiti, “Chinowanzokuvadza nzimba panguva yedutumupengo idutu remhepo rinenge richipinda mumba richipwanya mahwindo.”
VaSande vakati zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri muFlorida zvakati wandei asi vanetarisiro yekuti zvinhu zvese zvichafamba hazvo zvakanaka.
Nhengo dzedare reZanu PF nhasi dzavhiringa musangano wekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvekuburitswa kwemashoko, dzichiti hapana nhengo yeMDC ichabvumidzwa kutungamira misangano yemakomiti kudzamara dzatambira VaEmmerson Mnangagwa semutungamiriri wenyika.
Komiti iyi yange ichifanira kunzwa kubva kune vaimbove makomishina eZimbabwe Media Commission pamusoro pebhiri reZimbabwe Media Commission iro rave kutozeiwa neparamende.
Sachigaro vekomiti iyi VaPrince Dubeko Sibanda veMDC vaudza Studio 7 kuti nhengo dzekomiti yavo kubva kuZanu PF dzaramba kuti vatungamire musangano pamwe nekuti musangano wacho uenderere mberi.
VaSibanda vati mangwana chaiwo vange vachifanira kuita musangano neveMedia Institute of Southern Africa-Zimbabwe pamusoro pekuvandudzwa kwemitemo yezvekufambiswa kwemashoko asi musangano uyu hauchaenderera mberi.
Vati vamisa misangano yese yekomiti iyi kudzamara vatungamiriri weparamende vagadzirisa zvinhu.
Imwe nhengo yekomiti iyi kubva kuZanu PF, VaWebster Shamu, vati nyaya yakonzera kuti musangano usanderere mberi inyaya yekuti nhengo dzeMDC hadzitambite hutungamiriri hwaVaMnangagwa.
Imwe nhengo yekomiti iyi, VaRegai Tsunga veMDC, vati makakatanwa aya ave kukanganisa basa reparamende uye nyaya iyi inofanira kugadziriswa.
Nhengo dzeZanu PF dzave nemasvondo maviri dzichivhiringidza misangano yemakomiti anotungamirirwa neMDC.
Nyanzvi yemutemo zvakare vachidzidzisa paUniversity of Zimbabwe muzvinafundo Lovemore Madhuku vati Zanu PF iri kukanganisa chose uye nhengo dzeZanu PF dzinofanira kurega paramende ichiita basa rayo.
Vati hapana chakaipa pane zvinoitwa nenhengo dzeparamende dzeMDC zvekubuda mudare kana VaMnangagwa vapinda kana kurega kupinda mudare kana varimo vachiti ndozvinotarisirwa kuitwa nebato rinopikisa.
Rimwe gweta, VaKudzayi Kadzere, vaudza Studio 7 kuti nhengo dzeZanu PF dziri kutotyora mutemo.

Nyanzvi inowona nezvezvirwere zvepfungwa Dr. Sekai Nhiwatiwa vanoti veruzhinji munyika havakoshese zvirwere zvepfungwa uye vanofungira kuti zvinokonzerwa nekuroyiwa kana mamhepo, votanga vaenda kuchivanhu kana kumaporofita vasati vaenda kuchipatara.
Izvi zvinonzi zviri kuita kuti dambudziko iri rirambe rechikura sezvo murwere achizononoka kuwana rubatsiro.
"Zvatiri kuwona ndezvekuti vazhinji vanotanga vaenda kuchivanhu kana kumachechi emweya vozowuya nemurwere wepfungwa zvinhu zvisisina kumira zvakanaka, asi isu tino kurudzira kuti murwere aendeswe kunachiremba nechimbi chimbi," vanodaro Dr Nhiwatiwa.
Zvipatara zvehurumende zvinofanirwa kunge zvichipa rubatsiro kuvarwere vepfungwa pachena asi nekuti zvinhu hazvina kumira zvakanaka panyaya yehupfumi hwenyika, dzimwe dzenguva varwere havasi kukwanisa kuwana mishonga yavo pachena izvo zviri kushungurudza mhuri dzakawanda.
"Tinobatikana nekuti kuwondoka kwaita zvinhu munyika kwakonzera kuti mimwe mishonga ishaikwe muzvipatara zvehurumende saka shuwiro yedu ndeyekuti mari inodirwa muzvirongwa zvekurapa vanorwara nepfungwa iwedzerwe," Dr. Nhiwatiwa vanodaro.
Dr. Nhiwatiwa vanoti zvirwere zvepfungwa zvinowanikwa muvana nemuvanhu vakuru asi zvakakosha kuti vanhu vasaseme vanorwara uye kuti vaphihwe rubatsiro pachiri nenguva muzvipatara kana kunaana chiremba.

"Dai vanhu vakakwanisa kuwunza avo vanenge vachiratidza kunge vave kubatwa nezvirwere zvepfungwa kuti tizeye navo nekuti pane dzimwe nguva pfungwa dzekuti munhu azvipfuudze dzinogona kushandurwa kana munhu uyu akawana rubatsiro pachiri nenguva," Dr Nhiwatiwa vanoudza Studio7.

Vabereki vevana vanoita matambudziko pakutamba nevamwe kana kuita zvinhu zvinotarisirwa pazera ravo kana kuti vane "autism" vanoti vatarisana nedambudziko guru pakuriritira vana ava.
Vanoti hupenyu hwavo hwakaomarara nepamusana pekuti vana vane autism havakwanisi kuita zvinhu zvinoitwa nevamwe vechidiki kana kushamwaridzana navo.
Baba Luke Pencil veku Malbereign muHarare vane mwana wavo ane makore gumi ane autism. Baba Pencil, avo vane makore makumi mana nematanhatu ekuberekwa vanoti dambudziko guru rinosangana nevabereki ava nderekushaya ruzivo pamusoro pe autism.
“Izvi hazvina kunge zvabatwa nana chiremba kunyange mwana akarwara kwenguva refu ndichienda kunana chiremba vakasiyana siyana nekunana mukoti vakasiyana siyana.” Vanoenderera mberi vachiti, “Pakashayikwa kana mumwechete akatibatsira chaizvo kuti mwana wenyu condition yake inonzi autism. Aiti akachema zvainzi ah, baba hamuzivi mwana anongochema, zvinoreva kuti haasi kunzwa zvakanaka kana kuti muri kumuitira zvaasingadi. Asi uchiedza kutsanangura kuti aiwa, mwana uyu pane zvaanoita zvandisinganzwisise zvakafanana nekuti dzimwe nguva anoramba kupfeka bhutsu, dzimwe nguva anoramba kugerwa musoro.”
Baba Pencil vanoti vabereki vakawanda vanokatyamadzwa nekugumbuka zvikuru pavanoona kuti mwana wavo ari kukura zvakasiyana nevamwe vana. Vanoti ivo vakaita mhanza yekukurumidza kuziva zvaiitika kumwana wavo.
“Vana ava vanenge vane ma censory issues anenge akavhiringika, haana kuita seevamwe vana. Saka kana achigerwa ane zvaanonzwa zvisinganzwiwi nevamwe vana vose saka achiita muitiro waanoita iwowo.” Vatiwo, “ Saka izvozvo ndizvo zvakaita kuti tinzwisise kuti ho mwana wedu condition yaaninayo inonzi autism. Izvozvo ndinoda kuti nditsinhire kuti izvi handina kuzviwana kunana chiremba kana kunana mukoti. Ndakatozvinzwawo kune mumwe mubereki akanga ari affected, akatoenda pa radio akanotaura. Ndopatazowana information yakadaro.”
Baba Pencil vanoti murume nemudzimai vanofanira kubatana kwete kunongedzerana kana mwana asangana nedambudziko.
“Saka izvozvo zvakatipa simba rekuti kuti mwana wedu aite zviri nani, tikwanise kumumaneja, regai tinorisecha.” Vatizve, “ Tikabva taenda pa internet. Iripo information pa internet. Ukaiwana zvinoita kuti umaneje mwana wako zviri nani. Zvinoita kuti kuwadzana kwako naye kuve kuri nani, kuwadzana kwake nenharaunda yakamukomberedza kuve nani.”
Amai Emma Muchefa avo vane mwana ane autism, vanoshandira hurumende vari pa Domboshava training centre. Vanoti madzimai mazhinji ane vana vane autism anoshungurudzika zvikuru.
“Vazhinji vana baba vanotiza, uye hama hadzizvitambiri. Kazhinji burden inosiyirwa amai, seni as a mother of three, two vari disabled murume akabva aenda ndikasara ndiri a single mother.” Amai Muchefa vatizve, “ Saka dambudziko rinenge rave rekuti unenge uchida kuenda kubasa, uri kuda ku physio nemwana iyeye, uri kuda zvekudya uri kuda zvekupfeka zvevana ivavo, uri kuda medication. Saka kazhinji kacho uri kuda zvekufambisa, hauna kana motor kana wheel-chair.”
Amai Tendai Kamutero veku Domboshava vane mwana wavo ane autism. Vakatozozviziva mwana uyu ave nemakore matatu kuti ndizvo zvaari.
Amai Kamutero vanoti kuriritira mwana uyu zvinovanetsa semunhu ari pamushando.
“Pandinoenda kubasa, munhu anosara naye haanzwisisi zvaanoda nekuti haatauri.” Vatizve, “Sign language haaizivi, haakwanisi ku communicator naye. Asi iye takatozomudzidza kuti kana ave nenzara kana chikafu chiri paanosvikira anotora ega. Kana kuti ukaona akukudhonza, isaini yekuti ane nzara.”
Amai Constance Mandishona vane vana vana, uye vaviri vavo vakaremara. Amai Mandishona, avo vanoshanda muhurumende vakapihwa imba yekugara kuMufakose mushure mekunge vakuru vavo vaona kutambura kwavaiita.
Vanoti vakaremara vanofanira kusimudzirana. “Ipapo ndisati ndapihwa imba ndakanga ndisina pfungwa dzekuti I can advocate kana kumiririrawo kana kutsigira munhu akaremara.”
Amai Mandishona vanoenderera mberi vachiti, “Ndakazogara pasi ndikazvibvunza kuti, hongu ndamiririrwa, ko vari kunze uko vasina anovamiririrawo tochiita sei? Nekuti inini pandakabatsirwa nemba, Permanent secretary mai Nhekairo vakandiudza kuti, Cony, dai vana vako wanga wakavachengetesa kumaraini, vachiita kunge musara pavana, I wasn’t going to assist you. But pese patinotaura unotungamidza vana vako kumberi kuti ma’am vangu vazodai nekuti hauna kunyara navo saka tazokudai. Ndakakwanisa kubatsira vamwe vabereki vairi. Mumwe wacho anonzi mai Boora anoshanda ku President’s department. Ane mwana wakewo ane autism. Ndikamuti akoma nyaya yangu yakamira yakadai, inini ndakawanawo imba. Imimi can you not write a letter mukwanisewo kuti mubatsirwe? Vakapihwa flat ku Ardbennie.”
Dr Cotilda Mangoma mugari wemuHarare uye vanofamba vachipa dzidziso pamusoro pe autism. Vanoti vabereki vevana vakadai vanofanira kushingaira kutsvaga ruzivo kuitira kuti vana vavo vave nepundutso.
“Inini ndiri kuona kuti zvakakosha kuve neruzivo mukati memhuri nemhaka yekuti chinhu chawave kuziva unoziva kuti unochibata sei, unochibata nemutoo upi.”
Dr Mangoma vanotizve, “Saka ini ndinoti vana baba nana mai vane vana vavasinganzwisisi kuti ingave autism here kana kwete zviri nani vatsvake rubatsiro kubva ku clinic level. Kana vabva ikoko voudzwa kuti enda ku rehabilitation. Rehabilitation yoferefeta kuti itype ipi ye autism, pamusana pekuti akasiyana siyana, akawanda. Nekuonekwa kunoita mwana, nemaitiro ake unobva waudzwa kuti aiwa ichi ndechakati, then rubatsiro rwobva rwauya. Angave anogona nezvemaoko, angave munhu ari bright kuchikoro, zvese zvinobatsirika along those lines.”
VaPardon Gonorashe mushandi wehurumende ane hunyanzvi hwekubatsira veruzhinji, kunyanya vanotambura kuti vave neraramo iri nani.
Vanoti vabereki vevana vane autism vanofanira kuve padyo nepavanowana ruzivo pamusoro pe autism.“Saka paida kuti patange pawanikwa centre yekuti vanhu vari kumaruwa, vangadai vari kuBinga, Muzarabani kana kuti kuMberengwa vakaona kuti vane vana vane autism they can refer vana ivavo kuno.” Vatizve,“Tikashevedza ma parents vari kumaruwa vanogona kuuya kuma campaign akaita seaya.”
VaGonorashe vanoti hurumende inofanira kuisa mari yakawanda gore rega rega kuzvirongwa zvakanangana ne autism.
“Hakuna zviri kunyanya kuitwa about disability as a whole.” Vatizve, “Then mukazopinda mudisability sector imomo munozoona kuti autism is relegated kuzasizasi kune other forms of disability. Saka ngatitorei disability sector se ine mari shoma mu budget. Then yapihwa mari shoma already, autism iri kuzasizasi zvekuti ikoko kunosvika one cent. Ndosaka kune vanhu vashomanana vari kutari nezve autism as a right.”
Sangano guru rezvehutano pasi rese reWorld Health Organisation rinoti pavanhu zana nemakumi matanhatu ega ega mumwechete wavo anenge aine autism.

Apo mabasa akasiyana siyana ari kuvhiringidzwa nechirwere cheCovid-19 pasi rose, mamwe murimi ari kuratidza huhurudza hwake nekurima achitengesa maruva nezvimwe zvirimwa kunyika dzekuEurope.  Kana munhu uchiri kure unogona kusanzwisisa kuti zvauri kuona mune mumwe munda uri papurazi reLingfield zvirimwa here, kana kuti imwe mhando yesora isinganyanyoziikanwi.
Asi ukazosvika pedyo unozoona kuti zvirimwa izvi maruva.  Purazi reLingfield riri makiromita makumi maviri kwakadziva kumabvazuva kweguta reGweru, uye papurazi apa panoitwa mabasa akawanda, kusanganisira kurima maruva nezvimwe zvirimwa zvakasiyana-siyana, pamwe nekupfuya mombe dzemukaka nedzenyama.  Purazi iri ndere mhuri yekwaKarimazondo, uye VaTatenda Karimazondo, ndivo mukuru wepapurazi iri.
VaKarimazondo vane makore makumi matatu nemapfumbamwe ekuberekwa uye vakadzidzira basa rehu chartered accountant. Vanoti vakaita shungu dzekumutsurudza kurima maruva kwaiitwa nevabereki vavo papurazi iri mumakore ekuma1990, nekuda kwekuziva kuti kuita izvi kunopa pundutso yakakura.  Pave nemakore anoda kusvika mana VaKarimazondo vamutsurudza zvekurima maruva papurazi reLingfield. Vanoti vanorima maruva zvichienderana nekuti vavanotengesera vanenge vachida maruva akaita sei.  Mukuru anoona nezvekurima paLingfield Farm, VaJaison Madyira, vanoti vanorima mhando shanu dzemaruva anokwanisa kurimwa panguva yemwaka wekupisa, uyewo vanorima imwe mhando yemaruva ine hupenyu hwakatirebei.
Vanogara vachiitawo ongororo yekuti ndeapi mamwe maruva angakwanise kurimwa papurazi apa.  Purazi reLingfield rinoendesa maruva anosvika matani maviri kuNetherlands pasvondo rega rega.
Maruva aya anotakurwa nerhori yakagadzirirwa kuita izvi pamwe chete nezvimwe zvirimwa zvakadai se peas, kuendeswa kunhandare yendege muHarare, uko zvose zvinozotakurwa kuendeswa kunze kwenyika.
Mumwaka wekutengesa maruva, purazi iri rinowana mari inodarika mazana mashanu ezviuru zvemadhora.
VaMadyira vanoti kunyuka kwakaita chirwere cheCovid-19 icho chinobva muhutachiwana hwecoronavirus, kwakambokanganisa zvikuru basa ravo.  Kunze kwekurima maruva, veLingfield Farm vanorimawo peas dzavanotengesa kunze kwenyika, vachiwana zvakare mari inodarika mazana mashanu ezviuru zvemadhora ekuAmerica.
VaMadyira vanoti vanorimawo zvichienderana nezvinodiwa nevavanotengesera.  Vanoti pakukohwa nekurongedza peas kuti dzizoendeswa kunze kwenyika panodiwa kutevedzera zvehutsanana zvakasimba.
Mumwe mudzimai wechidiki, Muzvare Magna Saidi, ndemumwe wevashandi vanodarika mazana mashanu vanoshanda papurazi iri vane basa rekuona kuti izvi zvatevedzerwa.
Kunyange hazvo vachifadzwa nebasa rekurima ravari kuita, VaKarimazondo vanoti kushaikwa kwemari munyika kunovhiringidza basa ravo.  VaKarimazondo vanochema-chemawo nenyaya yekuchinja-chinja mitemo kunoita hurumende, kunyanya munyaya dzezvehupfumi, vachiti panofanirwa kuve nemitemo inokurudzira varimi vanotengesa zvirimwa kunze kwenyika vakaita saivo.  Kurima maruva ndechimwe chezvinhu zvaiwanisa nyika mari yekunze kwenyika yakawanda zvikuru, uye Zimbabwe ndiyo yaitevera Kenya muAfrica mose pakutengesa maruva kunze kwenyika.

Zvizwarwa zveZimbabwe zviri muBotswana nhasi zvabatana nezvizvarwa zvenyika iyi mukupemberera makore makumi mashanu nematatu Botswana yawana kuzvitonga kuzere.
Botswana ndeimwe yenyika dzemuAfrica dzakazvipira mukubatsira Zimbabwe kuti isununguke.
Botswana yakawana kuzvitonga kubva kunyika yeBritain musi wa30 Gunyana 1966, muchiitiko charumbidzwa nevakawanda semukana wakaita kuti Zimbabwe ibatsirikane mukuwanawo kwayo kuzvitonga.
Zimbabwe, iyo yakanga iri pasiwo pehutongi hweBritain, ikazove pasi pehutongi hwamushakabvu, VaIan Douglas Smith mushure mekunge Rhodesia yazvipa rusununguko yega kubva kuBritain isati yadzokera zvakare mumaoko eBritain, inonzi yakawana rubatsiro rwakakosha zvikuru kubva kuBotswana kusvika iwane kuzvitonga kuzere musi wa18 Kubvumbi 1980.
Mutungamiri webato reMavambo/Kusile/Dawn, Doctor Simbarashe Makoni, vakagara muBotswana kwemakore gumi mushure mekudomwa semunyori wesangano reSADC mugore ra1983.
Doctor Makoni vaudza Studio7 kuti Botswana yaive nhengo hombe yechikwata chenyika dzaitsigira hondo dzerusunguko munyika dzinosanganisira Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Angola, Namibia neSouth Africa.
Doctor makoni vaenderera mberi vachiti Botswana yakapa zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvizhinji hupoteri pamuzinda wevapoteri weDukwi Refugee Camp, apo paichengetwa vanhu vaitiza hondo munyika.
Hukama pakati penyika mbiri idzi hunofadza ruzhinji rwevana veZimbabwe vanogara nekushanda muBotswana, izvo zvaita kuti vabatatane nezvizvarwa zveBotswana mukurangarira zuva iri.
Chimwe chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chinogara mudhorobha reFrancistown, VaPatson Mushayabasa, vaudza Studio7 kuti kugokedzana moto kwenyika mbiri idzi ndiko kuri kuita kuti zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvigamuchirike muBotswana.
VaChristopher Chingwanangwana, avo vanorarama nechamuka inyama mudhorobha reFrancistown, vati chikumbiro chavo chikuru ndechekuti Botswana iratidze zvakare chido chayakamboratidza munguva yehondo kuitira kuti ibatsire kubvisa Zimbabwe mumadhaka mairi nhasi mune zveupfumi.
Nyanzvi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika, VaNorman Mufandaedza, vati Botswana inyika yakabvira kare mukuchengeta zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvakanyanya zvichiyenzaniswa nedzimwe nyika.
VaMokgweetsi Masisi, mutungamiri wenyika iyi, vanga vari pakati pezvizvarwa zveBotswana zvaswera zvichipemberera zuva iri munhandare yeNational Stadium muguta guru renyika iyi reGaborone.
Murongi wemisangano muMDC, VaAmos Chibaya, vasungwa nemapurisa vachipomerwa mhosva yekutadza kumisa misangano yekuratidzira iyo yakarambidzwa nemapurisa.
Mutevedzeri wemutauriri weMDC, Va Luke Tamborinyoka, vanoti Va Chibaya vazvipira kumapurisa epa Harare Central Police Station apo vanzwa kuti mapurisa eku Gweru anga achivatsvaga.
Semurongi wemisangano yebato, VaChibaya ndivo vanga vari pamberi pekuronga kuratidzira kwebato ravo mumaguta mashanu anoti Harare, Bulawayo, Gweru, Masvingo neMutare.
VaChibaya vaenda kuHarare Central negweta ravo, Va Obey Shava.
Mapurisa akarambidza kuratidzira kweMDC mumaguta anoti Harare, Bulawayo, Gweru, Masvingo neMutare achishandisa chimwe chikamu chemutemo wePublic Order and Security Act.

VaChibaya vakasungwa zvakare muna Ndira vachipomerwa mhosva yekukurudzira vanhu kuti varatidzire zvichitevera kurudziro yakaitwa neZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions yekuti vanhu vasaende kumabasa kwemazuva matatu vachiratidza kusafara nekukwidzwa kwainge kwaitwa peturu nedhiziri.
Asi vanhu havana kugara mudzimba, izvo zvakaita kuti kuratidzira uku kuite mhirizhonga.
Vanhu vanodarika gumi nevanomwe vakapfurwa vakafa, uye sangano remagweta reZimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights rinoti vanhu makumi matanhatu nevasere vakarapwa maronda akakonzerwa nemabara epfuti, uye vamwe vanhu vanosvika mazana matanhatu vakarapwawo zvichitevera kukuvara kwavakaita mumhirizhonga iyi.
Kunyange hazvo Zimbabwe ichiverengwa pane dzimwe nyika dziri kukwanisa kurwisa HIV/Aids pamwe nekupa dzidziso pamusoro pekudzivirira zvirwere zvepabonde uye kuronga mhuri, vamwe vechidiki vanoti zvakaomera vakawanda vavo kuti vade kuongororwa ropa ravo, kurapwa zvirwere zvepabonde kana kutsvaga zvekudzivirira zvirwere izvi.
Izvi zvakabuda pamusangano weAdolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health Dialogue wakaitwa muBulawayo munguva pfupi yapfuura nesangano reCommunity Working Group on Health nevamwe vechidiki, wekuzeya kuongororwa ropa, kutsvaga ruzivo rwekuronga mhuri, pamwe nerwekuzvidzivirira kwevechidiki kubva kuzvirwere zvepabonde kwevechidiki.
Mumwe mukomana anoda kungoziikanwa nezita rekuti Everson, ndemumwe wevechidiki vari muBulawayo, vanodzidzisa vamwe vavo nezveHIV/AIDS, kuronga mhuri pamwe nekudzivirira zvirwere zvepabonde.
Everson anoti nyaya yekuti muzvipatara nemumakiriniki hamuna vanamukoti vakakwana ndeimwe inoita kuti vechidiki vakawanda vatadze kuongororwa ropa ravo, kutsvaga ruzivo rwekuronga mhuri pamwe nerwekuzvidzivirira kubva kuzvirwere zvepabonde.
Everson anotiwo vechidiki vanotya kubuda pachena panyaya dzine chekuita nezvepabonde nekuda kwekuti vanonyara kutaura nevanhu vanenge vari kumakiriniki kana dzimwe nzvimbo dzavanogona kuongororwa ropa ravo kana kuwana ruzivo rwekuronga mhuri pamwe nerwekuzvidzivirira kubva kuzvirwere zvepabonde.
Mumwe musikana wechidiki, Muzvare Natasha Shoko, vanobvumirana nemaonero aya vachiti vechidiki vanoona vana mukoti vakawanda sevanhu vanovasarura vasingakwanise kuvanzwisisa kunyanya panyaya dzine chekuita nezvedzidziso yekudzivirira zvirwere zvepabonde kana kuronga mhuri.
VaWatson Chiwambo ndemumwezve mukomana wechidiki anoitawo zvekudzidzisa vamwe vezera rake nezveHIV/AIDS.
VaChiwambo vanoti mutemo wekuti vechidiki vari pasi pemakore gumi nematanhatu havakwanise kuenda kuzvipatara kana makiriniki vari vega unokanganisa vechidiki munyaya dzekurwisa HIV/AIDS nzvimwe zvirwere zvepabonde uye kusimudzira ruzivo rwekuronga mhuri.
Mumwe wechidiki anoita zvekurwira kodzero dzevechidiki, Muzvare Bertha Nyoni, vanobvumawo kuti mutemo uyu unokanganisa vechidiki.
VaNhlanhla Moyo vanoshanda nesangano reYoung People’s Network mubazi reSexual and Reproductive Health.
VaNhlanhla vanoti kunyange hazvo chingave chokwadi kuti vechidiki vanosangana nematambudziko akawanda mukeudza kuwana ruzivo pamwe nekurapwa HIV/Aids nezvirwere zvepabonde uye kuronga mhuri, vanoti vechidiki vanofanirwa kuzvipira kuenda kunzvimbo dzinoita izvi.
Murongi wemabasa nesangano reCommunity Working Group on Health, VaMongi Khumalo, vanoti zvakakosha kuti veruzhinji, kunyanya vechidiki pachavo, vazeye nezvenyaya iyi senzira yekupedza matambudziko avanosngana nawo panyaya dzine chekuita nezvedzidziso yekudzivirira zvirwere zvepabonde kana kuronga mhuri.
Munguva pfupi yapfuura, sangano reUNAIDS rakaburitsa gwaro rinoratidza kuti vechidiki vemuZimbabwe, kunyanya vari pakati pemakore gumi nemashanu nemakumi maviri nemashanu havanyanyofarira kunogororwa ropa ravo.

Vakati kunyange zvichiratidza sechinhu chakaoma panofanirwa kuve nenhaurirano pakati pavo naVaMnangagwa.
VaChamisa vakati ivo semutungamiri vanogona kukurudzira veruzhinji kuti varatidzire uye izvi zvigobudirira asi panogona kuve nekudeuka kweropa izvo vakati hazvifanirwe kuitika, asi kuti pangove nenhaurirano dzekupedza makakatanwa ari pakati pavo naVaMnangagwa.
VaChamisa vakati rimwe dambudziko guru riri kudzorera nyika kumashure inyaya yehuwori . Vakabvuma kuti kune mamwe makanzura nevamiriri veparamende vebato vanobatwawo munyaya dzehuwori asi vakati vose vanoita izvi vachadzingwa mubato.

VaChitambara vakati munhu mumwe chete ari munyika akaisirwa parutivi mari inosvika maRTGS makumi mana nerimwe semari yekushandisa muhutano hwake kwegore rose.

VaChitambara vakati dzimwe nyika dzinnoisa parutivi mari inosvika zviuru zvitanhatu zvemadhora ekuAmereka pamunhu wega wega mubazi rezveutano semari yarinopihwa mubhajeti repagore.
VaChitambara vakati hurumende yakapa bazi rehutano mari inosvika mazana matanhatu nemakumi mapfumbamwe emamiriyoni emadhora emaRTGS.

Mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vashora vamwe vevaimbova varwi muhondo yerusununguko vachiti vave kukara masimba.
VaMugabe vakurudzira kuti vanhu vabatane mubato ravo reZanu PF iro raita zinyekenyeke. VaMugabe vataura mashoko aya pakuradzikwa kwegamba renyika Brigadier General James Murozvi.
Vachitaura neChitatu pamarinda anovigwa magamba enyika paHeroes Acre muHarare, VaMugabe vashora vamwe vevakarwa muhondo yerusununguko vachiti vave kuda masimba zvakanyanyisa vakakurudzira kuti vanhu vese vakaenda kuhondo, vashande pamwe chete kuitira kuti hupenyu hweveruzhinji husimukire.
Kunyange hazvo VaMugabe vasina wavadoma nezita, mashoko avo aya anouyawo apo vatungamiri vesangano reZimbabwe National Liberation War Veterans vakabvumirana kuti vachashanda zvakasimba kuti veruzhinji vasarudze mutungamiri wavanoda pasarudzo dzichaitwa gore rinouya.
Vatungamiri vesangano revakwarwa muhondo yerusununguko vanoti VaChristopher Mutsvangwa naVaDouglas Mahiya avo vakadzingwa muZanu PF ndevamwe vevanga vari pataurwa mashoko aya.
Zvichakadai, VaMugabe vakurudzira kuti vanhu vari mubato ravo reZanu PF vabatane sezvo mumusangano wavo mave kuitwa bvondawaponda matambiro ezvidhakwa nekuda kwezvikwata-zvikwata zvave mubato iri.
Mashoko aya anouya apo murongi wemisangano muZanu PF, VaSaviour Kasukuwere, vari kurongerwa kudzingwa pachinzvimbo chavo vachinzi vari kuronga zvekutorera VaMugabe masimba.
Nekune rumwe rutivi zvinonziwo pane chikwata chinotungamirirwa nemutevedzeri wemutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, chiri kuzvidaidza kuti Team Lacoste, icho chiri kukwidzana necheGeneration 40 kutora matomhu kubva kuna VaMugabe.

Dynamos yakafadza vateveri vayo mushure mekunge chikwata ichi chakadambura Caps United 2-0 pamberi pechaunga chaityisa muNational Sports Stadium nemusi weSvondo.
Vese vaive munhandare iyi vanobvuma kuti Dembare yaikodzera kutora mapoinzi ese matatu sezvo vaipotsera mabhora akasimba pagedhe reMakepekepe, panguva iyo maGreen Machine aitamba zvekuda kufadza veruzhinji panzvimbo yekuenda kumberi kunokanda zvibodzwa.

Izvi zviri kureva kuti Dynamos yatungamira Caps United 2-1 mumitambo mitatu yavatamba mwaka uno mushure mekurova MaGreen Machine mumukombe weIndependence Trophy, vabva mukukundwa mumakwikwi e ZNA Charity Shield.

Asi mutevedzeri wemurairidzi weCaps United, Fungai Kwashi, akati vari kurwadziwa zvikuru nekurohwa nechikwata icho vakavakidzana nacho muHarare kunyanya mumutambo weligi achitizve chibodzwa chechipiri cheDynamos chainge chisina kumira zvakaanaka.

Asi kutambura kweHighlanders kuri kuramba kupera mushure mekunge Bosso yakarohwa 1-0 pamusha payo neChapungu. Highlanders yadzikira zvekuti yave pachinhanho chechinomwe uyezve kure kure nekutora mukombe weligi uyu.

Murairidzi wemaWarriors Sunday Chidzambwa ashevedza mukamba vatambi vake vemutambo mukuru we 2019 Africa Cup of Nations neCongo Brazzaville.
Chikwata ichi chine vatambi vatsva vaviri Kelly Lunga uyo anotamira Rodighausen kuGermay na Admiral Muskwe anotambira Leicester City kuEngland asi hachina McCaulley Bonne uyo arikukanda zvibodzwa pamadiro kuchikwata chake cheLeyton Orient.
Bonne uyo akaberekerwa kuEngland haana kudaidzwa zvichinzi haana kutumira mapepa ake ekugadzirirwa pasipoti yemuZimbabwe mushure mekunge Lunga na Muskwe vakaita izvi pachiri nenguva.
Maneja we maWarriors VaWellington Mpandare vanoti Lunga na Muskwe vachatambidzwa mapasipoti avo musi wavanosvika muZimbabwe vachiwedzera ivo kuti gonhi harina kuvharwa kuna Bonne kana akatevera zvinodiwa.
Asi chikwata ichi hachina shanduko huru pane chinozivikanwa nevazhinji mushure mekunge Kowledge Musona, Khama Billiart, George Chigova, Tino Kadewere, Marvelous Nakamba, Tendai Darikwa, Danny Phiri, Alec Mudimu, na Evans Rusike vanzi vanofanira kuuya mukamba. VaMpandare vanotaura nezvevamwe vevatambi varikupinda mukamba.
Vamwe vevatambi vadanwa vanosanganisira Edmore Sibanda, Ronald Pfumbidzai, Kuda Mahachi, Knox Mtizwa, Talent Chawapihwa, Ovidy Karuru, na Teenage Hadebe.
Vamwewo vanotambira zvikwata zvemuno, Petros Mhari naGodkows Murwira, veFC Platinum, Richard Hachiro weHerentals, naLeeroy Mavhuga weYadah vapuhwawo mukana wekutambira chikwata chenyika ichi.
VaMpandare vanoti vane chivimbo chekuti vakomana ava vachabata basa nemazvo.
Munyori wemutambo wenhabvu VaTawanda Tafirenyika vari kugutsikanawo nechikwata ichi vachiti ivo vatambi ava vanobudirira nekuti vatamba vese kwenguva refu.
Chidzambwa pachake anoti parikuda kubatana kuti maWarriors abudirire kuenda kumafainari eAfcon kechina.
MaWarriors ari kungoda poindi imwe chete kubva pamutambo uyu kuti vaende kufainari eAfcon ayo achaitirwa kuEgypt muna Chikumi. Chidzambwa ndiye akaendesa maWarriors kumafainari avo ekutanga muna 2004.

Vamwe vagari vemuMasvingo nemusi weMvhuro vakaramba kutambira bhiri rekusora kana kuti Cyber Security and Data Protection, vachiti hurumende inogona kushandisa mutemo uyu kumbunyikidza vanopikisa pamwe nevatori venhau munyika uye kutyora kodzero dzavo dzekutaura vakasunungukua pamasai sai.  Vachitaura pamusangano waitwa paMucheke Hall, vamwe vagari vemuMasvingo, vati zvimwe zvikamu zvebhiri iri zvinogona kushandiswa kushungurdzwa vanhu vane pfungwa dzinopikisana nevanotonga izvo zvinoita kuti vanhu vasakwanise kutaura nhuna dzavo munyika pajekerere.
VaJeffrson Chitando, vanoti, bhiri iri richashandiswa kupenengura magwaro ne mashoko akavanzika evanhu uye harina chikamu chinodzivirira avo vanenge vafumura vakuru vakuru panyaya dzehuori.
Vamwewo vati bhiri iri rinogona kuzoshandiswa kusunga vezve matongerwe enyika pamwe nemasangano akazvimirira ayo anoongorora zviri kuitika munyika sezvo rine chikamu chekuti vanofambisa nhema pamasai sai vasungwe.  Sachigaro wesangano revatori venhau reMISA Zimbabwe, VaGolden Maunganidze, vatiwo bhiri iri rinogona kushandiswa kumbunyikidza kodzero dzevatori venhau uye kuti vasaite basa ravo vakasununguka.
Asi vamwe vatsigira bhiri iri vachiti rakanaka chaizvo nekuti vamwe vanhu munyika vari kushandisa madandemutande akaita seWhatsApp neTwitter zvisirizvo vachishoropodza hurumende pamwe nekuzvidza vamwe.
Vamwewo vanotiwo madandemutande ari kushandiswa kufumura zvakavanzika zvevanhu kunyanya nyaya dzerudo nekudaro nhubu dzinofanira kurangwa nekusungwa.
VaGashiya Mundondo, nhengo yeZanu PF, vanoti vanotsigira bhiri iri nekuti vazhinji vari kushandisa madandemutande akaita seWhatsapp, Twitter neFacebook kushoropodza hurumende.

Sangano ravanachiremba vanorwira kodzero dzevanhu reZimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights rinoti riri kushushikana zvikuru nekunonoka kuri kuita hurumende kugadzirisa gakava rayo navanachiremba, izvo zvasiya zvipatara zvehurumende zvisina vanachiremba kwemazuva anoda kusvika makumi mapfumbamwe.
Sangano iri rinoti kana hurumende yakasagadzirisa gakava iri navanachiremba vari kuramwa mabasa ava, hupenyu hwevanhu vakawanda hucharamba huri munjodzi, vanhu vakwanda vachifa.

Hurumende yakadzi vanachiremba vanodarika mazana mashanu mabasa mushure mekunge varamba kunomira pamberi pekomiti inoranga vashandi vanenge vatsautsira.
Mutungamiri wenyika akanga ati vanachiremba ava vadzokere kubasa mukati memazuva maviri vasina mhosva yavanopomerwa asi mazuva maviri aya atopfuura pasina vanachiremba vadzokera kumabasa.

"Pari zvino varwere vegomarara vari kunorapwa kuSouth Africa nekuIndia isu tine nyanzvi dzinokwanisa kurapa muno asi vasina michina inodiwa izvo zvinoshoresa pasi rose."

Mapiritsi ekudzivirira pamuviri aya anonwiwa mangwanani mushure mekunge munhu aita zvepabonde asina kuzvidzivirira nemakondomu.
Mapiritsi aya anonyanyozivikanwa nezita rekuti, “Morning after pill.”
Nyanzvi munyaya dzeHIV/AIDS, Amai Muchanyara Mukamuri, vanoti kunyanyoshandiswa kwema morning after pill kunongoratidza kuti vechidiki vari kuita zvepabonde vasina kuzvidzivirira.
Amai Mukamuri vanoti vechidiki vanonyanyotya kubata pamuviri pachinzvimbo chekuti vatye zvirwere zvepabonde zvakadai seHIV/AIDS.
Amai Mukamuri vanotiwo tsvakiridzo dzakaitwa dzinoratidza kuti kushandiswa kwakanyanya kwemapiritsi aya kunoita kuti vanhu vawedzere kusimba, kuita zvirwere zvakadai sema Ovarian Cysts nezvimwewo.
Chiremba vanoshanda nesangano re Zimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights, Doctor Nicholas Wazadza, vanotiwo pamusoro pekuwedzera kusimba, mapiritsi aya akaramba achinwiwa, haazokwanisi kudzivirira pamuviri.
VaWazadza vanotiwo vanoyambira vechidiki kuti kunwa mapiritsi aya hakudziviriri zvirwere zvepabonde.
Doctor Moses Macheka, avo vanoshanda neZimbabwe National Family Planning Council, vanoti vanhu havafanirwi kushandisa nzira iyi senzira yekuronga mhuri.
