Chirwere ichi, icho chakatanga kuChina gore rapera, chabata vanhu vanodarika mamiroyoni maviri nemazana mashanu nemakumi masere ezviuru pasi rose, uye kuuraya vanhu vanodarika zviuru zana nemakumi manomwe nezvisere.
Vanga vari mutungamiri wenyika kwemakore makumi matatu nemanomwe, VaRobert Mugabe, vazivisa mutauriri weparamende, VaJacob Mudenda, kuti vasiya basa.
VaMugabe vasiya basa zvichitevera kupindira kwakaita mauto svondo rapera nemusi weChipiri achiti kutonga kwavo kwakanga kovhiringa zvinhu zvakawanda.
Veruzhinji vakatsigira danho rakanga ratorwa nemauto, vakaungana muguta nemusi weSvondo vachiratidzira kusafarira kwavo VaMugabe.
Mauto akamboedza kunyengetedza VaMugabe kuti vasiye basa vega, asi vakaramba vakatsika madziro.
Kusiya basa kwavaita, VaMugabe vange vave kusungiswa neparamende pachishandiswa nzira ye impeachment.
Nzira iyi yazomiswa mushure mekunge VaMugabe vazivisa kuti vasiya basa kuburikidzwa netsamba yaverengwa naVaMudenda.
VaMugabe vacharangarirwa nevanhu vakawanda nenzira dzakasiyana siyana.
VaMugabe vakaberekwa kwaKutama munharaunda yekwaZvimba musi wa 21 Kukadzi 1924, semumwe wevana vashanu vamuchakabvu Bona naVaConstantine Gabriel Mugabe Matibiri. Mukuru mumhuri yavo anga ari Michael, achiteverwa na Raphael, kuchizouya Sabina, Bridget ari chigumisirwa.
Pavakanga vachiri mwana mudiki, baba vavo vaiita basa rekuveza, vakaenda kuBulawayo vachinotsvaga basa.
Mazuva iwayo kufamba rwendo rwakadaro kwaitora masvondo akati kuti zvikusei kumunhu aita mabasa emaoko anga asina upfumi hwakawanda.
Vari kuBulawayo, baba vaVaMugabe vakanoroora mumwe mudzimai wepiri ainzi Colleta, vakaita vana vatatu; Albert, David na Regina.
Munguva iyi, amai vaVaMugabe, avo vaive mudzidzisi, vakasara vachirera VaMugabe nevamwe vana vari vega. Vachiri vadiki, VaMugabe vaibatsira amai vavo nekufudza zvipfuwo zvemhuri pamwe nekuita tumari nemaricho.
Vanhu vatema vakawanda panguva iyi vaingodzidza kusvika pazvidzidzo zvisingapfuure dzidzo yepasi, kana kuti primary school education. VaMugabe pavakapedza zvidzidzo zvepasi, vakaenda kunoita zvidzidzo zvesekondari paKutama Mission, iyo yaiva pasi peMufundisi O’Hea, avo vakanga vakakurudzira VaMugabe kuti vaenderere mberi nedzidzo.
Vadzidzisi vaVaMugabe vakatanga kuona huchenjeri hwavo vakatanga kuvadaidza nerekuti ‘mukomana akachenjera’. Shamwari yavo vachikura, muchakabvu James Chikerema, vakambotsanangura VaMugabe semunhu akanga asingatane kuramwa chero pakutanga nevamwe uye ane mwoyo wakaoma zvekuti yanga isiri nyore kumubvisa pane zvaanenge achida kuita.
VaMugabe vakaenda ku Fort Hare University kumabvazuva kwe Cape Town, vakapedza zvidzidzo muna 1951 vakapihwa Bachelor of Arts Degree muzvidzidzo zvenhoroondo nechirungu.
Vapedza zvidzidzo zvavo kuSouth Africa, VaMugabe vakadzoka kumusha kunodzidzisa, asi vachienderera mberi nezvidzidzo panguva imwe cheteyo. Mumashure memakore maviri, vakange vave nedegree repiri panguva yavaidzidzisa paHope Fountain Mission pedyo neBulawayo.
Muna 1955 VaMugabe vakayenda kuZambia, ichanzi Northern Rhodesia, uko vakanodzidzisa kwemakore mana paChalimbana Training College vachidzidzira zvakare degree reEconomics vachizviita vari kumba, izvo vakapedza muna 1958.
Mushure memakore matatu, VaMugabe vakaenda ku Ghana uko vakanodzidzisa varairidzi paSt Mary’s. Uku ndiko kwavakasangana nemudzimai wavo wekutanga, Amai Satah Heyfron, vakazochata muna 1961.
Pavvakauya kuzoshanya kumusha mugore ra 1960 akaita mahwekwe nekuratidzira kwaive nemhirizhonga zvikuru sei kumisha yaigara vatema vachiti vaida magariro ari nani.
VaMugabe vakakumbirwa vakabvuma kutaura pane rimwe gungano revairatidzira vachitsanangura mamiriro ezvinhu ku Ghana uko kwakawanikwa kuzvitonga kuchikurudzirwa pfungwa dzegutsaruzhinji.
Mumasure memasvondo mashoma, VaMugabe vakasarudzwa kuita munyori anoona nezvekuburitswa nekufambiswa kwemashoko mubato re National Democratic Party.
Hurumende ye Rhodesia yakamisa kushanda kwebato iri mukupera kwa 1961, asi nhengo dzakaungana zvekare nezita idzva re Zimbabwe African People’s Union (ZAPU) richitungamirirwa naVaJoshua Mqabuko Nkomo, avo vaizivikanwa nezvekutungamira masangano evashandi.
Nekupindana kwenguva, VaMugabe nevamwe vanonzi vakatanga kuzvidza VaNkomo vachivapomera mhosva yekusada kuita mahwekwe nevachena vachisimbisa kuti vanoda kuti ‘munhu wese abvumidzwe kuvhota’ nevavariro yekusvika muhutongi hwevatema.
Muna 1963 VaMugabe nevamwe vavo vakaita pfungwa dzakasiyana vakatanga bato idzva re Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU) richitungamirirwa na Reverend Ndabaningi Sithole.
Mugore iroro, VaMugabe vakasungwa nemhosva yekukuchidzira mhirizhonga vakavharirwa kwemakore anopfuura gumi. Munguva iyi, VaMugabe vakaita zvakare zvidzidzo vari mujeri vakawana Bachelor of Law Degree.
Vakasungwa kudaro mugore ra 1974 VaMugabe vanonzi vakatungamira mukubviswa kwa Rev Ndabaningi Sithole semutungamiri we ZANU.
Mugore iroro, mutungamiri wehurumende ye Rhodesia, Va Ian Douglas Smith, vakabvumidza VaMugabe kuti vabuditswe mujere kuitira kuti vanopinda musangano ku Lusaka ku Zambia.
Pane kunanga kumusangano, VaMugabe vachibatsirwa na Ishe Rekayi Tangwena, vakaenda kuMozambique kunobatana neuto re ZANU rainzi ZANLA.
Bato reVaNkomo re ZAPU rakanga rine uto raro rainzi ZIPRA. Pakave nematanho ekubatanhidza mauto maviri aya pasi pe Zimbabwe People’s army mumashure mezvo pasi pe Patriotic Front.
Mapato aVaMugabe naVaNkomo arimu Patriotic Front akazoita hurukuro naVaSmith we Rhodesia dzekuunza kusununguka kweZimbabwe.
VaMugabe vakakunda musarudzo dzekuumba hurumende yekutanga yeveruzhinji muZimbabwe dzakazoitwa muna 1980.
Kubvira muna Ndira 1983 kwakaita hondo yekurwisa ma dissidents kuMatebeleland nekuMidlands. Hurumende ye ZANU-PF yakapomera vanhu vemumatunhu aya mhosva yekuchengeta ma dissidents.
Hondo iyi yakazivikanwa nezita nerekuti Gukurahundi. Vanhu vanofungidzirwa kusvika kuzviuru makumi maviri vanonzi vakaurayiwa ne5th Brigade.
Senzira yekumisa kurwisana, VaMugabe naVaNkomo vakanyorerana chibvumirano che Zimbabwe Unity Accord muna 1987, icho chakaona VaNkomo vachiitwa mumwe wevatevedzeri vaVaMugabe.
Chibvumirano ichi chakapedza kurwisana kwaitika pakati pehurumende neavo yaiiti ma dissidents.
VaMugabe vakarasikrwa nemudzimai wavo wekutanga, Aami Sally Hayfron Mugabe, avo vakashaya muna Ndira 1992 mushure mekunetseka kwenguva yakareba nechirwere cheitsvo.
Asi Amai Sally Mugabe vasati vashaya, VaMugabe vakanga vatoroora pachivanhu mukadzi wechipiri, Muzvare Grace Marufu, uyo akanga amboroorwa nemuuto, Stanley Goreraza.
Vana vaviri, Bona naRobert Junior vakaberekwa Amai Sally Mugabe vasati vashaya.
Kusazvibata kwaVaMugabe kwakakonzera dambudziko muchechi mavo vamwe vachiti havafanirwe kuchatiswa naGrace sezvo vaviri vakaita zvisingatambirwe neRoman Catholic.
Asi VaMugabe naGrace vakazochatiswa namushakabvu ArchBishop Patrick Chakaipa.
Makore maviri vachata naGrace, VaMugabe vakakonzeresa mutauro zvakare munyika apo vakatumira mauto kuDemocratic Republic of Congo, kuti anobatsira mutungamiri wenyika iyi, muchakabvu Laurent Kabila kuti asabviswe pachigaro zvechisimba. Izvi zvakaitwa dare reparamende risina ruzivo.
VaMugabe vanoshorwa nevakawanda kuti vakatadza kupindira zvichitevera kubuda kwemashoko ekuti vakuru vakuru mubato ravo, kusanganisira mukuru wemapurisa, VaAugustine Chihuri nevamwe, vakanyepa kukuvara kwavakaita muhondo, izvo zvakapa kuti vapihwe mari yakawandisa.
Munguva iyi, hurumende yakapawo vose vaimbova varwiri vehondo mari inoita zviuru makumi mashanu zvemadhora. Izvi zvakaitika muna Gumiguru 1997 mushure mekunge varwiri ava varatidzira.
Izvi zvakadhingura homwe yehurumende nekuti yainge isina kuiswa pabhajeti.
VaMugabe, avo vainge vagara vakatandavara zvavo munyaya dzematongerwo enyika, vakazoona kuti zvinhu zviri kuvaipira mushure mekunge bato reMDC raumbwa muna 1999.
Bato iri rakashanda zvakasimba mukuramba kutambira bumbiro idzva pareferendamu yakaitwa muna Kukadzi 2000.
Musarudzo dzakaitwa muna 2000, MDC yakapotsa yabvisa Zanu PF pachigaro chekutonga dai sarudzo idzi dzakaitwa pasina mhirizhonga zvikuru kumaruwa.
Sarudzo yemutungamiri wenyika yakazoitwa muna 2002, asi vakawanda vanobvumirana kuti VaMugabe vakakundwa musarudzo iyi naVaMugan Tsvangirai ve MDC.
Nyika dzekumavirira dzakabva dzaisa zvirango pahurumende yaVaMugabe nemakurukota avo.
Dzimwe sarudzo dzakasiya VaMugabe vazunzika dzakaitwa muna 2008, idzo dzakaona VaMugabe vachikundwa naVaTsvangirai, asi pakazoshandiswa mutemo wekuti VaTsvangirai vainge vasina kukunda zvinotambirwa nemutemo.
Sarudzo iyi yakadzokororwa, asi VaTsvangirai vakazobuda musarudzo iyi vachiti vatsigiri vavo vaipondwa nehurumende yeZanu PF.
Nyika dzemu Africa dzakazopindira pagakava remuZimbabwe, izvo zvakapa kuti paumbwe hurumende yemubatanidzwa iyo yakashanda kubva muna 2009 kusvika muna 2013.
Munguva iyi, VaMugabe ndivo vaive mutungamiri wenyika ane masimb akawandisa, VaTsvangirai vari mutungamiri wehurumende, asi masimba ari mashoma zvichienzaniswa neaVaMugabe.
VaMugabe naVaTsvangirai vakashanda vose kwemakore mashanu, asi hukama hwavo hwaiva husina kuti tsvikiti, VaTsvangirai vachiti VaMugabe vari kuramba kuzadzisa zvakanga zvawiriranwa pachibvumirano chaekuvaka hurumende chakakokerwa nevaimbove mutungamiri weSouth Africa, VaThabo Mbeki.
Musarudzo dzakaitwa muna 2013, VaMugabe nebato ravo vakakunda musarudzo inonzi yakabiridzirwa zvemhando yepamusoro soro kunyange hazvo Zanu PF ichiti yakakunda zvine mutsindo, uye zviri pachena.
Munguva yekutsvaga rutsigiro, VaMugabe nebato ravo vakavimbisa nyika kuti vachawanira vanhu mabasa matsva mamiriyoni maviri pasi pechirongwa cheZimAsset. Asi pakangotanga VaMugabe kutonga mushure mekukunda muna 2013, zvinhu zvakabva zvatanga kuipa, upfumi ndokuondomoka.
Makambani akatanga kuvhara vanhu vachirasikirwa nemabasa.
Kunetsana kwakatanga muZanu PF, zvikasiya mutevedzeri waVaMugabe muhurumende nemubato, Amai Joice Mujuru, vadzingwa zvose muhurumende nemubato.
Semunongedzo wekuti VaMugabe zvava kuvakunda, kurwisana muZanu PF kwakatanga kubuda pachena vanhu vachitukana vari pamberi paVaMugabe, ivo VaMugabe vasina zvavaitaura kana kutsiura.
VaMugabe vacharangarirwa kwenguva yakareba nepamusana pezvinhu zvavakaita, zvimwe zvakanaka, zvimwe zvakaipa:
Kutadza kugadzirisa gakava reGukurahundi vachiri vapenyu;
Kuparadzwa kwakaitwa hupfumi hwenyika vari pachigaro;
Kushaikwa kwemabasa munyika yaizivikanwa nenyaya yehupfumi;
Kumbunyikidza vanovapikisa;
Kusada kutsiurwa pavanenge vatadza;
Kuita humbimbindoga munyaya dzenyika;
Kune avo vakawana cheuviri kuburikidza nehutongi hwaVaMugabe:
Kupa vanhu mapurazi nehupfumi hwemupurazi pasina kana peni rawabvisa;
Kuwana hupfumi mumakambani kuburikidza nekushandiswa kwemitemo inotsigira kuendeswa kwehupfumi kuvatema;
Vana chiremba vapinda muzuva regumi neshanu vachiramwa mabasa vachiti zvichemo zvavo hazvisi kunzwikwa nehurumende.
Munyori mukuru wesangano ravanachiremba vanorwira kodzero dzevanhu, reZimbabwe Association of Doctors For Human Rights, Dr Evans Masitara, vanoti sangano ravo riri kushushikana zvikuru nezviri kuitika izvi vachiti hutano hwakanaka ndeimwe yekodzero dzevanhu vese saka varwere vanogona kuendesa hurumende kumatare edzimhosva nenyaya iyi.
Dr Masitara vati chimwe chinokonzera kuti zvichemo zvanachiremba zviite makore mazhinji zvisina kugadziriswa, inyaya yekuti vanhu vanoshanda mubazi rezvehutano, kusanganisira negurukota rezvehutano, VaDavid Parirenyatwa, vagarisa pabasa iri asi vane zvishoma zvavakagadzirisa.
“Pangapachida kuti panguva ino iyi, sezvo kuchitaurwa nezvemaitiro matsva, zvaidawo kuti mubazi redu reutano nemumaofisi nemumabhodhi edu muchimbounzwawo kufunga kutsva kwevanhu vanofunga zvakati siyanei. Mukatarisa munoona kuti kubva 1980, vanhu vakange varimumahofisi aya ndivo vanongorimo nanhasi.”
Studio7 haina kukwanisa kunzwa divi raVaParirenyatwa panyaya iyi.
Asi munyori mubazi rezvehutano, Dr Gerald Gwinji, vanoti hurumende iri kutaurirana navana chiremba uye panguva iyo nhaurirano dzinenge dzichiitwa, vana chiremba ava vanofanirwa kudzokera kumabasa.
Asi vana chiremba ava vanoti havasi kudzokera kubasa kudzamara hurumende yagadzirisa zvichemo zvavo.
Zvimwe zvezvichemo izvi zvinosanganisira mihoro ine chiremera, kusabvisiswa mitero pamotokari dzavanenge vatenga kunze kwenyika kuitira kuti vashandise kuenda nekudzoka kubasa, nezvimwe.
Muchikamu chedu chemumhanzi nhasi tirikutarisa nezvedambarefu idzva riri kuburitswa nemusi weChishanu nemuimbi weAfro-Fusion Ashton "Mbeu" Nyahora rinonzi Mhodzi Diaries 1.
Maneja waMhodzi Tribe Band VaEugene Museredza vanoti mabiko ekuparura dambarefu iri achaitirwa ku Theatre in the Park, Harare Gardens kutanga nenguva dzesere manheru.
Dambarefu idzva iri rine nziyo gumi uye rakatsikiswa kuMonolio Studios yaClive Mono Mukundu.
Nziyo dziripo dzinosanganisa Mhondi Yenguva, Matare, Kondo, Kafira Mberi, Ngoni, Baba Vedu, Dambudziko, Zambuko naAfrica. Tererai hurukuro yaVaMuzeredza naBlessing Zulu weStudio 7.
Hutungamiri hwesangano rinomirira vashandi reZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions, ZCTU, hunoti hwave kugara hwakabatira hura mumaoko zvichitevera kutambira kwahwakaita mashoko ekuhutyisidzira nerufu.
Mutungamiri weZCTU, VaPeter Mutasa, vaudza Studio7 kuti hutungamiri hwesangano ravo hwave kutyira hupenyu hwahwo zvichitevera kutambira kwavanoti hwakaita mashoko ekuvatyisidzira nerufu pamberi pemusangano mukuru wesangano ravo weGeneral Council uyo waitwa neChishanu manheru.
Aka kave kechipiri hutungamiri hweZCTU huchitumirwa mashoko ekutyisdzirwa nerufu gore rino.
Asi VaMutasa vati havasi kuzodzokera kumashurenemkumirira zvido zvevashandi avo vavanoti vari kunhonga svosve nemuromo.
Kunyange hazvo ZCTU ichiti yamhan’ara nyaya iyi kumapurisa, mutauriri wemapurisa, Assistant Commissioner Paul Nyathi, vati havakwanise kutaura nezvanyaya iyi sezvo isati yasvika munzeve dzavo.
VaMutasa vati vachazivisa munguva pfupi iri kutevera zvichabuda pamusangano wavo weGeneral Council uyo wanga uchiri kuitwa pataenda pamhepo kuti vashandi votora matanho api zvichitevera kuoma kuri kuramba kuchiita hupenyu kubudikidza nemari shoma dzavari kutambira nekukwira kuri kuita mitengo yezvinhu muzvitoro.
Zvichakadai, sangano rinomirira vadzidzisi vekumaruwa reAmalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, kana kuti ARTUZ, rinoti richatanga kuramwa mabasa neMuvhuro zsezvo richi mari iri kutambiriswa nhengo dzayo yakafanana nemutero wembwa.
Mutungamiri weARTUZ, VaObert Masaraure, vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyange hazvo hurumende yashevedzera musangano nevashandi vayo avo vari kumiririrwa neApex Council, nhengo dzesangano ravo dzichakanda mapadza pasi zvisinei nemusangano uyu.
Zvichakadai, mamwe masangano evadzidzisi anoti reProgressive Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, Zimbabwe Rural Teachers Union, Zimbabwe National Teachers Union nemamwe vanyorerawo hurumende vachizivisa kuti havasi kuzokwanisa kunyoresa vana bvunzo kana vasina kupihwa mari yakaringana nemadhora manomwe ekuAmerica ari maRTGS paawa imwechete paanenge achinyoresa bvunzo dzeGrade 7, Fomu 4 pamwe Fomu 6 idzo dzakatarisira kutanga kunyorwa svondo rinouya.
Hatina kukwanisa kutaura negurukota rinoona nezvedzidzo, VaPaul Mavhima, sezvo vati tigozovafonera kana vachinge vabuda mumusangano. Pataenda pamhepo VaMavhima vanga vasiri kudaira nharembozha yavo.
Dr John Elijah Chanakira avo vakave munyori mukuru wekutanga mubazi rezvedzidzo apo nyika yakawana kuzvitonga kuzere muna 1980 vashaya.
VaChanakira vakambovawo mumiriri weZimbabwe kuGermany uye vakamboitawo sachigaro weHarare City Council.
VaChanakira vanonzi vashaikira kuchipatara cheWest End muHarare mushure mekuita njodzi yemumugwagwa. Vanofungidzirwa kuti vakadhumwa nemunhu ainge asina chitupa chekutyaira motokari.
Vasiya vana vatatu vanoti Ngoni, Fadzo na Teurai. Mudzimai wavo, Amai Elizabeth Chanakira vakashaya nechirwere chegomarara muna 2010.
Zvikwata zviri pamusoro pegungano reCastle Lager Premier Soccer League zvatarisana nemitambo yakaoma mukupera kwesvondo.
Zvikwata zvitatu zviri kurwira mukombe weCastle Lager Premier Soccer League, FC Platinum, Caps United ne Highlanders zviri panguva yakaoma apo zviri kusangana kunze kwemusha nezvikwata zvakaomerwa mumakundano aya.
FC Platinum iyo iri kutungamira makundano ezvikwata gumi nezvitanhatu aya, yakananga kuRufaro Stadium uko irikusangana nechikwata chaMoses Chunga icho chine chinangwa chekupedza chiri pazvikwata zvisere zvinenge zviri pamusoro mukupera kwemwaka.
Chunga naNorman Mapeza uyo anorairidza Kugona Kunenge Kudada vakatamba vese muchikwata chemaWarriors asi vanga vasati vawana mukana wekuratidzana masimba avo muhurairidzi.
Aimbotambira chikwata cheCaps United Charles Manjera anoti mutambo uyu wakabaka moto zvekuti wakaoma kudoma chikwata chinokunda.
Manjera anoti semaonero ake mutambo uyu unoita mangange. Asi chikwata chakanyanyoomerwa nemutambo iCaps United. Makepekepe, iyo yakasiiwa nepoindi imwechete neFC Platinum yakananga kuBeitbridge uko irikusangana neBorder Strikers.
Border Strikers ndiyo iri pasi pasi mumakundano aya asi zvikwata zviri kurwira hupenyu hwazvo zvinonetsa kukunda.
Border Strikers ine murairidzi mutsva Luke Masomere uyo asati akunda mumitambo miviri iyo atamba zvekuti arikutarisira kukunda mumutambo wake wekutanga pamusha muDubulavadzimu Stadium.
Muongorori wezvemutambo wenhabvu VaSilas Mukonoweshuro vanoti Caps United innge yaita raki ikakwanisa kudzoka nepoindi kuBorder.
Highlanders irikubudawo muBulawayo asi yakananga padyo nepamba muGweru umo iri kutamba neChapungu muAscot Stadium.
Panowanzotamba zvikwata izvi zvinowanzoita mangange asi kwete ikozvino apo Highlanders yakatarisana nemukombe, Chapungu yacho ichirwira kuramba iri muPremier League.

Cricket
Zvichakadaro, aimbove kaputeni wechikwata chenyika cheZimbabwe Heath Streak ndiye adomwa kuita murairidzi mutsva wechikwata chenyika checricket chemaChevrons.
Mashoko ari kufamba asina kutsinhirwa ari kuti Streak akapihwa basa iri neChishanu mushure mekutambura kwechikwata chenyika kwenguva yakareba.
Streak uyo aimbove mutungamiri wevatambi anoziva vatambi vemuno uyezve nematambiro avo zvekuti anokwanisa kusimudzira matambiro echikwata ichi.
Streak anobva abatana naTatenda Taibu uyo akambotamba naye muhurongwa hwevarairidzi muchikwata ichi.
Taibu achangopihwa basa rehumaneja. Streak ndiye anofungidzirwa kuti akakunda vamwe vaidawp basa iri vanoti Andy Blignaut, Peter Kirsten uye Justine Summons. Izvi zvinotevera kudzingwa basa kwaDav Whatmore muna Chikumi.
Mutungamiriri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vadzinga basa vanga vari gurukota rinoona nezvemando dzemoto, VaFortune Chasi, vachiti havasi kuita basa ravo sezvavanga vachitarisira.
Mumagwaro abudiswa nemunyori mukuru mudare remakurukota, Doctor Misheck Sibanda, VaMnangagwa vati vamisa VaChasi basa nekuti vange vasisiri kubata basa ravo sezvinotarisirwa nehurumende.
VaMnangagwa vadoma mumiriri weMuzarabani North mudare reparamende, VaSoda Zhemu, segurukota idzva rezvemhando dzemoto.
Kudzingwa basa kwaVaChasi kunoteverawo kumbomiswa basa kwakaitwa sachigaro webhodhi reZESA, VaSydney Gata, pamwe nenhengo dzese dzebhodhi reZesa vachipomerwa nyaya dzehuori.
Pavakabvisa bhodhi reZesa, VaMnangagwa vakati komishini inoona nezvehuori iongorore nyaya dzehuori mukambani yeZesa.
Panga paine kutatsurana pakati paVaGata naVaChasi. VaChasi vakambenge vambomisa VaGata basa avo vakaramba kutambira izvi vachiti mutungamiriri wenyika akavadoma pabasa iri, ndivo voga vaigona kuvamisa basa.
Nyanzvi mune zvehupfumi vachishanda vakazvimirira, VaMasimba Kuchera, vati vakatyamadzwa nekumiswa basa kwaVaChasi vachiti vange vachivaona semunhu anga ari kugona basa.
Vatiwo vanoona sekuti VaChasi vagurisirwa panzira basa rekuedza kugadzirisa huori kukambani yeZESA.
Mumwe mutori wenhau webepa repadandemutande reZimbabwe Morning Post, Elias Mambo, uyo akanyora nyaya dzakawanda dzehuori kukambani yeZESA, atiwo anoona sekuti hurumende yarasikirwa nekumisa VaChasi basa.
Mambo ati kunetsana kwaVaChasi naVaGata munyaya yekuedza kupedza huori kunogona kuve kwakonzera kumiswa kwavo basa.
Vamwewo pamadandemutande akasiyana siyana vatiwo havanzwisisi kuti sei VaChasi vamiswa basa vachiti zvinhu zvange zvave nani munyaya dzekuwanikwa kwemagetsi kwemagetsi munyika.
Asi mumwe muongorori wezvematongerwo enyika, VaJoy Mabhenge, vaudza Studio7 kuti kunyange hazvo zvisina kujeka mumagwaro ehurumende kuti sei VaChasi vamiswa basa, vati kana zviine chekuita nekurwisa huori hapana chakaipa.

Mutungamiri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vaparura neMugovera mashoko ezuva rekubatana kwevanhu munyika, kana kuti Unity Day, iro rinocherechedzwa musi wa 22 Zvita.
Vachitaura kumuzinda wavo weState House, VaMnangagwa vati imba ine kurwisana inowondomoka vachitiwo pose panopera sarudzo panoda kuti paitwe sungawirirano kuitira kuti nyika ifambire mberi.
Zuva reUnity Day iri rakauya mushure mekunyoreranwa kwechibvumirano cherunyararo kana kuti Unity Accord pakati peZanu-PF nePF Zapu musi wa 22 Zvita 1987.
Vakanyorerana chibvumirano ichi ndimuchakabvu VaRobert Mugabe namuchakabvu Doctor Joshua Nkomo.

Gweta riri kumirira Va Musonza, Va Kudzai Choga, vanoti VaMusonza vachamiswa pamberi pedare neMugovera kuChinhoyi kwekare.
MDC inotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa inoti iri kuenderera mberi nehurongwa hwayo hwekuratidzira nemusi weChishanu, kunyange hazvo isati yanzwa kubva kumapurisa.
MDC yakazivisa mapurisa svondo rapera kuti ichapinda mukuratidzira uku sezvinodiwa nemitemo yenyika.
Asi bato iri rinoti kusapindura kwemapurisa hakusi kuzotadzisa hurongwa hwekuratidzira uhu, sezvo bumbiro remitemo yenyika ichiripa kodzero yekuratidzira.
MDC inoti iri kuratidzira sezvo isiri kufara nehutongi hwemutungamiri weZanu PF, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, avo bato iri rinoti haricherechedzi kusarudzwa kwavakaitwa gore rapera.
Sangano rinoona nezvesarudzo munyika, reZimbabwe Electoral Commission, rakazivisa gore rapera kuti VaMnangagwa ndivo vakanga vakunda musarudzo yemutungamiri wenyika.
Asi MDC yakapikisa izvi mudare reConstitutional Court, iro rakapa mutongo waitambira zvakanga zvaziviswa musarudzo dzegore rapera nasachigaro weZimbabwe Electoral Commission, Amai Priscilla Chigumba.

VaPompeo vati Cuba inoda kuita mari ichishandisa chirwere che coronavirus. Kubva nechakare, nyika yeCuba yagara ichitumira vanachiremba vayo kunobatsira nyika dzakasiyanasiyana, kunyanya kunyika dzichiri kubudirira. Asi vaPompeo vanoti vanachiremba ava vanopiwa mihoro mishoma pamari dzavanofanirwa kupiwa, vachiti hurumende yeCuba inovatorera mari yavo. VaPompeo varumbidza nyika dzeBrazil, Ecuador neBolivia vachiti dzakaramba kutambira vanachiremba vekuCuba nekuti nyika idzi dzinoona kuti zvirikuitwa nehurumende ye Cuba hazvina kunaka. VaPompeo vatizve hurumende dzinoshandisa vanachiremba veku Cuba dzinofanirwa kubhadhara vanachiremba ava pachavo, vachiti hurumende yeCuba inovapa mari shomanana pane inenge yabhadharwa nenyika dzavanenge vanzi vashandire. VaPompeo vati hurumende yeCuba irikushandisa vanachiremba vayo kuti vaiwanire mari panguva nyika dzose dzakatarisana nedambudziko recoronavirus. Vagari vemuMbare vanoti chinonyanyorwadza ndechekuti musikana uyu ange akabuda zvinofadza pabvunzo dzake dzeGrade 7 aine 4 units uye kunyange hazvo kanzuru yeHarare yati iri kuongorora kuti chii chakanzozera kufa kwake, vagari vemunzvimbo iyi vati kubuda kwemasiweji achierera mudzimba dzavo ndiko kwakonzera kufa kwemwana uyu.
Vagari vakawanda mumigwagwa inoti 8th na 9th vaudza Studio 7 kuti kanzuru yeHarare yange isiri kuterera zvichemo zvavo zvekuti vazogadzira mapaipi emasewage akaputika uye vanhu vakawanda munzvimbo iyi vakatoendeswa kuchipatara vachirwara nemanyoka.
Mumwe mugari wemuna 9th uyo asina kuda kudomwa nezita audza Studio 7 kuti kufa kwemwana uyu kwarwadza vanhu vakawanda.
Ambuya Anne Marry Karimushanje vanoti mumusha weMbare maita dambudziko guru remasuweji ari kupitika mudzimba zvekutoti vave kutyira kuti vana vakawanda vachafa nezvirwere zvemanyoka.
Tinashe Karise uyo ane tuckshop yake munzvimbo iyi audza Studio 7 kuti seweji iri kuerera pese yave kukanganisa bhizimisi rake uye nhunzi dzave kuzara mutuckshop make.
Mugwaro ravaburitsa kuvatori venhau, mutauriri weHarare City Council, VaMichael Chideme, vati kanzuru iri kuongorora rufu rwemwana uyu uye vatsinhirawo kuti hanzvidzi yake pamwe nevamwe vanhu vane chitsama kubva munzvimbo iyi vari muchipatara uye vari kufungidzirwa kuti vane typhoid.
Vatiwo pane vanhu makumi matatu kubva munzvimbo iyi vakatorapwa sezvo vaifunguidzirwa kuti vane typhoid.
Mukuru anoona nezvehutano mukanzuru yeHarare, Dr Proper Chonzi, vaudza Studio 7 kuti mufi ange achiratidzika kunge ane typhoid asi kanzuru haisati yave nehumbowo hwekuti ange aine typhoid here kana kuti kwete.
Dr Chonzi vati zvinokonzera typhoid zvinozikanwa uye kanzuru iri kuedza napose painogona napo kugadzirisa nyaya dzekutakurwa kwemarara nemasiweji senzira yekudzivirira chirwere ichi.
VaChideme vatiwo kanzuru yatanga chirongwa chekudzidzisa vanhu pamusoro pezvirwere zvetyphoid necholera pamwe nekukosha kwehutsanana.
Kanzuru yeHarare yakazivisa muna Mbudzi kuti yakatarisira kuti zvirwere zvemanyoka zvichawanda panotanga kunaya mvura uye yakati vese vanenge vachirwara nezvirwere izvi vacharapwa pachena.
Bazi reCentres for Disease Control rinoona nezvehutano muAmerica rinoti kudzivirira chirwere chetyphoid vanhu vanofanira kubhoirisa chikafu kana mvura, kubika chikafu, kuchimenya kana kutorega kudya muchirungu, “Boil it, cook it, peel it or forget it.”
Dare ramejisitireti muHarare rarasa chikumbiro chamuzvinabhimisisi ane mutauro mukuru munyika, VaDelish Nguwaya, chekuti vatongwe vachibva kumba kwavo panyaya mbiri dzavari kupomerwa.
VaNguwaya vari kupomerwa mhosva dzekukorovhera hurumende kuti ipinde muchibvumirano chekutenga mishonga kubva kumbani yekunze yavanomirira muZimbabwe, yeDrax Consult SAGL.
Mutongi wedare, Amai Vongai Muchuchuti, vati VaNguwaya vadzoke kudare musi wa 30 Chikumi, asi pose apa vanenge vari mutirongo.
Amai Muchuchuti vati vanobvumirana nevachuchusi panyaya iyi kuti kana VaNguwaya vakabhadhara mari yechibatiso vanogona kuvhiringidza kuferefetwa kwenyaya iyi uye vanogona kutiza munyika sezvo mhaka yavakapara yakakura chose.
Vatiwo vamwe vavanonzi vakapara navo mhosva iyi vari kunze kwenyika.
VaNguwaya vanonzi vakapara mhosva iyi pamwe nemuridzi wekambani yeDrax Consult, LIir Dedja, uyo anonzi ari kuItaly kana kuti kuti Hungary.
Rimwe remagweta aVaNguwaya, VaTafadzwa Hungwe, vanoti dare raona VaNguwaya semunhu asingavimbike sezvo vakomboita dzimwe nyaya dzekukorovhera vanhu nguva yapfuura.
Vatiwo havana kufara nemutongo wedare uye vanovimba kuti dare repamusoro richave nemuono wakasiyana panyaya.
VaNguwaya, avo vanomirira kambani yeDrax Consult SAGL neDrax International, vakusungwa nemusi weChishanu chapfuura vachipomerwa mhosva yekutsotsa kambani yehurumende inoita zvekutenga mishonga yeNatpharm kuita chibvumirano chekutenga mishonga kukambani yavanomirira inokosha mamiriyoni makumi matanhatu emadhora ekuAmerica.
Vachuchusi panyaya iyi vanoti VaNguwaya vakanyepa kuti kambani iyi inogadzira mishonga izvo zvakaita kuti mapazi ehutano, nebazi remari ape NatPharm mvumo yekushanda neDrax.
Asi VaNguwaya vari kuramba mhosva dzavari kupomerwa.
Magweta avo anoti ivo semumiriri weDrax havana chavakatadza uye vachatura kudare humbowo hunoratidza kuti Dejda uyo akatombuuya munyika akaonana nemutungamiriri wenyika, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa, ndiye ainyora nekusaina matsamba ekutsvaga basa rekutengesa mushonga kubazi rezvehutano.
Magweta aya anotiwo ane humbowo hunoratidza kuti Drax yakapihwa basa kuNatpharm mushure mekunge bazi rezvemari raita ongororo rikaona kuti kambani iyi yainge yakachena.
VaHungwe vanoti kunyange VaNguwaya vaive ivo vaisaina matsamba ekutsvaga basa kubazi rezvehutano, hapana nhema dzakataurwa mutsamba idzi nekuti kambani yeDrax inoita mabasa akawanda kusanganisira kutengesa mishonga.
Vatiwo pachibvumirano cheDrax neNatpharm, Drax yakabuda pachena kuti mishonga yainotengesa yaiiwana kupi uye hapana kana nhema dzakataurwa muchibvumirano ichi.
Mutitikitiva ari kuita nyaya iyi akaudza dare kuti vakatanga kuferefeta nyaya iyi mushure mekunge bazi rezvehutano, raratidza kusafara nechibvumirano cheDrax neNatpharm.
Asi magweta aVaNguwaya anoti vane humbowo hunoratidza kuti mapurisa emuno akatanga kufererfeta nyaya iyi mushure mekunge sangano remapurisa pasi rese reInterpol ranyorera kuZimbabwe Republic Police richida rubatsiro pakuongorora kuti mamiriyoni maviri emadhora ekuAmerica aiinge aiswa mubhanga reDrax kuHungary yainge iri yei.
Interpol yaifungidzira kuti paive nekusafambiswa kwemari zvakanaka kana kuti money laundering sezvo Drax isina basa rayaiita raizikanwa kuti iwane mari yakawanda kudai.
Mushure maizvozvo hurumende yakabva yamisa chibvumirano cheDrax neNatpharm.
Svondo rapfuura mapurisa akabvunzurudza vakuru vakuru kuNatpharm, bazi rezvehutano pamwe nebazi rezvemari uye vazhinji vavo vanotarisira kupa humbowo kana kusungwa nekuda kwenyaya iyi.
VaNguwaya vakabuda mumifananidzo yakawanda vaine mudzimai wemutungamiri wenyika, Amai Auxilia Mnangagwa, pamwe nevana vaVaMnangagwa, Shaun na Collins.
Mifananidzo iyi yakakonzera mitauro yakawanda mu social media vamwe vachiti zvose zviri kuitwa naVaNguwaya, vari kutsigirwa nemhuri yemutungamiri wenyika.

Shasha yetsiva pasi rose Muhammad Ali akashaya nemusi weChishanu mushure mekurwara kwenguva yakareba.
Ali uyo ainge aine chirwere chekukanganwa kana kuti Parkinson's disease akashaya ave nemakore makumi manomwe nemana.
Izvi zvinotevera kuendeswa kwake mazuva mashoma apfuura kuchipatara che Phoenix, Arizona mushure mekutadza kufema zvakanaka.
Chirwere ichi chinonzi navanachiremba chinogona kunge chakakonzerwa nezvibhakera zvairohwa Ali mumusoro mumutambo wetsiva.
Mutungamiri wenyika yeAmerica VaBarack Obama vati Ali ndiye ainge ari mutambi wetsiva akadarika vamwe vose uye hapana kana mubvunzo. VaObama vati Ali akaita kuti pasi rose ritinhire nekugona kwake tsiva.
Vaenderera mberi vachiti Ali akarwa zvine nhoroondo apo airwisana nechirwere cheParkinson's ichi. VaObama varumbidzawo Ali uyo vati ainge aine chipo chekutaura.
VeSports Illustrated vanonyora zvemitambo vakati Ali ndiye mutambi akashura mare mumakore ose zana ekuma 1900 kana kuti 20the century.
Zita rake rekuberekwa rinonzi Cassius Marcellus Clay Jr iro akazochinya muna 1964 ave kushandisa rekuti Muhammad Ali zvichienderana nechitendero chake chechi Muslim.
Ali akava mumwe ane mukurumbira zvakanyanya muAmerica kubuda muchitendero chechiKristu achienda kuchitendero chechiMuslim ichi.
Ali aivewo nehushamwari hwakasimba nemutauriri we sangano reNation of Islam Malcolm X. Kudyidzana kwaAli neveNation of Islam hakwaifarirwa nevamwe vachena asi izvi hazvina kumusvibisa moyo.
Muna 1967, Ali akaramba kuenda kuhondo yeku Vietnam achiti chitendero chake chitsva hachaimutendera kuti ayende kuhondo. Izvi zvakapa kuti asungwe kuHuston, Texas sezvo paisungirwa kuti varume vose vezera rake vaende kuhondo.
Ali akapedza makore akawanda achitongwa kusvika dare repamusor soro muAmerica reSupreme Court ramuchenura.
Muhammad Ali akarwa mitambo ine nhoroondo kusanganisa wainzi "Rumble in the Jungle" apo akarwa neGeorge Foreman muna 1974 kuZaire (DRC).
Pamutambo uyu Ali ainyebera hake kunge aneta achisiya Foreman achipedza simba nekukanda zvibhakera. Asi Ali akazomuka chibhembenenga ndokurova Foreman.
Muna 1975, Ali akarwawo naFrazier kuPhilippines pamutambo wainzi "Thriller in Manila". Ali akazorova Frazier mushure memarounds gumi nemana.
Don King uyo aishambadzira mitambo yetsiva yaAli ati Ali saMartin Luther King haafe akakanganwikwa uye rufu harungaite kuti vanhu vakanganwe nhoroondo yake.
Ali ari kuchemerwa kunzvimbo yaakaberekerwa yeLouisville, Kentucky. Mireza yemunzvimbo iyi yaderedzwa semunongedzo wekuchema gamba.
Ali akatora menduru yeWorld Heavyweight aine makore makumi maviri nemaviri ekuberekwa.

Amai Sikaka vanotiwo kunyange hazvo mapiritsi aya achiwanikwa muzvitoro zvemapiritsi, havakwanisi kuatenga sezvo achidhura kwavari sezvo vari kutotambura kuwana mari yekuti vararame zuva nezuva.

Izvi zvinotevera kugadzwa muna 2016, kwa VaChen Quanguo, senhengo yedare rePolitburo, pamusoro pekuve kwavo munyori mukuru webato re Communist Party mudunhu rinofanirwa kuzvitonga re Xinjiang Uyghur, uko vari mukuru zvekare we masangano ari pasi pehurumende yeChina.
Kubva pavakasvika, VaChen Quanguo, vakatanga kusora vanhu, kuvavharira muhusungwa pamwe nekuvamanikidza kudzidza gwara rebato riri kutonga.
Zvese izvi vaizviita vakanyanya kunangana nevanhu verudzi rwechi Uyghur nevatendi vemakereki madiki.
Panguva ino, mazana nemazana evanhu vechiUyghur, vechiKyrgyz nevechitendero chechi Moslem vari muhusungwa pamusoro pezvinhu zvisina maturo, zvakaita sekuregera ndebvu dzichikura, kana kuramba kunwa hwahwa.
Hurumende yaVaDonald Trump muAmerica yakazvipira kuchengetedza kodzero dzevanhu kwese kwese.
Nepamusana pekushungurudzwa vanhu kuri kuitwa uku, mapazi eAmerica anoona nezvemari, pamwe nerezvekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika, akatemera zvirangopavakuru vanoona nezvekugadzikana mudunhu iri, VaChen Quanguo naVaWang Mingshan; mumwe wevakuru vebato muXinjiang, VaZhu Hailun; vaimbove mumwe wevakuru vaiona nezvekuchengetedzwa kwedunhu, VaHuo Liujun; vaimbove munyori webato mudunhu iri, VaSun Jinlong; uye nevaimbove mutevedzeri wemunyori mudunhu iri, VaPeng Jiarui.
Bazi rezvemari muAmerica rakatemeravo zvirango pamakambani ehurumende paishandwa nevanhu ava, zvinoreva kuti havachabvumidzwa kupinda muAmerica uye mari dzemakambani aya dziri muAmerica, pamwe nenyika dzinodyidzana neAmerica, hadzichakwanisi kutorwa kana kushandiswa.

Muzvare Mainato vanoti hurumende inofanirwa kubatsira vanorarama nehusope nekuvapa mukana wekuunza munyika mishonga nemagirazi anoshandiswa nevanorarama nehusope.
Muzvare Mainato vanoti matambudziko anosangana nevanorarama nehusope anosanganisira kusemwa munzvimbo dzavanogara nekuzvikoro kwavanodzidza.
Muzvare Mainato vanoti vakatosiyana nemurume wavo mushure mekunge hama dzavo dzakatyamadzwa nekuti vakange vane vana vaviri vanorarama nehusope.
"Munzvimbo dzataigara taigarosemwa uye vamwe vaitoti tisabudise vana panze kana pane vaenzi sezvo vari masope. Asi izvi zvinofanirwa kumiswa sezvo mwana ari mwana zvisineyi nekuti akaita seyi," Muzvare Mainato vaudza Studio7.
Amnesty International svondo yapfuura yakaparura gwaro rinoshora kutyorwa kwekodzero dzevanorarama nehusope muSouthern Africa kunyanya kuMalawi neTanzania uko vanhu vari kuurayiwa vachitorwa mitezo yavo kuti ishandiswe pane zvemishonga.

"Zvakakosha kuti kodzero dzevanorarama nehusope dzichengetedzwe uye tinoshora zvikuru zviri kuitika kuMalawi ne Tanzinia uko vanhu vari kuurayiwa vachitorerwa mitezo inoshandiswa mune zvemishonga, kunyangwe dambudziko iri tisati tariwona muZimbabwe, kodzero dzevanorarama nehusope munyika dzinofanirwa kuremekedzwa," VaMawanza vaudza Studio7.

Bazi reZimbabwe National Statistics Agency, kana kuti ZIMSTATS, rinoti mitengo yezvinhu kana kuti consumer inflation mumwedzi mitatu yapfuura iri kukwira hayo asi kwete zvakanyanyisa sezvayange ichimboita.
Asi dzimwe nyanzvi munyaya dzezvehupfumi dzinoti izvi hazvina hazvo zvakanyanya zvazvinoreva nekuti hupfumi hwenyika hwananga kumawere.
Muna Chikumi, mutengo wezvinhu kana kuti consumer inflation wainge wasvika pazvikamu makumi matatu nemapfumbamwe nezviga zvitatu kubva muzana kana kuti 39.3%.
Mumwedzi waChikunguru wakange wave pazvikamu gumi nezvisere nechiga chimwe chete kubva muzana kana kuti 18,1% uchizodzika kusvika pazvikamu gumi nezvinomwe nezviga zvinomwe kubva muzana kana kuti 17,7% muna Nyamavhuvhu.

Nyaya yekushomeka kwemagetsi uye kudhura nekushomeka kwemafuta ekufambisa dzimotokari kwave kupa kuti mitengo yezvinhu iwedzerwe panguva iyo vashandi vasiri kuwedzerwa mari.
Mutungamiri wesangano reConfederation of Zimbabwe Retailers Association, VaDenford Mutashu, vayambira vanhu kuti mitengo ichawedzera kukwira kwayo muzvitoro sezvo mafuta ekufambisa dzimotokari akawedzerwawo nemusi weMuvhuro.
VaMutashu vanotiwo vamwe vemuzvitoro vatoregera kutengesa zvimwe zvinhu nenyaya yekushaikwa kwemagetsi.
Mutungamiri weConfederation of Zimbabwe Industries, VaHenry Ruzvidzo, vanotiwo kushaikwa kwemagetsi kwave kuita kuti bhizimisi kunetse.
Mumwe muzvinabhizimisi, VaGilbert Muponda, vati makambani anofanira kupihwa masimba ekuti vagadzirise dambudziko remagetsi kuitira kuti varambe vachiita basa.
VaMuponda vatiwo mutemo unofanira kuchinjwa mukutengwa kwemafuta ekufambisa dzimotokari.
Kunyange hazvo zvinhu zvakaoma kudai, munyori mukuru weZCTU, VaJaphet Moyo, vanoti vashandi havasi kuwedzerwa mari vachipa semuenzaniso vashandi vehurumende.
VaRuzvidzo vanoti vanoda chose kugadzirisa matambudziko evashandi kunyange hazvo zvinhu zvaita mhidigari.
Mumashoko kuvatori venhau nemusi weMuvhuro, kambani yeEconet yakati yave kuomerwa nekuita basa sezvo mutengo wekuita basa uri kuramba uchiwedzera.
Kambani iyi inotiwo mari yemafuta ekufambisa dzimotokari yawedzerwa nezvikamu zvinodarika mazana mashanu kubva muzana ukuwo dhora remunyika reRTGS radonha nezvikamu mazana mapfumbamwe kubva muzana kubva muna Ndira.
Kambani iyi inoti mari yakawanda yave kupera vachitenga dhiziri kuti vashandise magwenya nekuti magetsi ari kudzimwa kwenguva yakareba dzimwe nguva maawa anodarika gumi nemasere.
Kukwira zvakanyanya kwemitengo yezvinhu kuri kupawo kuti inflation irambe ichiita chamurambamhuru uye Zimstats yakati yainge yasvika pazvikamu zana nemakumi manomwe nezvishanu kubva muzana mwedzi wapera kunyange hazvo hurumende yainge yati inofanira kunge yasvika pazvikamu zviri pasi pegumi mukupera kwegore.
Imwe nyanzvi mune zveupfumi inoti nekuda kwemamiriro akaita zvinhu munyaya dzezveupfumi munyika, haioni makambani emunyika achikwanisa kugadzira zvikwanisiro zvinodiwa mukudzivirira kutapuriranwa kwehutachiwana hwecoronavirus.
Zvinodiwa zvinosanganisira magorovhosi, zvekuvharisa miromo nekumeso (masks), zvekuzora zvinouraya hutachiwana (sanitizers) kanawo mbatya dzinodzivirira (protective suits) izvo zvinodiwa mukudzivirira kutapuriranwa pamwe nekuparadzirwa kwehutachiwana hwe coronavirus.
VaMasimba Kuchera, avo vanoshanda vakazvimirira, vanoti makambani akwanda emunyika haasi kushanda zvakakwana, uye vanhu vakawanda vave kuzvishandira izvo zvavanoti zvinoderedza huwandu hwezvinhu zvingagadzirwe munyika nemakambani kana dambudziko rechirwere ichi rakazokura.
Nyika dzakawanda dzine dambudziko rechirwere che COVID-19 kusanganisira America, dziri kuchema nekushaya zvekudzivirira kutapuriranwa kwechirwere ichi zvakakwana zvekuti mamwe makambani anobika doro muAmerica ave kutobatsirawo kuburukidza nekugadzira hand sanitizer.
Nyika zhinji kusanganisirawo Zimbabwe, dziri kutowana rubatsiro kubva kunyika yeChina, iyo iri kutumira zvekushandisa izvi asi zvinonzi nevamwe zvinogona kuzononoka kusvika kwazvinenge zvichidiwa nekukasika.
Hurumende yeZimbabwe iri kuti yakagadzirira zvakakwana kudzivirira kupararira kwehutachiwana hwecoronavirus.

Apo Zimbabwe yabatana nepasi rose mukucherechedza zuva reWorld Aids Day kuMasvingo neSvondo, vanhu vanorarama neHIV/AIDS varatidzira pamberi pegurukota rezvehutano nekuchengetedzwa kwevana, Doctor Obadiah Moyo, vachiti vanoda mishonga navanachiremba muzvipatara, umo vanoti hamusisina kumira zvakana nekuda kwekuramwa mabasa kwavanachiremba.
VaMoyo, ndivo vanga vari munyarikani mukuru pamhemberero idzi, idzo dzaitirwa munhandare ye Mucheke Stadium.
Vanhu varatidzira ava vaita izvi kuburikidza nekurara pasi panguva iyo VaMoyo vanga vachitura mashoko avo kuvanhu vaungana pachiitiko ichi, uye vati vatora danho iri senzira yeratidza hurumende kutsutsumwa kwavo nekushaikwa kwemishonga uye vanachiremba muzvipatara zvehurumende.
Vanachiremba vave nemwedzi mitatu vachiramwa mabasa vachida kuti hurumende igadziririse nyaya dzemihoro yavo pamwe nemashandiro avo.
Amai Moreen Musanzu, vanove mukuru anoona nezvemabasa musangano reZimbabwe Aids Network iro rine nhengo dzaro dzaratidzira, vanoti ivo vange vasiri kuwana mukana wekusvitsa mashoko avo kuna VaMoyo segurukota rezvehutano, nekudaro pavangowana mukana uyu.
VaEmmanuel Gasa, vanove mumwe wevanhu varatidzira nekurara pasi VaMoyo vachitaura, vanoti ivo varatidzira kuti vaudze hurumende kuti muzvipatara hamuna kumira zvakana kuvanhu vanorarama nehutachiwana, avo vavanoti vari kufa nekushaiwa mishonga pamwe navanahiremba vanovarapa.
Vanochengetedza runyararo pamwe nevashandi vebazi rezvehutano vambozama kudzinga vange vachiratidzira ava asi varamba vakarara izvo zvazoita kuti vanhu vange vauya kuzocherechedza zuva iri vamire kuteerera mashoko egurukota vachitora mifanidzo yevanga vachiratidzira ava.
VaGasa vanoti vafara kuti kuratidzira kwavo kwabudirira, uye mashoko avo asvika kune gurukota iro vanoti razotumira vashandi vebazi raro vakati vachaita musangano kuHarare.
Kunyange VaMoyo varamba kupindura mibvunzo yevatori venhau nezvekuratidzira kwaitika pamberi pavo, vaudza vanhu kuti hurumende iri kukoshesa kurwisa HIV neAIDS kuti vanhu vazhinji vasarasikirwe nehupenyu.
Vaenderea mberi vachiti hurumende ichavaka chipatara chikuru chedunhu, cheMasvingo Central Hospital chinove chipatara chepamusoro chinenge chiine nyanzvi dzakasiyanasiyana pamwe nemichina yemhando dzepamusoro, vachiti kubva nyika ichiwana kuzvitonga dunhu rose raive risina riine General Hospital chete.
Vati izvi zvichabatsira mukurwisa chirwere cheshuramatongo mudunhu reMasvingo.
Vachitaurawo pamhemberero iyi, gurukota redunhu reMasvingo, VaEzra Chadzamira, vati vanotenda kuti dunhu rikavakirwa chipatara che Masvingo Central Hospital zvichabatsira mukurapwa kwezvirwere zvakasiyanasiyana kuvanhu vemudunhu ravo rose.
Vachitaurawo pamusangano uyu, mutevedzeri wemumiriri wemuzinda weAmerica, VaThomas Hastings, vanoti nyika yavo icharamba ichibatsira Zimbabwe nemari pamwe nemishonga mukurwiswa kwe HIV/AIDS.
VaMoyo vatiwo dunhu reMasvingo rine vanhu vanopfuura miriyoni, pavanhu ava zviuru zana nemakumi mashanu vanorarama nehutachiwana uye vakanyanya kuwanda madzimai nevana vadiki.
Vati hurumende icharamba ichishanda nemasangano akazvimirira pamwe nemizinda yedzimwe nyika mukurwisa chirwere kuti chidzikire munyika.
Gore rino zuva iri racherechedzwa nedingindira rinokurudzira kuti matunhu atungamire pakuunzwa kweshanduko, kana kuti “Communities make the Difference”.
Sangano reNational Aids Council, iro rakabatana nebazi rezvehutano mukutungamira hurongwa uhwu, ranga richipawo veruzhinji magwaro anopa dzidziso pamusoro peHIV/AIDS.
Sangano iri ranga richishandawo nevanorarama nezvepabonde mudunhu reChiredzi mukurudzira vanhu kuti vavhenekwe ropa, uyewo kupa dzidziso pamusoro peshuramatongo.
Kuratidzira kwavanachiremba vakuru vepachipatara cheParirenyatwa muHarare nemusi weChitatu kunonzi nevamwe kwakaratidza pachena kusamira kwezvinhu muzvipatara zvehurumende.
Vanachiremba ava vakaburitsa pachena kuti havana zvekushandisa zvinotarisirwa kunge zviri muzvipatara, zvakaita semabhandeji, majikiseni pamwe nembatya dzekupfeka vari pabasa, izvo zvinonzi zvinokwanisa kugadzirwa muZimbabwe.
Zvimwe zvezvichemo zvakaburitswa navanachiremba ava pamusangano wavakaita negurukota rezvehutano Doctor Obadiah Moyo ndezvekuti vavari kurwadziwa nekuona varwere vachifa, kana kuvadzosera kudzimba kunofira kudzimba dzavo.
Mumwe chiremba ari mukuru wedivi rekunorapwa maronda erutsva akazivisa kuti vanamukoti vari kuwacha mambandeji anenge abviswa pane mumwe murwere achizoshandiswawo pane mumwe anozouya, achiti izvi hazvina hutano nekuti zvinogona kuita kuti zvirwere zvitapuriranwe.
Varwere vanoda kuvhiyiwa vanonzi vanenge vaita mhanza vari kuzoonekwa kwapera masvondo maviri.
Vekudivi rinosunungutswa madzimai akazvitakura vakatiwo vari kumanikidzwa kushandisa nzira dzisina kukodzera mukuita basa ravo nekuda kwekushaikwa kwezvikwanisiro, izvo zvinonzi zviri kuzosiya vamwe vana varemara, kana kushaya.
Asi nemusi weChina, Doctor Moyo vakazivisa kuti hurumende yawana mari inoita miriyoni yemadhora yekutengesa zvekushandisa.
Vamwe vanoongorora zvematongerwo enyika vanoti zviri muzvipatara mucherechedzo wekukundikana kwehurumende yaVaEmmerson Mnangagwa, iyo iri kupomerwa mhosva yekuisa mari kuzvinhu zvisina kukosha.

Asi vakambowewo nhengo yeparamende vachimirira Pelandaba/Mpopoma, VaJoseph Tshuma, veZanu PF vanoti nyaya yezvirango ndiyo yakanganisa zvinhu munyaya dzezvehutano.

Vanhu mazana maviri negumi nevanomwe havasi kuzivikanwa kuti vari kupi uye vamwe makumi mana nevaviri vakavharirwa pazvitsuwa.

VaMangwana vanoti mvura inenge yambomira kunaya nekudaro vave kusimbisa kubatsira vanhu uye kubatsira mukuvigwa kwevanhu vakarasikirwa nehupenyu. Vatiwo kwave nemauto akawanda nemapurisa ari kubatsira vanhu.

Munyori wemu America ane mukurumbira mukuru pasi pose, Amai Toni Morrison, vakashaya neMuvhuro kuNew York vave nemakore makumi masere nemasere.
Bhuku rakanyorwa naAmai Morrison muna 1988, rinonzi ‘Beloved’, renhoroondo yemutapwa akange atiza varidzi vake, rakapiwa mubairo wekunyora weNobel Prize, zvikaita kuti Amai Morrison vave mudzimai wechitema wekutanga kupiwa mubairo uyu.
Muna 2012, vaimbove mutungamiriri weAmerica, VaBarack Obama, vakakudza Amai Morrison nekuvapa menduru yePresidential Medal of Honor.
Amai Morrison vakamboshanda semupepeti wemabhuku pakambani inozivikanwa zvikuru, yeRandom House, kubva muna 1967 kusvika muna 1983, vakavazve munhu mutema wechidzimai wekutanga kuita basa iri pakambani iyi.
Amai Morrison vakamboita murairidzi kwemakore mazhinji paHoward University, pachikoro pavakadzidza vakapedza dzidzo dzavo ipapo muna 1953.
Zvimwe zvikoro zvepa musorosoro pavakaita murairidzi zvinosanganisira Yale University, SUNY Purchase, Bard College, Rutgers University, SUNY Albany ne Princeton University apo pavakazobva vavekuenda kumudyandigere muna 2006.
Vanodzidzisa zvematongerwo enyika paWellesley College, kuMassachusets, Doctor Chipo Dendere, vanoti Amai Morrison vaifarira vanyori veku Africa uye vaiwirirana nevanyori ava, vanosanganisira Chinua Achebe na Wole Soyinka. .
Zvimwe zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvinogara muHuston kuTexas uko kwakarohwa nedutumupengo rine mafashamu, Hurricane Harvey, zvinoti kunyange zvazvo vamwe vavo vakakuvadzirwa dzimba dzavo, vanotenda Nyadenga kuti hapana kana munhu mumwe chete pakati pavo ati azivikanwa kuti akafa kana kukuvadzwa.
Pari zvino dutumupengo iri rauraya vanhu vanoita makumi matanhatu nevatatu pamusoro pekupunza dzimba nezvivakwa mudunhu iri.
Zvikoro nemakambani zvakavharwa uye migwagwa izere mvura zvekuti vazhinji vanotoshandisa zvikepe kusvika kuvanhu vanoda rubatsiro.
“Inini ndinoda kutenda Mwari kuti handina kunyanya kushungurudzwa nedutumupengo iri. Harvey yakaita zvatisati tamboona; mvura kunge yaNoah chaiyo. Nemusi weChishanu ndakaona dambudziko guru chaizvo kuuya kumba ndichibva kubasa nokuti takange taudzwa kuti mvura nenhepo zvichasvika kuno uku pamwe neSvondo,” vanodaro Muzvare Muchuro.
“Vese vekuZimbabwe vandinoziva vakapona. Kumativi kwavanogara hakuna kunyanya kuvhiringwa asi vamwe vandinoshanda navo vakapinda pakaoma, vakarasikirwa nezvinhu zvavo,” Muzvare Muchuro vanowedzera.
Mumwe mugari wekuTexas, Muzvare Orissa Williams, vanotiwo mune dzimwe nzvimbo mvura yaisvika pamatenga edzimba.
“Kwandinogara nzira dzema ‘highway’ dzange dzakavharwa zvekuti vamwe vaitoshandisa zvikepe kuenda kumabasa nekuti mvura muneimwe migwagwa yaisvika mumabvi,” Muzvare Williams vanotsanangura.
Muzvare Williams vanoti vari kugara nedzimwe hama dzavo nokuti denga reimba yavo rakadonhera mumba yekutandarira mushure mekunge mvura nemhepo zvaparadza nharaunda yavo kwemazuva mashanu.
“Inini pachangu handina kunyanya kuvhiringwa asi hama dzangu ndidzo dzakasvitswa pakaoma nokuti mvura haisi kudzika mumba mavo uye hapana rubatsiro rwavari kuwana pari zvino asi kungomirira vanhu ve Federal Emergency Management Agency, vanobatsira vanhu munguva dzakadai. Ongororo yakaitwa neCenter for Sexual Health and HIV/AIDS Research inoratidza kuti vanoita mabasa echipfambi vakawanda vave kutya kuenda kunotora mishonga yavo yeHIV/AIDS kana kunorapwa zvimwe zvirwere pamwe nekuwana dzidziso, sezvo vachiti vari kunyombwa kana kushungurudzwa nanamukoti.
Ongororo iyi yakaitwa mushure mekuona vakawanda vevanhu ava vasisaendi kuzvipatara nemakirinika, zvisineyi kuti bazi rezvehutano nemasangano akasiyana siyana ari kukurudzira kuti vanhu vaongororwe hutachiwana pamwe nekuenda kunopihwa mushonga kana vachinge vawanikwa vainahwo.
Vachitaura pamusangano wange wakarongwa neveZimbabwe Lawyers for Human Rights maererano neongororo yavo, vanoona nekufambiswa kwezvirongwa muCESHHAR, Amai Sibongile Mtetwa, vakati vanoita mabasa echipfambi vari kushungurudzwa pamwe nekupomerwa mhosva yekuparadzirwa hutachiwana hweHIV/AIDS.
Vanoti ongororo yavo yakaitwa pasi pechirongwa che“Sisters With a Voice” yakaburitsa pachena kuti vanhu ava ndivo vanonekwa pekupedzisira kana vachinge vaenda kumakirinika.
Vanoti semuenziso mumwe mudzimai akashungurudzika chose mushure mekuudzwa namukoti wepane imwe kirinika yavasina kuda kudoma kuti sei ainge achiita zvivindi zvekuuya kukirinika kuzotora mapiritisi asi iye akazvitsvakira hutachiwanda ega.
Vanotiwo pane zvakawanda zvinoitika muzvipatara nemakirinika zvave kuita kuti vanoita zvechipfambi veregedze kuenda kuzvipatara izvi sezvo vachitya kunonyadziswa pamberi pevamwe varwere.
Amai Mtetwa vanoti kuita kwakadai hakuna kunaka uye sangano ravo richishanda nebazi rezvehutano nemamwe masangano vave kushanda nanamukoti nevamwe vanoshanda muzvipatara kuti vabate vanhu ava pamwe nevarwere zvakanaka.
Vanoti kana izvi zvikaitika vanhu vanosununguka kuenda kunotora mapiritsi avo eHIV/AIDS pamwe nekurapwa zvirwere zvepabonde.
Ongororo iyi yakaratidzawo kuti pane vanhu vanoita zvechipfambi vanodarika zviuru makumi mashanu vakaenda kumakirinika eCESHHAR kubva muna2009 kusvika pari zvino uye zvikamu makumi maviri kubva muzana zvevanu ava zvaive neHIV/AIDS.

Mumwe wevakaremara ari pahumani ndiMuzvare Praxedes Chadambura vekuHwedza avo vari kushandisa chimbuzi chakaondomoka.
Muzvare Chadambura, avo vane makore makumi mana nematatu ekuberekwa, vakaremara makumbo ese, vachigara mumusha waMadoka kuHwedza. Vanoti tsaona yekuwondomoka kwechimbuzi chavo yakaitika gore rapera.
“Toilet yangu yakadhirika nemvura. Inini ndinoita zvekukambaira zvekuti kana mvura ichinaya ndinenge ndiri mumadhaka. Ndiri kungoshandisa yakadaro ine chidziro chimwechete. Kuti ndicherese imwe handina mari.”
Muzvare Chadambura vanoti vakaremara vakawanda kumamisha vari kunetsekana nezvivakwa zvakaita sezvimbuzi nemavakirwo epamikova.
“Todawo zvekare ramping mumamisha medu. Vamwe vacho havatokwanisi kufamba. Vamwe vanoda ma wheelchair vamwe vanoda ma crutches. Vamwe havana zvinofambisa kuti vaende kure.”
Amai vaMuzvare Praxedes, Ambuya Florence Chadambura, vanoti dambudziko rakatarisana nemwana wavo rinovabata zvakasimba.
“Toilet yakadhirika zvechokwadi asi kuti pagadzirisike handiiwane mari yacho. Pane paanofamba achienda mumba maanorara pakareba asi kuti ndizive kuti ndingapaite sei kuti pagadzirisike handikwanise. Ini ndachembera hakuna kwandichawana mari.
"Saka ndiri kukumbira hurumende kuti ibatsire, vanovaziva vanhu ava. Inga vakatipa chikafu, zvinhu zvakanaka izvozvo asi pane zvinenge zvakarema ngavabatsirewo.”
Ambuya Chadambura, avo vane makore makumi masere ekuberekwa, vanoti vakaremara vanofanira kubatsirwa kuti vazvimiririre.
“Vanhu vanotambura vanofanira kuti vabatsirwe. Anoshaya sipo, anoshaya mafuta ekuzora. Ma projects havasi kuburitsirwa pachena kuti vachapihwa here? Munhu anogona kusona nekurima zvekuti anofanira kunge achiwana machira ekuti abatsirikane.
"Hongu ane mubereki asi anenge akura sezvandaita inini, handichakwanisa kumushandira. Ndinogona kumupa sadza kwete kutsvaga mari yekuti aite project yaanenge achida.”
Hanzvadzi yaMuzvare Chadambura, VaGilbert Choda, vanogara pamusha nemhuri yavo. Vakasiya basa nekuda kwehurwere. Vanoti kunyangwe dambudziko rechimbuzi vachiriona havana zvavanokwanisa kuita.
“Inini ndakagara na Praxedes nyaya ye toilet iri kutambudza, ndinozviona paanoenda kuchimbuzi asi handikwanise kumubatsira. Ye toilet ndozongonzwawo zvamunenge mafunga. Vemumusha havana hurukuro pamusoro pedambudziko iri. Vanongoti zvionere, kumba kwako.”
Councillor veWard 7 muDendenyore mune musha wekwa Madoka, VaAmos Chakuinga, vanoti zvakakosha kuti vemunharaunda vazivise vatungamiri vavo kana vawirwa nematambudziko.
“Sekutaura kwamaita kuti toilet ya Praxedes yakapwanyika, tinenge tichitarisira kuti ivo vanogara naye vanenge vachidzidzisa vakuru vemunharaunda. Tinofanira kubatsirana kuti tive nemuono wakafanana.
"Nekuti haisi nyaya yekuti tiri kumuvakira toilet asi i development yatinenge tichiita mu area. Tinounganidza vanhu zvine uchenjeri tovakumbira kuti vapinde mazviri vachibetsera nemwoyo wese. Kana takabatana semhuri imwechete hapana chinotitadzisa nekuti tinokwanisa kuona kuti zvinowanikwa muvanhu ndezvipi.
"Nekupera kwenguva hazvizofaniri kugumira pana Praxedes chete nekuti zvinofanira kufanana kune vakaremara vese. Hapafanire kuoneka kuti pane asarudzwa kana kuti pane mumwe anokosha nekuti budiriro inofanira kuve yemunhu wese.”
VaChakuinga vanoti vakatombobatsira Muzvare Chadambura pamakore apfuura.
“Pane imwe nguva yandakakurukura na Praxedes aisimbisa iye kuti anofarira zvekusona nekuti pamashure apo akatombowana mushini kubva kuna former MP. Tiri kukoshesa kuti iye akawana zvekuita zvinowandudza hupenyu hwake uye pfungwa dzake dzinogara dzakadzikama.”
Baba Richard Muzerura inyanzvi yekudzidzisa mune zvemaoko pane chimwe chikoro chikuru muHarare. Vanoti dambudziko rakatarisana naMuzvare Chadambura nevamwe vakawanda vakaremara rinonzwisa ngoni.
“Ndanzwa kubatikana nemifananidzo yamandiratidza. Toilet inofanira kuvakwa zvakanaka kuti iye azokwanisa kushandisa. Iye anoda zvekare rubatsiro rwekuti anopinda sei mu toilet imomo asingabate pasi achikambaira nekuti zvinoita kuti abate zvirwere.
"Uye panofanira kugara pachishandiswa mishonga yekuti haazobati zvirwere. Zvinoburitsawo matambudziko anosangana nevakwegura mudzimba dzavanogara. Ndopa muenzaniso wevabereki vangu. Takabisa ma steps pamba.
"Vakwegura vanofanira kugara pakanaka uye pakashambidzika. Vanofamba vachibata madziro kana pasi saka panofanira kugara pakatsvinda. Uye vanoda rudo rwevana vavo.”
Baba Muzerura vanoti nyanzvi mumabasa emaoko dzinofanira kushanda pamwechete kugadzira zvinorerutsa mararamiro evakaremara nevakwegura.
“Patinogadzirira vabereki dzimba ngatizivei kuti vabereki ava vanokura vozotadza kudzishandisa. Kana munhu akaremara anofanira kupinda ne wheel chair zvakatambanuka pasina ma steps.
"Ndinokurudzira vanoita engineering kuti izvi zviri nyore kugadzirira vakaremara kuti vagare hupenyu hwakatambanuka. Tinoita zvimwe zvakaoma chaizvo zvekuti handione izvi zvichitinetsa.”

Nhumwa yeUnited Nations inoona nezvekodzero dzevanhu pasi rose, VaClement Nyaletsossi Voule, vanoti pane kusawirirana kusina kunaka muZimbabwe, uko vati kunofanirwa kugadziriswa nechimbi chimbi.
Vachitaura mushure mekupedza basa ravakafambira muZimbabwe, VaVoule vati kusawirirana kuri munyika kunogona kupedzwa nenhaurirano pakati pemapato ezvematongerwo enyika, vanoshandira masangano akazvimiririra, pamwe neruzhinji.
VaVoule vati kunyange hazvo vanhu vemuZimbabwe vaive netarisiro yekuti zvinhu zvichachinja munyika nekuda kwehurumende yaVaEmmerson Mnangagwa, vakaona kuti vanhu vazhinji havasisina chivimbo nehurumende iripo iyi.
Vatiwo kunyange hazvo hurumende yeZimbabwe iri kuda kubvisa mutemo wePublic Order and Security Act uyo vati unokanganisa kodzero yekuungana nekusangana, vati mutemo weMaintanance of Peace and Order Bill uri kuda kuiswa hauzadzikisi kodzero dzaityorwa nemutemo uri kuda kubviswa.
VaVoule vakurudzira hurumende kuti igadzirise MOPA kuti ienderane nekodzero dziri mubumbiro remitemo yenyika.
VaVoule vashorawo nyaya yekupiwa simba kwemauto kuti ave achikwanisa kudeedzwa panenge paine vanhu vakaungana kana paita mhirizhonga. Vati izvi hazvisi izvo zvinotarisirwa nemitemo yenyika dzepasi rese.
VaVoule vati zvakanakirawo nyika kuti vanhu vapiwe mukana wekuungana kuti vataure zvavanoda pamwe nenyunyutodzavo vachiti zvinobatsira kuti vanhu vasazoshandise nzira dzisiri pamutemo huye dzinogona kukanganisa zvinhu munyika.
Vatiwo vakanzwa nezvekusabatwa zvakanaka kunoitwa vanorwira kodzero dzevashandi vakapa muenzaniso wekupambwa kwevakafanobata chigaro chemutungamiriri weZimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association, Doctor Peter Magombeyi, nevanhu vasingazivikanwi.
VaVoule vakurudzirawo hurumende kuti isashungurudze vanorwira kodzero dzevashandi nekuvaendesa kumatare edzimhosva kana pachinge paitwa mhirizhonga mukuratidzira.
Vakurudzira hurumende kuti pachinzvimbo chekusunga vanenge vadaidzira musangano, inofanirwa kusunga vanenge vachiita zvisakarurama zvakadai sekuputsa zvitoro nekupisa zvinhu.

Muchina uyu unokosha mazana matatu ezviuru zvemadhora.
Zimbabwe yakapedzesera kuopareta moyo muna 2003 apo pakatanga kunetsa zvinhu munyaya dzehupfumi uye kubvira ipapo vane zvirwere zvemoyo vane mari vange vachienda kunorapwa kunyika dzakaita seIndia neSouth Africa ukuwo vanoshaya vange vakangogara uye vamwe vavo vakatofa.

Broadcasting Authority of Zimbabwe yadoma nzvimbo gumi dzinokwanisa kunyoreswa kuwana marezinhesi enhepfenyuro dzenharaunda muchiziviso chavakokawo nhepfenyuro dzemaunivhesiti pamwe nezvivhitivhiti kuti dzinyorere marezinhesi.
BAZ yazivisa kuti pamusoro pekupa nhepfenyuro dzenharaunda marezinesi gumi munzvimbo dzavadoma vachapawo zvivhitivhiti marezinesi matanhatu uyewo marezinesi gumi nemapfumbamwe kuzvikoro zvedzidzo yepamusoro zvinodzidzisa zvidzidzo zvekutora nhau.
Mukuru weMedia Institute of Sothern Africa Zimbabwe, VaTabani Moyo vati kunyangwe hazvo bandiko rehurumende iri radeedzera marezinhesi vanokatyamadzwa nekudomwa kwenzvimbo dzichapiwa marezinesi enhepfenyuro dzenharaunda vakati izvi hazvina kujeka kuti sei hurumende iri kuda kupa dzimwe nzvimbo dzimwe dzisiri kupiwa. VaMoyo vanoti havagutsikani kuti hurumende ichapa marezinesi aya zvakasununguka sezvo vatodoma nzvimbo dzichawana.
VaMoyo vatiwo zvichaomera vari kuda marezinesi zvakanyanya kuti vakwanise kushanda sezvo mutemo uri kugadzirwa weBroadcasting Services Bill usingavatenderi kupihwa mari nevekunze inodarika zvikamu makumi maviri kubva muzana.
Nyanzi munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika uye vaive mutori wenhau Doctor Pedzisai Ruhanya vati vachatenda maruva vadya chakata. VaRuhanya vatiwo kutepfenyura kunoda mari yakawanda zvakanyanya vakati kana hurumende ine chido chekusunungura masai-sai inofanirwa kudzikisa mari dzinodiwa pakuwana marezinesi.
Imwe nhengo yekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvekubudiswa kwemashoko VaSettlement Chikwinya vati kunyangwe vari kugamuchira shuviro yekuwedzerwa kwevanotepfenyura munyika vati vanoda kuti marezinesi awa apiwe zvejekerere.
Vati parizvino varikutoshamiswa kuti imwe terevhizheni yeZimpapers yatova nemichina nechakare yekutepfenyura marezinesi asati apiwa.
VaChikwinya vatiwo vachaongorora mari iri kudiwa kunyorera marezinesi iyi vakati shuviro yavo ndeyekuti idzike zvichienzaniswa nedzimwe nyika dzakaita seKenya.
Kunyangwe hazvo vamwe vari kugunun’una nenyaya yemarezinesi aya kune vamwewo vatambira danho iri nemufaro.
Mukuru weGreat Zimbabwe University Campus Radio, VaGolden Maunganidze vati vatambira nemufaro kudaidzirwa kwemarezinesi uku vachiti zvichavabatsira kubudisa vadzidzi vane hunyanzvi hwepamusoro.
Mumwe mugari wemuHarare, VaStanford Nyatsanza vati vafarira zvikuru zvaitwa nehurumende.
Mumwe mutori wenhau, Muzvare Margaret Chinowaita vatiwo vafadzwa nedanho iri sezvo kuwedzera kwevanotepfenyura kuchirevawo basa kune vatori venhau. Vakurudzirawo vanhukadzi kuti vanyorerewo marezinesi aya.
Mutevedzeri wegurukota rinoona nezvekubudiswa kwemashoko, VaEnergy Mutodi vaudza Studio 7 kuti nzvimbo dzadomwa idzi hadzisviki masai-sai kunenhepfenyuro nezvivhitivhiti zviriko nekudaro ndidzo dzinoda kutangwa. Asi vati hurumende ine hurongwa hwekupa marezinesi makumi mana kunhepfenyuro dzenharaunda.

Sangano reCommunity Working Group on Health rinoti zvitunha zvave kuworera mumamochari emuzvipatara zvehurumende nekushaya vanachiremba vanovhiya kuti pabude chirwere chinenge chapa kuti murwere afe.
Sachigharo wesangano reHealth Service Board, Dr. Paulinus Sikosana, vaudza Studio 7 kuti matare ekunzwa mhosva dziri kupomerwa vanachiremba ava kuzvipatara zvavo ari kuenderera mberi uye vakawanda vari kutarisirwa kudzingwa basa pamusoro pevadzingwa basa ava.

Bato reZanu PF rinoti zvirango zviri kuramba zvichitemerwa vamwe vakuru muhurumende pamwe nemakambani ari pasi pehurumende nenyika dzinosanganisira America nedzimwe dzine pfungwa dzakafanana neAmerica hazvisi pamutemo, uye zvinoshoreka.
Mutauriri weZanu PF, VaSimon Khaya-Moyo vataura mashoko aya mugwaro ravaburitsa, vachiti chiitiko ichi chinouya pasina nguva sangano reEuropean Union ratora danho rimwechetero rekuwedzera zvirango izvi, kunyange hazvo hurumende iri kuedza zvikuru kumutsiridza kudyidzana nedzimwe nyika.
VaKhaya-Moyo vati mashoko eAmerica ekuti sarudzo dzakaitwa muna 2018 dzakanga dzisina kuchena haasi echokwadi, nekuti sarudzo idzi dzakatambirwa nemasangano emuAfrica eSADC neAfrican Union, pamwe nemamwe ekumhiri akawanda.
Vanotiwo mutongo wedare repamusorosoro reConstitutional Court wekuti mutungamiri wenyika ndivo vakakunda musarudzo dzaipikiswa nemutungamiri weMDC, Vanelson Chamisa, wakavhara nyaya yose.
Vatiwo munyika mune kuremekedzwa kwekodzero dzevanhu nekuteverwa kwebumbiro remitemo, kushanda kwevanotora nhau vakasununguka, uye kuteverwa kwebumbiro remitemo yenyika.
Mashoko avaKhaya-Moyo aya anotevera kuziviswa kwakaitwa nemutungamiri we America, VaDonald Trump, neMuvhuro kuti hurumende yavo yakawedzera nerimwe gore zvirango zvakatemerwa vakuru-vakuru muhurumende yeZanu PF, pamwe nemakambani anodyidzana nehurumende yaVaEmmerson Manangagwa.
Izvi zvinouya panguva iyo VaMnangagwa nehurumende yavo vari kuti vari kuedza nepose pavanogona kutanga kudyidzana zvakare nenyika dzakanga dzambochekana hukama neZimbabwe munguva yehurumende yevaive mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe.
Vachiwedzera zvirango izvi, VaTrump vakati maitiro evanhu vari pazvirango anokanganisa kutonga kwejekerere. Vakatiwo kodzero dzevanhu dzichiri kutyorwa nehurumende yaVaMnangagwa.
Hurumende yaVaMnangagwa pamwe nenhengo dzeZanu PF vanogarochema nerekuti zvirango izvi zviri kukanganisa nyaya dzezvehupfumi, uye kuti zviri kukanganisa hurongwa hwekukwezva vemabhizimusi vekunze kuti vapinde munyika kuzonodyara mari dzavo. Nekudaro, vanoti zvirango izvi zvinofanirwa kubviswa.
Nyanzvi mune zveupfumi, VaMasimba Kuchera vanoti danho remutungamiri weAmerica iri richatoita kuti zvinhu zvinyanyooma muZimbabwe sezvo richiratidza kuti America haisati yagutsikana nenhanho dzafambwa nehurumende yaVaMnangagwa.
VaKuchera vanoti dambudziko riripo nderekuti hurumende yeZimbabwe inoda kuti ibvisirwe zvirango izvi asi iyo isiri kutorawo matanho ekugadzirisa zvakamboshevedza zvirango pakutanga.
Gweta rinorwira kodzero dzevanhu vachishanda nesangano reHuman Rights Watch kuchamhembe kweAfrica, VaDewa Mavhinga, vanoti zviri kuitwa nehurumende yeZimbabwe zvekuramba ichityora kodzero dzevanhu pamwe nekushungurudza vanopikisa nevemasangano akazvimirira hazviratidze kuti ine chido chekugadzirisa zvinhu nekukasika.
VaMavhinga vanoti zviri kuZimbabwe kuvhuka kana kuwarira panyaya yezvirango iyi, kwete kumirira kufungirwa zvekuita neAmerica.
Panyaya yekuti VaMnangagwa nehurumende yavo vari kuedza napose pavanogona kudyidzana zvakare nenyika dzekumawirira, VaMavhinga vanoti mutungamiri wenyika ari kungoita godzera mumukanwa, pasina chiri kuonekwa kunze.
Mutauriri weMDC, VaJacob Mafume, vanoti zviri nyore kwazvo kuti America ibvise zvirango izvi kana hurumende yeZimbabwe yakangomira kushunguradza pamwe nekudzvinyirira vanhu vayo.
Asi vanoongorora zvematongerwo enyika, vakarerekera kubato reZanu PF, VaGadzira Chirumhanzu, vanoti havaoni paine chiri kukanganiswa naVaMnangagwa nehurumende yavo.
VaChirumhanzu vanoti chirti kuitwa chete kusimbisa nyaya yekuti vana veZimbabwe vanoramba vari varidzi venyika yavo. Vanoenderera mberi vachiti zvekuti pave nezvirango kana kuti hapana zvirango kuvana veZimbabwe hazvishandi.
Danho rehurumende yeAmerica iri rinouya panguva iyo vatungamiri vakawanda vanyika dzemuAfrica kusanganisira mutungamiri weSouth Africa, VaCyril Ramaphosa, vari kukurudzira kuti zvirango izvi zvibviswe, vachiti Zimbabwe inofanirwa kumbopiwa mukana wekuti imuke mune zveupfumi, uhwo hwagwadama.
Asi vamwe vanoongorora zvematongerwo enyika vanoti vatungamiri ava, zvikuru VaRamaphosa, vanofanirwa kutsiura VaMnangagwa kuti varemekedze kodzero dzevanhu.
Hurumende yeAmerica inoti vanhu pamwe nemakambani anodyidzana nehurumende zvinosvika zana nemakumi mana ane chimwe, kusanganisira VaMnangagwa pamwe nevaive mutungamiri wenyika VaRobert Mugabe, zvichiri pasi pezvirango izvi, izvo zvakadzikwa munguva yaVaMugabe muna 2003 vachinzi vatyora kodzero dzevanhu.
Kusvika hurumende yaita zvinogutsa vana veZimbabwe pamwe nehurumende dzakaita seAmerica, Britain European Union, zvirango zvakatemerwa vamwe vakuru ava nenyika dzekumawirira zvacharamba zviripo.
Gadziriro yemusangano mukuru weInternational Conference on AIDS and STIs in Africa, Icasa, wegumi nesere uri kutarisirwa kuitwa muHarare svondo rinouya, inonzi iri kufamba negwara, uye kusvika pari zvino zvikamu makumi mapfumbamwe nezvisere kubva muzana zvazadziswa.
Mutauriri we Icasa, Amai Tariro Makanga-Chikumbirike, vanoti kunyange hazvo Zimbabwe yakapiwa mwedzi mina chete yekugadzirira musangano uyu, uyo waifanirwa kunge wakaitirwa kunyika yeTunisia, vakakwanisa kuwana rutsigiro kubva kuhurumende pamwe nemamwe mapoka.
Musangano uyu uchatanga nemusi wa 29 Mbudzi uchipera musi wa 4 Zvita. Mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, vari kutarisirwa kuvhura musangano uyu zviri pamutemo.
Mutambi wenhabvu ane mukurumbira pasi rose, Samuel Etoo wekuCameroon, ari kutarisirwawo kuve mumwe wevanyarikani pamusangano uyu.

Nyaya yezvikwata zviri kurwisa pamwe nekuponda vanhu zvichishandisa mabhemba, izvo zvave kuzivikanwa nerekuti “mashurugwi” yanetsa munyika yose zvichitevera kupararira kuri kuitwa zvikwata izvi mumatunhu ose emunyika.
Mukutanga, zvikwata zvevanhu vemabhemba izvi zvainyanyowanikwa munzvimbo dzinocherwa zvicherwa zvakaita semangoda negoridhe, asi pari zvino vanhu ava vanonzi vave kungowanikwa chero mumapurazi kana mumamisha, umo vari kurwisa vanhu vavanenge vanetsana navo, kana kushandisa mabhemba avo mukubira vanhu.
Mashurugwi anonzi akonzerawo kusagadzikana kwevanhu mumatunhu akawanda, kusanganisira mumadhorobha.
Mashoko ari kubuda mumadandemutande anoti chikwata che"Mashurugwi" chakarwisa imwe mhuri kuChegutu neChitatu manheru vanhu vaviri vakafa vamwe vatatu vakakuwara zvakaipisisa.
Vanhu ava vanonziwo vakanorwisa kamba yemapurisa kuNembudziya kuGokwe vachiedza kununura mumwe wavo akanga asungwa.

Vanoti mapurisa haasi kutora matanho sezvo vanhu ava vari pasi pevamwe vakuru vari muchipurisa nemuchiuto.

Mutungamiri weparamende yeAfrica, kana kuti Pan-African Parliament, VaRoger Nkodo Dang, vari kushanya muZimbabwe nechinangwa chekuona mamiriro akaita zvinhu zvichitevera kubviswa kwakaitwa vaimbove mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe.

Asi VaSikhala vati vakazvipira kusazovepo pachazeiwa zvichabuda muongororo iyi uye vati VaSibanda naVaNdebele vakavadoma kuti vavamirire panyaya iyi.
Vati mutemo uno bvumidza munhu mumwe nemumwe kumirirwa negweta raanoda uye kuvarambidza kumirira vaviriri ava kutyora kodzero dzavo.

Izvi hazvina kufadza VaSikhala avo vati, vave kukwidza nyaya iyi kumatare kuti ambomisa ongororo iyi pamwe nekupa mutongo wekuti danho ratorwa nekomiti iyi riri pamutemo here kana kuti kwete.

Ongororo yeZimstat iyi inoburitsa kubudirira kwehutano hwemadzimai akazvitakura, hutano hwevana, kurongwa kwemhuri pamwe nenyaya dzezvirwere zvakaita seHIV/AIDS ne Malaria.

VaPiason Madhuku Mlambo vanoshanda neUNFPA. VaMhlambo vanoti chakavafadza mutsvagiridzo iyi huwandu kwevanhukadzi vakazvitakura vanoenda kunoongororwa sezvo izvi zvichibatsira kudzikisa huwandu hwevana vanofa.

Amai Damiso vanoti Zimbabwe inofanirwa kuramba yakazvipira mukupedza dambudziko iri.
Ongororo iyi inoti vanhu zvikamu gumi nezvina kubva muzana ndivo vane HIV/AIDS. Huwandu uhu hwadzikira kubva pazvikamu gumi nezvisere kubva muzana mugore ra2005-6.
Asiwo Amai Damiso vanoti vanosuwiswa zvikuru neongororo iri kuratidza kuti munyika mune vamwewo vanhu vanofunga kuti pane zvikonzero zvekuti mhirizhonga itambirwe mudzimba nemunharaunda.
Ongororo iyi inoti zvikamu makumi mana kubva muzana zvemadzimai ari pakati pemakore gumi nemashanu kusvika pamakore makumi mana nemapfumbamwe vanobvuma kuti pane zvikonzero zvakanaka zvinorovesa vanhukadzi mudzimba.

Vaimbove muutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Gabriel Mugabe, vakashaya neChishanu mangwanani kuchipatara cheGleneagles Hospital kuSingapore.
Izvi zvatanga kuziviswa nebazi rezvekunze kweSingapore.
VaMugabe vashaya vava nemakore makumi mapfumbamwe nemashanu, uye vasiya mudzimai, Amai Grace Mugabe, vana vatatu, Bona Mugabe Chikore, Robert Mugabe naChatunga Bellarmine Mugabe.
VaMugabe vakaenda kuSingapore muna Kubvumbi vachirwara nehurwere husina kunyatsotsanangurwa.
VaMugabe vakabviswa pachigaro nemauto muna Mbudzi 2017, mushure mekunge vadzinga vaive mutevedzeri wavo, VaEmmerson Mnangagwa.
Mushure mekubviswa pachigaro, Zanu PF yakagara pasi ndokubva yavadzinga mubato iri, pamwe nemudzimai wavo, Amai Grace Mugabe.
Bato iri rakasarudzawo VaMnangagwa kuti vatsive VaMugabe, izvo zvakatambirwa naparamende muna Zvita 2017. VaMnangagwa vakagadzwa semutungamiri wenyika.
VaMugabe vakaberekwa kwaKutama munharaunda yekwaZvimba musi wa21 Kukadzi 1924, semumwe wevana vashanu vamuchakabvu Bona naVaConstantine Gabriel Mugabe Matibiri. Mukuru mumhuri yavo anga ari Michael, achiteverwa naRaphael, Sabina, kuchizouya ivo Robert, Bridget ari chigumisirwa.
Pavakanga vachiri mwana mudiki, babavavo vaiita basa rekuveza, vakaenda kuBulawayo vachinotsvaga basa.
Vari kuBulawayo, baba vaVaMugabe vakanoroora mumwe mudzimai wepiri vakaita vana vatatu; Albert, David, naRegina.
Munguva iyi, amai vaVaMugabe, avo vaive mudzidzisi, vakasara vachirera VaMugabe nevamwe vana varivega.
Vachiri mudiki, VaMugabe vaibatsira amai vavo nekufudza zvipfuwo zvemhuri pamwe nekuita tumari nemaricho.
Vanhu vatema vakawanda panguva iyi vaingodzidza kusvika pazvidzidzo zvisingapfuure dzidzo yepasi, kana kuti primary school education.
VaMugabe pavakapedza zvidzidzo zvepasi, vakaenda kunoita zvidzidzo zvesekondari paKutama Mission, iyo yaiva pasi paMufundisi O’Hea, avo vakanga vakakurudzira VaMugabe kuti vaenderere mberi nedzidzo.
Vadzidzisi vaVaMugabe vakatanga kuona njere dzavo vakatanga kuvadaidza nerekuti ‘mukomana akachenjera’.
Shamwari yavo vachikura, muchakabvu James Chikerema, vakambotsanangura VaMugabe semunhu akanga asingatane kuramwa chero pakutamba nevamwe uye ane mwoyo wakaoma zvekuti yanga isiri nyore kumubvisa pane zvaanenge achida kuita.
VaMugabe pavakapedza zvidzidzo zvepasi, vakaenda kunoita zvidzidzo ku Fort Hare University kumabvazuva kwe Cape Town.
Vapedza zvidzidzo zvavo kuSouth Africa, VaMugabe vakadzoka kumusha kunodzidzisa, asi vachienderera mberi nezvidzidzo paHope Fountain Mission pedyo neBulawayo.
Muna 1955 VaMugabe vakayenda kuZambia, ichanzi Northern Rhodesia, uko vakanodzidzisa kwemakore mana paChalimbana Training College.
Amai Sally Mugabe
Mushure mezvo, VaMugabe vakaenda ku Ghana uko vakanodzidzisa varairidzi paSt Mary’s. Uku ndiko kwavakasangana nemudzimai wavo wekutanga, Amai Sally Heyfron, vakazochata muna 1961.
Pavakauya kuzoshanya kumusha mugore ra 1960 akaita mahwekwe nekuratidzira kwaive nemhirizhonga zvikuru sei kumisha yaigara vatema vachiti vaida magariro ari nani.VaMugabe vakakumbirwa vakabvuma kutaura pane rimwe gungano revairatidzira vachitsanangura mamiriro ezvinhu ku Ghana uko kwakawanikwa kuzvitonga kuchikurudzirwa pfungwa dzegutsaruzhinji.
Hurumende ye Rhodesia yakamisa kushanda kwebato iri mukupera kwa1961, asinhengo dzakaungana zvekare nezita idzva re Zimbabwe African People’s Union (ZAPU) richitungamirirwa naVaJoshua Mqabuko Nkomo, avo vaizivikanwa nezvekutungamira masangano evashandi.
Rev. Ndabaningi Sithole
Muna 1963 VaMugabe nevamwe vavo vakaita pfungwa dzakasiyana vakatanga bato idzva re Zimbabwe African National Union (ZANU) richitungamirirwa naReverend Ndabaningi Sithole.
Vakasungwa kudaro mugore ra 1974 VaMugabe vanonzi vakatungamira mukubviswa kwaRev. Sithole semutungamiri we ZANU. Mugore iroro, mutungamiri wehurumende ye Rhodesia, Va Ian Douglas Smith, vakabvumidza VaMugabe kuti vabuditswe mujere kuitira kuti vanopinda musangano ku Lusaka ku Zambia.
Pane kunanga kumusangano, VaMugabe vachiperekedzwa naVaEdgar Tekere, vachibatsirwa naIshe Rekayi Tangwena, vakaenda kuMozambique kunobatana neuto re ZANU rainzi ZANLA.
Bato reVaNkomo re ZAPU rakanga rine uto raro rainzi ZIPRA. Mauto maviri aya pasi pe Patriotic Front, akazoita hurukuro naVaSmith we Rhodesia dzekuunza kusununguka kweZimbabwe.
Rusununguko Pamwe neGakava reGukurahundi
Asi pakaitwa sarudzo dzekutanga muna 1980, mauto aya akapinda musarudzo akapatsurana.
Kubvira muna Ndira 1983 kwakaita hondo yekurwisa madissidents kuMatebeleland nekuMidlands. Hurumende ye ZANU-PF yakapomera vanhu vemumatunhu aya mhosva yekuchengeta ma dissidents.
Senzira yekumisa kurwisana, VaMugabe naVaNkomo vakanyorerana chibvumirano che Zimbabwe Unity Accord muna 1987, icho chakaona VaNkomo vachiitwa mumwe wevatevedzeri vaVaMugabe, avo vakanga vave mutungamiri wenyika.
Sally Mugabe naGrace Mugabe
VaMugabe vakarasikirwa nemudzimai wavo wekutanga, Aami Sally Hayfron Mugabe, avo vakashaya muna Ndira 1992 mushure mekunetseka kwenguva yakareba nechirwere cheitsvo.
Asi Amai Sally Mugabe vasati vashaya, VaMugabe vakanga vatoroora pachivanhu mukadzi wechipiri, Muzvare Grace Marufu, uyo akanga amboroorwa nemuuto, Stanley Goreraza vane mwana mukomana, Russell Goreraza.
VaMugabe naGrace vakava ne vana vaviri, Bona naRobert junior vakaberekwa Amai Sally Mugabe vasati vashaya.
Kusazvibata kwaVaMugabe kwakakonzera dambudziko muchechi mavo vamwe vachiti havafanirwe kuchatiswa naGrace sezvo vaviri vakaita zvisingatambirwe neRoman Catholic. Asi VaMugabe naGrace vakazochatiswa namushakabvu ArchBishop Patrick Chakaipa.
VaMugabe vanoshorwa nevakawanda kuti vakatadza kupindira zvichitevera kubuda kwemashoko ekuti vakuru vakuru mubato ravo, vakanyepa kukuvara kwavakaita muhondo, izvo zvakapa kuti vapihwe mariyakawandisa.
Munguva iyi, hurumende yakapawo vose vaimbova varwiri vehondo mariinoita zviuru makumi mashanu zvemadhora. Izvi zvakaitika muna Gumiguru 1997 mushure mekunge varwiri avavaratidzira.
Izvi zvakadhingura homwe yehurumende nekuti mari iyi yainge isina kuiswa pabhajeti.
Morgan Richard Tsvangirai – Movement for Democratic Change
Musarudzo dzakaitwa muna 2000, MDC yakapotsa yabvisa Zanu PF pachigaro chekutonga daisarudzo idzi dzakaitwa pasina mhirizhonga zvikuru kumaruwa.
Sarudzo yemutungamiri wenyika yakazoitwa muna 2002, asivakawanda vanobvumirana kuti VaMugabe vakakundwa musarudzo iyi naVaMorgan Tsvangirai veMDC.
Dzimwe sarudzo dzakasiya VaMugabe vazunzika dzakaitwa muna 2008, idzo dzakaona VaMugabe vachikundwa naVaTsvangirai, asipakazoshandiswa mutemo wekuti VaTsvangirai vainge vasina kukunda zvinotambirwa nemutemo.Sarudzo iyi yakadzokororwa, asi VaTsvangirai vakazobuda musarudzo iyi vachiti vatsigiri vavo vaipondwa nehurumende yeZanu PF.
Munguva iyi, VaMugabe ndivo vaive mutungamiri wenyika ane masimba akawandisa, VaTsvangirai vari mutungamiri wehurumende, asimasimba ari mashoma zvichienzaniswa neaVaMugabe.
VaMugabe naVaTsvangirai vakashanda vose kwemakore mashanu, asi hukama hwavo hwaiva husina kuti tsvikiti, VaTsvangirai vachiti VaMugabe vairamba kuzadzisa zvakanga zvawiriranwa pachibvumirano chekuvaka hurumende chakakokerwa nevaimbove mutungamiri weSouth Africa, VaThabo Mbeki.
Kunetsana kwakatangawo muZanu PF, zvikasiya mutevedzeri waVaMugabe muhurumende nemubato, Amai Joice Mujuru, vadzingwa zvose muhurumende nemubato.
Muna Mbudzi 2017, VaMugabe vakadzinga VaMnangagwa semutevedzeri wavo muhurumende, izvo zvakasiya bato iri ratsemuka nepakati, vamwe vachitsigira chikwata cheLacoste, icho chaitsigira VaMnangagwa, vamwe vachitsigira chikwata cheG-40, icho chaive nevanhu vanoti Amai Grace Mugabe, VaJonathan Moyo, VaSavior Kasukuwere nevamwe.
Pakabviswa VaMugabe pachigaro, VaMoyo, VaKasukuwere naVaLeo Mugabe vakabuda munyika vachinopotera kune dzimwe nyika.
Vachitaura pamusoro pekushaya kwaVaMugabe, VaMnangagwa vati VaMugabe vaitwa gamba nebato ravo ravo izvo zvatambirwa nehurumende. VaMnangagwa vati VaMugabe munhu akarwira nyika kuitira kuti ive nerusununguko.
Vatiwo vanhu vakawanda vachavarangarira nebasa ravakaita mukuwanisa vanhu vatema mapurazi ayo vakatorera varungu.
VaMnangagwa havana kutara kuti mutumbi waVaMugabe uchauyiswa riini kumusha kuzovigwa.
Kunyanga hazvo VaMnangagwa varumbidza mabasa akaitwa naVaMugabe, vakawanda vacharangarira VaMugabe kwenguva yakareba nepamusana pezvinhu zvavakaita, zvimwe zvakanaka, zvimwe zvakaipa:
Kune avo vakawana cheuviri kuburikidza nehutongi hwaVaMugabe;
Kuwana hupfumi mumakambani kuburikidza nekushandiswa kwemitemo inotsigira kuendeswa kwehupfumi kuvatema.
Huwandu hwevanhu vari kuzviuraya munyika hunonzi huri kuramba huchikwira izvo zvinonzi zvinokwanisa kudzikira kana vanhu vakakwanisa kuwana rubatsiro pachine nguva.
Doctor Sekai Nhiwatiwa, vanove nyanzvi yezvirwere zvepfungwa vachishanda nechipatara che parirenyatwa vanoti zvakakosha kuti vanhu vanenge vachitaura zvekutora hupenyu hwavo uye vachiratidza kusuruwara vapihwe rubatsiro kuzvipara vasati vatora matanho sezvo zvimwe zvacho zvichikwanisa kurapika kana dambudziko racho rikawongororwa pachiri nenguva.

Doctor Nhiwatiwa vanoti dambudziko guru nderekuti zvipatara zvemunyika hazvina mari yekutenga mishonga inodikanwa kuti inwiwe nevanenge vawongororwa kuti vanoda rubatsiro.
Vanotiwo mishonga iyi iri kushomeka sezvo hurumende isingaise mari yakawanda kubhajeti renyika rinowona nezvezvirwere zvepfungwa.
"Shuviro yedu ndeyekuti mishonga inofanirwa kutorwa neavo vanotarisana nedambudziko rezvirwere zvakadayi sezvekudzamisa pfungwa kana kuti depression, iwanikwe nyore kune avo vanoida," Doctor Nhiwatiwa vaudza Studio7.

Huwandu hwevanhu vabatwa nechirwere cheCOVID-19 munyika hwakwira kusvika pavanhu makumi matatu nevanomwe zvichitevera kuwanikwa kwemumwe munhu mumwe chete aine chirwere ichi pavanhu vakaongororwa neMuvhuro muHarare.
Mashoko akaburitswa neMuvhuro nebazi rezvehutano nekurerwa zvakanaka kwevana anoti vanhu vaponawo kubva kuchirwere ichi vave gumi nevaviri, uye vashaya vachiri vanhu vana.

Doctor Mandigo vanokurudzirawo veruzhinji kuti vakoshese matanho ekudzivirira kutapuriranwa kwehutachiwana anosanganisira kuchengetedza nhanho dzekuti vanhu vasiye pavanenge vakaungana, kugeza maoko nesipo zvakasimba uye kusabatana maoko kana vachikwazisana.

"Pane nhau ye social distancing, yekusiya nhanho inokwana kuita iyo one metre pakusangana kwatinenge tichiita, kwoita nyaya yekugeza maoko nesipo. Iyo yakakosha zvakare nekuti mukumhoresana imomo ndimo mumwe matinowana chirwere," vanodaro Doctor Mandigo.

Matambudziko anonzi anonyanyotarisana nemhuri dzakawanda dziri kunze kwenyika dzinorasikirwa nehama neshamwari anosanganisira kukundikana kuunganidza mari dzakawanda dzinodiwa kuti munhu anovigwa kumusha, izvo zvinozoita kuti apedzesere angovigwa kwaanenge ashaikira.
Mhuri dzakawanda dzinorasikirwa nevadikani vadzo dziri kusara dzichishaya pekutangira, zvikuru kana mufi ari iye anga akabata mhuri.
Matambudziko aya anonzi anozonyanyowedzerwawo nemakakava anenge avepo pakati pevemhuri vari kunze nevemhuri vari kumusha, avo vanonzi vanenge vachida kuti hama yavo inovigwa kumusha pakavigwa vamwe vedzinza.
Izvi zvinonzi zviri kuzoita kuti vari kunze vakawanda vanetsekane kuunganidza mari dzekutakura vafi, pamwechete nevanoperekedza mumwe wavo, vangave madzimai nevana kana shamwari, voguma vave kuita mudemhe-mudemhe.
