Gurukota rezvemari, VaPatrick Chinamasa, vaparura neChina bhajeti regore rinouya remabhiriyoni mazana mashanu ezviuru zvemadhora.
VaChinamasa vanoti zvikamu makumi masere nezviviri kubva muzana zvemari iyi zvichashandiswa pamihoro yevashandi vehurumende.
Vati izvi zvinoreva kuti hurumende inosara isina mari yekawanda yekushandisa kuita mamwe mabasa ayo akakosha.
Vachitura muparamende hurongwa hwavari kuda kuti hushandiswe pamari yehurumende gore rinouya, Chinamasa vati hupfumi hwenyika hauna kumira zvakanaka uye bhajeti iri harina kunyanyosiyana nere gore rino.
Semaonero avo, VaChinamasa vati izvi zvinoreva kuti hupfumi hwenyika hausi kufamba zvakanaka.
Vati mari zhinji ichaunganidzwa nehurumende ichaenda kumihoro yevashandi vayo uye izvi zvinoreva kuti hurumende ichange ichibhadhara vashandi vanenge vasingaite basa sezvo pasina mari yekuitisa mabasa anodiwa nehurumende.
VaChinamasa vati kunze kwemari yavari kutarisira kuwana kubva kumitero, vanotarisira kuwana mari ingangosvika bhiriyoni remadhora sezvikwereti pamwe nerubatsiro runobva kune dzimwe nyika.
Vati sezvo hupfumi hwenyika husiri kufamba zvakanaka, zvakakosha kuti bhajeti ravo rironge hwaro hwekuti makambani avhure uye kuti nyika ikwanise kukwezva makambani ekunze.
Vanoti pari zvino nyika iri kutenga zvinhu zvakawanda kubva kunze kudarika zvairi kutengesa. Vatiwo zvizhinji zviri kutengwa kunze zvinogona kugadzirwa munyika.
Nekuda kwaizvovo, VaChinamasa vati makambani achange achitengesa zvinhu kunze zvakanyanya achabvisa mitero inenge iri pasi pasi.
Vatiwo kunyange hazvo vari kushanda nemabhanga ekunze akaita seInternational Monetary Fund mukugadzirisa nyaya yezvikwereti, hurumende yavewo nehwaro hwekugadzirisa nyaya iyi.
Zimbabwe ine zvikwereti zvekunze zvinosvika mabhiriyoni masere emadhora ekunze.
Vatiwo mutemo wekupa masimba ehupfumi kuvatema vemuno unofanira kujekeswa kuitira kuti vekunze vakwanise kuzotanga mabhizimisi muZimbabwe.
VaChinamasa vanoti vanoda kutanga mabhizimisi munyika vanofanira kutaurirana nebazi rinoona nezvevechidiki nezvekupa masimba ehupfumi kuvatema kuti vajekeserwe kuti mutemo uyu unofamba sei.
Vati izvi zvakakosha sezvo makambani emunyika ari kuvhara.
Vatiwo kubva muna 2011 kusvika gore rino, makambani anodarika zviuru zvina nemazana matanhatu akavhara, ukuwo vashandi vanodarika zviuru makumi mashanu nezvishanu, vakarasikirwa nemabasa.
VaChinamasa vatiwo vashandi vanotambira mari isingadariki mazana matanhatu emadhora pamwedzi havafanirwe kubatirwa mutero kutanga gore rinouya.
VaChinamasa vatiwo hurumende iri kuda kukwidza mitero wefodya yemudzanga senzira yekuunganidza mari.
Vatiwo vari kukumbira paramende kuti idzikewo mutero kuvarimi vefodya vachiti mari ichaunganidzwa kubva pamutero uyu ichashandiswa pamabasa ekudyara miti sezvo varimi vefodya vari kutema miti apo vanenge vave kupisa fodya yavo.
VaChinamasa vati vari kudawo kuderedza mitero yehwahwa hwemumabhodhoro kana izvi zvikatambirwa neparamende.
VaChinamasa vatiwo hurumende ine hurongwa hwekupa hurumende dzematunhu mari asi yakamirira kuti patange pave nemitemo yekushanda kwehurumende dzematunhu idzi.
Vatiwo vari kuda kuisawo parutivi mamiriyoni gumi emadhora semari yekusimudzira matunhu kana kuti Constituency Development Fund. Asi vati mari iyi ichapihwa nhengo dzeparamende kana pachinge pave nemutemo wekushandiswa kwemari iyi.
VaChinamasa vatiwo hurumende ine hurongwa hwekubatsira varimi nembeu nefotireza nezvimwe senzira yekuti nyika iwane goho rakanaka.
Vatiwo hupfumi hwenyika hunotarisirwa kukura nezvikamu zvitatu nechidimbu kubva muzana gore rinouya.
Matare eHouse of Assembly ne Senate ari kutarisirwa kuzeya bhajeti raturwa naVaChinamasa oona kuti oritambira here kana kuti kwete sezvinodiwa nemitemo.

Gurukota rezvekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika, VaSibusiso Moyo, vanonzi vari kukurudzira zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri kunze kwenyika kuti zvinyorerewo mabasa anenge achishambadzwa kumusha kuitira kuti zvigoenda kunosimudzira nyika kuburikidza nehunyanzvi hwazvakawana kunze kwazvigere.
VaMoyo vanonzi vakataura mashoko aya pamusangano wavakaitwa svondo rapera nevamwe vechidiki, we “Road to Davos”, uyo unonzi waive wekutarisa gadziriro yemusangano mukuru weDavos, uyo uchaitwa mwedzi uno kuSwitzerland.
Asi chimwe chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chiri kunze kwenyika, Doctor Victor Chimhutu, vo vanodzidzisa paBergen University ku Norway, vanoti hurumende inofanirwa kutanga yagadzirisa zvinhu zvakawanda zvinosanganisira zvikonzero zvakaita kuti vanhu vabude munyika pakutanga.
Doctor Chimhutu vanoti hurumende inofanirwa kutorawo matanho ekuona kuti kodzero dzevanhu dzachengetedzwa vanhu vasati vasiya mabasa avo kunze vachidzikora kumusha.
Vamwewo ndivo vanoti hurumende haifanirwe kukwezva vanhu kuti vadzokere kumusha iyo ichiziva kuti hakuna mabasa. Vanoti zvikamu zvinosvika makumi mapfumbamwe nezvishanu kubva muzana hazvina mabasa, uye vashandi vehurumende vachiri pamabasa vari pakuramwa mabasa.
Zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zvakawanda zviri kunze kwenyika zvinoti zvinoda kwazvo kudzokera kumusha, asi hurumende inofanirwa kutanga yazvivimbisa kuti kana zvakasiya mabasa azvo zvinonokwanisa kuraramawo zvakanaka kumusha, kwete kungokurudzira vanhu asi vachizosvikopinda mumukanwa mamupere.
Zvinhu zvinonzi zviri kuramba zvichiomera veruzhinji munyika avo vamuka vachinzwa kuti mutengo wechingwa wakwira zvakare kutanga nemusi weChipiri.
Chingwa chinonzi chakwira mutengo kubva pamadhora manomwe kuenda pamadhora mapfumbamwe ane masendi makumi manomwe, mutengo unonzi nedzimwe nyanzvi mune zveupfumi uchatadza kusvikirwa nevakawanda, sezvo mihoro yevashandi iri kuramba iri pasi pasi.
Nyanzvi mune zveupfumi vachitungamira sangano reLabour and Economic Development Research Institute of Zimbabwe, Doctor Godfrey Kanyenze vanoti mutengo wechingwa mutsva uyu wave kureva kuti mhuri inodya rofu rechingwa rimwechete pazuva inenge yave kuda mari inoita madhora mazana maviri nemakumi mapfumbamwe nerimwe pamwedzi.
Kukwira kwemutengo wechingwa uku kunonzi kunogona kunge kwakonzerwa nekushaya huremu kwedhora remunyika kana richienzaniswa nedhora rekuAmerica.
Zvinonzi dhora rekuAmerica rimwechete rave kutengwa nemadhora gumi nemashanu emunyika, izvo zvinonzi zviri kukwidzawo mitengo yezvinhu zvinotengwa kunze sezvo zvichida mari yekuAmerica.
Imwe nyanzvi mune zveupfumi vachishanda vakazvimirira, VaMasimba Kuchera, vanoti chimwe chinogona kunge chakwidza mutengo wechingwa kukwidzwa kwemutengo wegorosi, iro rinonzi riri kutoshaikwa zvakare munyika.
Munyori mukuru wesangano guru rinomirira vashandi reZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions, ZCTU, VaJaphet Moyo, vanoti sevashandi havasi kufara, kwete nemutengo wechingwa chete, asi kuti nemitengo yezvinhu zvakawanda izvo zviri kungokwidzwa mutengo muchivande.
VaMoyo vanoti sevashandi, vakanga vambopawo pfungwa dzavo kuhurumende, asi zvinoratidza kuti hurumende itsva iripo iyi haina han’ya nekuita hurukuro navo.
Zvimwe zvinonzi zvakakwidzwa mitengo muchinyararire zvinosanganisira upfu, mafuta edzimotokari, mafuta ekubikisa nezvimwe.
Kukwira kwemitengo uku kunouya panguva iyo vabereki vari kutatarika kuunganidza mari dzekubhadharira vana vavo zvikoro, izvo zvavhurwawo neChipiri.
Doctor Kanyenze vanotiwo mihoro yevashandi vakawanda munyika yave pasi kwazvo zvekuti kurarama dzangove nyasha dzaMwari. Vanopa semuenzaniso muhoro wevashandi vemumapurazi avo vavanoti vari kutambira madhora zana nemakumi matatu pamwedzi.
Ukuwo, VaMoyo vanotiwo vashandi vakawanda vari kutambudzika zvekuti vanotofamba netsoka kuenda kumabasa pamwe nekudzokera kudzimba dzavo zuva roga roga.
Vanoti chimwe chiri kuwedzera matambudziko aya inyaya yekushaikwa kwemagetsi mumakambani, izvo zvave kuita kuti vashandi vangoshanda maawa mashomashoma, kana kusatoshanda zvachose.
VaMoyo vanoti kunyange zvinhu zvakaoma, vashandi vave kungoramba vakabatirira pamabasa avo vaine tarisiro yekuti hupenyu hungangozonaka mune ramangwana.

Vagari pamwe nevemabhizimusi vekuBirchenough Bridge kudunhu reBuhera South, kuManicaland, vari kunyunyuta nekushaya budiriro kwenzvimbo yavo kunyange hazvo vachiti vari kubhadhara mari dzemitero kukanzuru yavo. Vagari ava vanoti vava nechisungo chekuti vasabvisa mari dzemitero kudzamara vagutsikana nezvavari kuitirwa nekanzuru.
Vagari ava vanoti kubva pakatarwa kuti Birchenough Bridge yave imwe dzenzvimbo dzichange dziri kuzosimudzirwa kuitwa madhorobha maduku makore anoda kupfuura makumi maviri adarika, hapana chinobatika pabudiriro chakaitwa nekanzuru.
Venharaunda iyi vanoti Birchenough Bridge pamwechete neMurambinda Growth Point zvakatangirana pamwechete pakupiwa chidanho chekuti zvive mizinda yebudiriro kumaruwa asi Birchenough Growth Point yakasarira kwazvo.
Amai Mercy Saize Mtsveta mumiriri wavana muzvinabhizinesi paBirchenough Growth Point. Amai Mtsveta vanoti kunyangwe vachiziva kuti nzvimbo yavo yakatangwa kudomwa kuti ichange ichizova ichisimukira, hapana chiri kufamba asi uku ivo vachibvisa mari kukanzuru yavo yeBuhera Rural District Council.
“Kuno kuBirchenough, kuBuhera South takasungwa neCouncil nendaa yeGrowth Point ino zvichinzi tinoda maDevelopment Levy but maDevelopment Levy acho anoshandi chinyi asi imo muno muri mudondo? Vanotora mari dzedu muno vachinodzishandisa kwaMurambinda, izvozvi Murambinda yava taundi, but Murambinda isecond pamaGrowth points emuno muBuhera, Birchenough ndiyo growth point yekutanga. Nyangwe mukanozvitarisa pakubvisa mari dzemarates isusu kuno veBirchenough tiri number one pakubvisa uye nemitero yacho yemashops, but hapana kana chimwechete chatakaitirwa chinotaridza kuti mari dzedu pane chedzinoshanda.”
Muzvinabhizinesi ava vanoti nekuda kwenyunyuto dzevagari, varovera mwoyo kudombo kuti vave kumbomira kubvisa mari dzemitero kukanzuru yavo. Amai ava vanoti paifanirwa kunge paine musika wemabhazi hapana kana nechimbuzi chekuti vanhu vazvibatsire, asi kanzuru iri kungovabvisisa mari kwemakore nemakore.
VaFrancis Magaa ndivo sachigaro vevagari vekuBirchenough Bridge Growth point. VaMagaa vanoti vanogarochema nekanzuru yavo pamusoro pekusarira kuri kuita nharaunda yavo mune zvebudiriro.
“Zviri kutitambudza ndaa yekuti growth point yedu iyi zvatinobhadhara zvinoenda kunotorwa zvoenda kwaMurambinda, Murambinda waakutokura isusu kuno takafa asi apo panga pagadzirwa zvakanaka asi patofazve. Handizivi kuti Murambinda chii achitora zvinhu zvedu kuendesa ikoko; kuti ndiko kune mahofisi edistrict here hameno? Isusu tinoda kuti panapa pakure pasimukirewo growth point yedu isumukire, pano pachigara pakafa! Hatichazivi kuti tochemera kupi,” vadaro VaMagaa.
VaMagaa vanoti musika wange wovakwa nekanzuru yavo wakaregwa makore gumi apfuura pasina chikonzero chakapihwa asi vagari nevemabhizinesi vachibvisa mari mwedzi wega wega. Vanoti mugwagwa unobva paBirchenough wakananga kwaMurambinda haugadziriswe nenguva izvo zvinoita kuti usafambike; uye chikoro chekanzuru cheBirchenough Bridge Primary hachina makamuri ekudzidzira akakwana.
Vemabhizinesi vanotarisirwa kubvisa madhora zana nemakumi maviri pagore, vane misha muGrowth Point vachibvisawo madhora makumi matanhatu.

Zvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri kunze kwenyika zviri kukudzirwa kuti zvitevere kurudziro dzekudzivirira kubatwa nechirwere checoronavirus, icho chave kunzi Corona Virus Disease, 2019, kana kuti COVID-2019, dziri kupiwa nemapoka ehutano munyika dzazvigere, kuitira kuderedza mikana yekuti zvibatwe nechirwere ichi.
Chizvarwa cheZimbabwe uye vari sachigaro vesangano ravanachiremba vanorwira kodzero dzevanhu, reZimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights, Doctor Fortune Nyamande, avo vari kuSweden, vanoti nyika imwe neimwe iri kuburitsa mashoko ekushambadza nzira dzekuti vanhu vange vachizvidzivirira kubva kuchirwere ichi.
Doctor Nyamande vanoti izvi zvakakosha zvikuru kuvana veZimbabwe vari kunze kwenyika kuitita kuti vazive mamiriro akaita chirwere ichi munyika dzavagere.

Hurumende yanga ichiburitsa mashoko ekuti nhaurirano idzi dzanga dzichibudirira zvikuru, uye pane dzimwe nguva yakamboti vana chiremba vainge vadzokera kumabasa mushure mekunge vawirirana nehurumende.
Asi ichi chakanga chisiri chokwadi sezvo kuramwa mabasa kwavana chiremba kuri kuenderera mberi vana chiremba ava vachiti vanoda kuti zvichemo zvavo zvitange zvagadziriswa.
Vana chiremba vari kuda kuti vatambiriswe mari dzavo nemari yekuAmerica; muzvipatara muve nemishonga inokwanira varwere; uye kuti vana chiremba ava vapihwe mukana wekutenga motokari dzekufambisa kuenda kumabasa avo.

Mumashoko akataurwa mudunhu reOhio pamusoro pekusununguka kwezvitendero nguva pfupi yapfuura, gurukota rezvekudyidzana kweAmerica nedzimwe nyika, VaMike Pompeo, vakatsanangudza zvitendero “serusununguko rwekutanga pakatariswa zviri mubumbiro remitemo yenyika,” vakati “Kuremekedzwa kwepamusoro kwekodzero idzi dzisingatorerwe munhu, kunopa gwara rehurumende yedu.”
VaPompeo vakati rusununguko rwezvitendero rwuri kuiswa pnguva yakaoma pasi rose.
VaPompeo vakati vanhu vana pavanhu vashanu pasi rose, havasi kuwana rusununguko rwekufarira zvitendero zvavo.
VaPompeo vakati kuti magariro evanhu asimudzirwe kuitira kuti vanhu vave nekodzero dzekuita zvavanoda, America iri kushandisa zvose zvainokwanisa, kusanganisira kudoma nyika dzose dzinotyora kodzero dzakakosha idzi:
“Takataura pachena hondo iri kuitwa neChina mukurwisa zvitendero. Kuisa muhusungwa vanhu vari ku Uyghurs, kushora Mwari nekubvisa mashoko ari mugwaro re Ten Commandments, achitsiviwa nemashoko emunyori mukuru weChinese Communist Party, VaXi Jinping, uye hatina kuramba takanyarara pazvakaitwa,” vakadaro VaPompeo.
Mumakore maviri apfuura, bazi reAmerica rezvekudyidzana nedzimwe nyika, rakaita misangano miviri yemakurukota iine chinangwa chekusimudzira kusununguka kwezvitendero, vakuru vakuru vezvitendero munyika dzepasi rose, vakaungana vaine chinangwa chekudzivirira kodzero yezvitendero pasi rose.
America yakazvipira kuchengetedza zvitendero zvevanhu vepasi rose. Iyi inhaka inodadisa yakasiyiwa nevakatanga kuwanira nyika ino rusununguko, avo vakavaka America vaine donzvo rekuona kuti vanhu vemuAmerica vachengeterwa kodzero dzavo dzisina ani anodzibvisa, uye izvi zvikaiswa mugwaro rakashandiswa mukuzvipa kuzvitonga kweAmerica, re Declaration of Independence, pamwe nebumbiro remitemo yenyika, vakadaro VaPompeo

Rimwe remasangano anomirira vadzidzisi reProgressive Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, PTUZ, rinoti nhengo dzaro dzichatanga kuramwa mabasa mangwana richiti mari iri kutambiriswa vadzidzisi ishoma zvikuru.
Izvi zvouyawo panguva iyo sangano rinomirira vashandi reZimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions richiti riri kuenderera mberi nekuronga kuratidzira munyika yose.
Mutungamiri wePTUZ, VaTakavafira Zhou, vaudza Studio7 kuti nhengo dzesangano ravo dzichatanga kuregedza kuenda kubasa neChishanu vachiti hurumende yaramba yakaisa zvimiti munzeve pachikumbiro chavo chekuti iwedzere vadzidzisi mari dzemihoro dzine musoro.

Danho ratorwa nePTUZ rekutanga kusaenda kubasa mangwana rinouyawo apo mutungamiri wesangano revadzidzisi vekumaruwa reAmalgamated Rural Teachers Union of Zimbabwe, VaObert Masaraure, vachiti nhengo dzesangano ravo dzichatangawo kurega kuenda kubasa neMuvhuro uye havasi kutambira zvikamu makumi mashanu kubva muzana zvekurerutsa raramo yavo zvavapihwa nehurumende.

Danho riri kutorwa neZCTU iri rinouyawo panguva iyo hutungamiri hweZCTU huchiti huri kutyisidzirwa nepamusana pehurongwa hwekuratidzira uhwu.

Mutungamiri wePTUZ, Doctor Takavafira Zhou, vanoti vakuru vezvikoro, zvikuru mudunhu reMasvingo, vari kumanikidza varairidzi kuzadzisa mafomu aya vachiisa nhamba dzavo dzezvitupa, pamwe nemazita avo vachiudzwa kuti zvichazovabatsira kuti vapiwe makuponi ekutenga zvinhu muzvitoro zvemauto izvi.
Doctor Zhou vanoti kunyange hazvo hurumende yakati ichaisa zvitoro mumakamba emauto, haina kujekesa kuti mari yacho ichabve, panguva iyo yakati ichaumba homwe yekubatsira vashandi nemari.
Hurumende yakati homwe iyi ichaumbwa nemari inoita zvikamu zviviri nezviga zvishanu kubva muzana (2.5 percent) zvichabatirwa vashandi vehurumende vanoda zvavo kupinda muchirongwa ichi.
Asi Doctor Zhou vanoti hapana mushandi achapinda muchirongwa ichi sezvo vashandi vari kutotambura nechakare, izvo zvave kuita kuti hurumende iite chitsotsi ichi.

VaBox vanoti zvirikunyanya kuva shungurudza ndezvekuti vechidiki vakawanda munyika vave kushandisa zvinodhaka zvingave zviri zvekunwa kana kuputa asi varikunyanya kukanganiswa ndeavo vanova tengesera zvinhu izvi.
"Vatengesi vezvinodhaka tinoda kuti varambe vachipihwa mitongo yakawomarara sezvo vari ivo vari kukanganisa vana vedu nevamwe veruzhinji vari kutora zvinhu izvi," VaBox vakaenderera mberi vachidaro.
Parizvino zvinonzi kune zvinodhaka zvakawanda zvirikuwanikwa mumugwagwa yemadhorobha mazhinji zvakaita sembanje, broncho, nyaope nezvimwewo izvo zvave kunwiwawo pamitambo iri kuitwa nevechidiki mudzimba mumadihwino kana kuti mapool party.
Pamitambo iyi panonzi panowanikwa vanhu vachiita zvepabonde zvinokwanisa kuzoita kuti vabate zvirwere.
"Tirikuwona mitambo iyi ichiwanda munyika, izvo zviri kuti shungurudza zvekuti tinoda kuti tibatanidze pfungwa nehurumende kuti tioone kuti tingabatsire seyi kumisa zvirikuitika izvi vechidiki vedu vasati varasika," VaBox vakaudza Studio7.

“Muono wandiri kuzoburitsa manheru ano unoratidza kuti tiri kuvaka sei nyika ine budiriro inokunda dzimwe dzose pasi rose uye isina rusarura, yekuti ani nani zvake anokwanisa kupinda mubudiriro yeAmerica isina wainoenziswa naye, uyewo yekuti vanhu vanokwanisa kuve nechekuita mukusimukira kwayo.”

Izvi zvakapa Somalia kukunda kwayo kwekutanga mumitambo makumi matatu nemumwechete, mushure mekurohwa mumitambo gumi neminomwe nekuita mangange mumitambo gumi nemitatu kubvira muna 1984 apo Somalia yacho yakatanga kutamba nedzimwe nyika.
Izvi hazvisi kufadza vateveri vechikwata ichi kusanganisira VaOliver Musongoro avo vanoti maWarriors anofanira kusandura maitiro avo apo vari kusanganana zvekare neSomalia asi iko zvino kwete kuDjibouti asi muNational Sports Stadium muHarare.
Mutambo uyu waifanira kutambirwa kuBarbourfieds Stadium kuBulawayo neSvondo asi ukazoiswa muNational Sports Stadium neChipiri zvichitevera chikumbiro cheSomalia kuti yaive isingakwanise kusvika muZimbawe paine nguva nemhaka yemafambiro edzindege.
Nhengo yeZimbabwe National Soccer Supporters Association, VaWilliam Mahoko, vanoti vari kutya kuti maWarriors angangorohwa zvekare sezvo vasisina chivimbo nechikwata ichi kubvira pachakadzoka kubva kumafainari e 2019 Africa Cup of Nations.
Asi muteveri wechikwata cheHarare City, VaMarcabee Makamure, vanoti havasi kuona Zimbabwe ichinetseka kurova Somalia vachiti ivo maWarriors achakanda zvibodzwa zvitatu.
Mumwe muteveri wemaWarriors, Muzvare Tendekai Musabayana, vanoti semaonero avo maWarriors ari kurakasha Somalia nekuenderera mberi nemakwikwi aya.
Murairidzi wemaWarriors, Joey Antipas, ashevedza mutambi Ovidy Karuru kuwedzera pavatambi vaakaenda navo kuDjibouti aine tarisiro yekuti Karuru achakwanisa kusandura mafambiro ezvinhu.
Zimbabwe ikakunda mumutambo uyu inobudirira kupinda munguwani yemubatanidzwa wemagungano ezvikwata zvicharwira nzvimbo shanu dzekumirira Africa kuma 2022 World Cup ayo achaitirwa kuQatar.
Zimbabwe haina kukwanisa kutamba mumakundano e 2018 World Cup mushure mekudzingwa mumakwikwi aya neFifa mushure mekunge Zifa yatadza kubhadhara aimbove murairidzi wemaWarriors, Valinhos, uyo akaendesa nyaya yake kusangano rinotungamira nhabvu pasi rese iri.
Zvichadaro, chikwata cheFC Platinum chadzokera pamusoro petafura yeCastle Lager Premier Soccer League mushure mekurova Herentals 2-0 mumutambo waifanira kuve wakatambwa kare asi ukambomiswa nekuti FC Platinum yaitamba mumakwikwi eCaf Champions League.
Izvi zvapinza Platinum mumapoinzi makumi matatu nemapfumbamwe, yakaenzana mapoinzi neZPC Kariba asi ma “Pure Platinum Boys” aenda pamusoro mushure mekunwisa zvibodzwa zvakawandisa.
Asi Black Rhinos, iyo yakarova Triangle 2-1 mumutambo waive wasarirawo zvekare, yaramba iri pachinzvimbo chechisanhu pasi pe FC Platinum, ZPC Kariba, Chicken Inn neCaps United.
Chicken Inn ne Caps United dzine mapoinzi makumi matatu nemasere.
Rhinos yakasiiwa nemapoinzi maviri chete neFC Platinum.

Kukundwa neMali kwasiya Zimbabwe iri pasi pasi mumamiriro egungano rezvikwata zvina zviri mu Group D.
Apo Mali yave nemapoinzi mana, Zambia yave muma kota fainari nemapoinzi matanhatu, zvave kureva kuti Zimbabwe haichakwanisa kuenderera mberi mumakwikwi aya kunyange ikakunda mumutambo wavo wasara neUganda sezvo vanopedza vaine mapoinzi matatu.

VaGonese vanoti havasi kuona chikwata ichi chiine chachichabuda nacho pamutambo weUganda uhu.

Parizvino maWarriors ari pamusoro vakabatana neSwaziland nemapoinzi mana. Guinea neMalawi dzine poindi imwe chete.

Madzimai ari kushanya kuSouth Africa haasi kufara nekutorerwa mapiritsi ekuronga mhuri kwaari kuitwa nevashandi vanoona nezvekupinda nekubuda kwevashanyi muSouth Africa.
Madzimai aya anoti ari kubvumirwa kupinda nepakiti imwechete iyo inenge iyine mapiritsi anokwana mwedzi mumwechete.
Madzimai aya anoti izvi zvinoita kuti azopedzesera oshandisa mapiritsi ekuronga mhuri ekuSouth Africa ayo vakawanda vanoti anovarwarisa zvinosanganisira kubuda ropa kwenguva yakareba.
Amai Getrude Tarumbwa, avo vanodzidzisa kuPretoria, vanoti kurambidzwa mapiritsi akawanda anovakwanira kunozovamanikidza kunwa mapiritsi ekuSouth Africa ayo anovarwarisa, uye kubuda ropa rakawanda.
Amai Tarumbwa vanoti munhu anofanirwa kubvumirwa mapiritsi anoenderana nenguva yaanenge abvumirwa kugara muSouth Africa.
Izvi zvinotsigirwa naAmai Patricia Zuze, avo vanoenda kunotengesa zvinhu zvakaita semidziyo yemumba yakagadzirwa nemiti kuSouth Africa.
Amai Zuze, avo vanogara mwedzi miviri kana mitatu vachitengesa, vanoti kutorerwa mapiritsi kutyorerwa kodzero dzavo uye vanozomanikidzwa kunwa mapiritsi ekuronga mhuri ekuSouth Africa avanoti anovarwarisa.
Nekuda kwekurambidzwa kwemapiritsi akawanda pabhodha, mamwe madzimai ave kuita bhizinisi rekuenda nemapiritsi achinotengesera zvizvarwa zvemunyika zviri kuSouth Africa.
Pakiti rimwe chete, iro rinopihwa pachena munyika rinotengeswa nemari iri pakati pemaRands zana nemakumi mashanu nemazana maviri zvichienderana nekuti munhu ari kuatengesera kunzvimbo ipi muSouth Africa.
Amai Roselyne Chitani mumwe wemadzimai anotengesa mapiritsi ekuronga mhuri kuSouth Africa.
Vatyairi vemabhazi anoenda kuSouth Africa vanoyambirawo vanhu vavanenge vakatakura zvinhu zvisingabvumirwe kupinda munyika iyi kuitira kuti vasazobatwa vachinzi vari kutakura vanhu vanopinda nezvinhu zvisingabvumirwe.
Mutyairi webhazi reFirst Class, VaFrank Muguti, vachiyambira vashanyi vechidzimai kuti vasatakure mapiritsi ekuronga mhuri akawanda.
Zvinhu zvakaita semufushwa, manhanga, nzimbe muriwo hazvibvumirwe kupinda nazvo pabhodha. Munhu anowanikwa nazvo anotorerwa uye haazobvumirwa kupinda munyika iyi musi waanenge abatwa.
Munyori mubazi rezvehutano, Brg Gerald Gwinji, vanoti vachaongorora nyaya iyi vachiti hazvisi pamutemo kuti vanhu varambidzwe kana kuita zvinotadzisa kuti munhu atore mushonga wake sezvinenge zvataura chiremba.
Hatina kunzwa divi reSouth Africa panyaya iyi.

Komiti yedare reSenate inoona nezveHIV/AIDS pamwe nekomiti yeparamende inoona nezvehutano dzaratidza kusafara mushure mekunge kambani yehurumende yemishonga, yeNational Pharmaceutical Company of Zimbabwe, Natpharm,, yapa huchapupu hwekuti mishonga inotorwa nevanorarama nehutachiona hweHIV/AIDS munyika iripo inokwana.
Komiti mbiri idzi dzanga dzadaidza vanhu vakasiyana-siyana vane chekuita nekuwaniswa kwemishonga yema Anti-Retroviral Therapy, kana kuti ART, munyika kuti vanzwe pamusoro petsamba yenyunyuto yakanyorwa nesangano revanorarama neHIV/AIDS vachiti mishonga yavanonwa iri kunetsa munyika.
Vanga vadanwa kuzopa huchapupu vanosanganisira National Aids Council, Natpharm, Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe pamwe ne Zimbabwe Country Coordinating Mechanism for Global Fund.
VaLameck Chipo Mwaramba, avo vanga vakamirira NatPharm, vati havana dambudziko remishonga yeART iyi.

VaMundida vati kana zvinhu zvakanaka munyika vari pamishonga iyi vanofanirwa kupiwa mishonga yemwedzi miviri kana mitatu.

Sangano rezvizvarwa zveZimbabwe zviri muno muAmerica, reZimbabwe Diaspora Network North America, ZDNNA, rinoti nekuda kwedambudziko rechirwere cheCOVID-19, ramanikidzwa kumbosendeka mabiko ekupemberera makore makumi mana Zimbabwe yawana kuzvitonga.
Mabiko aya anga akarongwa kuitwa neMugovera svondo rino mudunhu reMaryland asi atadza kubudirira nekuda kwemitemo yakadzikwa nematunhu ose muAmerica inorambidza vanhu kufambafamba munguva ino yekudziviria kupararira kwe coronavirus.
Sachigaro weZDNNA muD.C./Maryland/Virginia/West Virginia, VaJonah Masiya, vanoti vaona zvakakodzera kuti sesangano vatevedzere mitemo yakadzikwa nevatungamiri vematunhu avanomirira senzira yekuchengetedza mutemo pamwe nekudzivirira vana veZimbabwe kubva kuchirwere charura pasi rose ichi.
VaMasiya vanoti vanotarisira kuita mabiko aya kana zvinhu zvangogadzikana, kunyange hazvo vanga vachishuvira kuungana musi wezororo racho, unove Mugovera uno.
Zimbabwe yakawana rusunguko rwayo musi wa 18 Kubvumbi 1980, asi vamwe vanoti zvinhu hazvina kumbogadzikana munyika, zvikuru munyaya dzezvematongerwo enyika, hupfumi pamwe nehutano, izvo zvakatuma vanhu vakawanda kubuda munyika nezvikonzero zvakasiyanasiyana.
Gurukota rezvemhando dzemoto, Doctor Joram Gumbo, vanoti zvinhu zvave kuzogadzikana munyaya dzemafuta edzimotokari zvichitevera kuibva kwemari inosvika mamiriyoni makumi mashanu emadhora ekuAmerica yakapiwa makambani anopinza mafuta munyika kana kuti ma 'letters of credit'.
Doctor Gumbo vanoti kubva kupera kwesvondo rapera kusvika pari zvino, motokari dzinotakura mafuta dziri mubishi kumhanya nemafuta dzichidira mumagaraji emunyika.
Asi vanoti sezvo munyika manga mave negaha nechekare, zvinoda kanguva kakati kuti kuti vakwanise kudzora zvinhu pazvinofanirwa kunge zviri.
Ukuwo, vamwe vedzimotokari vaudza Studio 7 kuti zvinhu hazvisati zvave kuratidza shanduko, sezvo mitsetse ichiri kuwanikwa munyika yose.
Zvichakadaro, kambani yemagetsi yeZimbabwe Electricity Transmission and Distribution Company yazivisa nezvehurongwa hwekumbodzimwa kwemagetsi pane dzimwe nguva senzira yekuchengetedza magetsi mashoma ari kuwanikwa munyika.
Kumbodzimwa kwemagetsi uku kuchaitwa munyika yose panguva dzatarwa nekambani iyi.
Kambani yemagetsi iyi inoti yamanikidzwa kutora danho iri nekuda kwekuderera zvakanyanya kwemvura kudhamu rinogaiwa magetsi reKariba, pamwe nekudzikira kwemagetsi ari kugaiwa kugwenya remarasha reHwange Power Station.
Kambani iyi yatiwo rimwe dambudziko riri kukonzera kushaikwa kwemagetsi anokwana nderekushomeka kwemagetsi ari kutengwa kubva kunze kwenyika, zvikuru kuMozambique.
Magetsi achadzimwa kubva nenguva dzeshanu mangwanani kusvika nenguva dzegumi mangwanani, kuchizotiwo kubva nenguva dzeshanu manheru kusvika nenguva dzegumi usiku.
Doctor Gumbo vanoti hurumende iri kugadzirisa dambudziko remagetsi iri kuburikidza nekupa marezinesi kwayakaita kumakambani makumi matatu nemana anoshandisa simba rezuva kuti awanise nyika magetsi, uye kugadziriswa kuri kuitwa magwenya ekuHwange.

VaShumba vanotiwo nyika haisati yave nezvikwanisiro zvekuti magetsi ezuva ave iwo nhungamiri munyaya dzemhando dzemoto, izvo zvichaita kuti ruzhinji rwuomerwe zvakanyanya.

Sangano ravana chiremba reZimbabwe Association of Doctors For Human Rights rinoti harisi kufara nehutsi hunokachidza huri kukandirwa vanhu vanenge vachiratidzira nemapurisa sezvo huchikwanisa kuzokonzera zvirwere.
Dr Evans Masitara vanoshanda nesangano ravanachiremba iri vanoti vanenge vakandirwa hutsi hunokachidza kana kudirwa mvura nemapurisa pakuratidzira vanofanirwa kumhanya kumba vobvisa mbatya dzavanenge vakapfeka vodzigeza.
"Tinokurudzira kuti vanhu vanenge vapfapfadzirwa mvura iyi vamhanye kumba kuno bvisa mbatya idzi nekugeza kuitira kuti vasawanikwe vachibatwa nezvimwe zvirwere zvakasiyana siyana. Vanenge vakandwa hutsi hunokatsidza vanofanirwa kuita zvimwechetezvo uye tinokurudzira kuti vatize panzvimbo inenge yakandwa hutsi uhwu," Dr Masitara vaudza Studio 7.
Dr Masitara vanoti pane zvirwere zvakawanda zvinogona kukonzerwa nehutsi hunokatyidza uhu zvimwe zvinozonetsa kurapa.
"Pane zvirwere zvinokonzerwa nehutsi hunokachidza huri kukandirwa vanhu vanenge vachiratidzira munyika pamwe nemvura inovava iri kupfapfaidzirwa vanhu. Hapana anoziva zvinenge zviri mumvura iyi saka isu savanachiremba zviri kutinetsa nekuti zvinhu izvi zvinogona kukonzeresa magomarara akasiya siyana nezvirwere zvemoyo," Dr Masitara vaudza Studio 7.

Izvi zvinotevera kubatwa nechirwere ichi kwevamwe vanhu gumi nevanomwe nezuro. Pavanhu ava pane gumi nevatatu vakabva kuSouth Africa, vatatu vakatapurirwa munyika uye mumwe chete kubva kuBotswana. Vashaya vadarika zviuru zvipfumbamwe nemazana matanhatu nemakumi mapfumbamwe nemumwe kana kuti 9,691. Vapora vanodarika zviuru zana nemakumi masere nevatatu kana kuti 183,000. Mukuru weVoice of America Amai Amanda Bennet vaburitsawo mashoko nhasi vachitaura nezvekukosha kwezuva revatori venhau kana kuti Press Freedom Day vachiti nhepfenyuro yeVOA yakazvipira kuramba ichiburitsa nhau dzechokwadi dzisina divi radzinonorerekera.
Amai Bennet vati, “Muno muAmerica tinoti haasi masanga kuti kusununguka kwevatori venhau ndicho chinhu chakatanga kuitwa kuvandudza bumbiro remutemo nekuti kana nyika isina vatori venhau vanoshanda vakasungunuka vanhu havawane mashoko akakosha muhupenyu hwavo.”
Vanoenderera mberi vachiti, “Ndosaka muchiona hurumende dzehudzvanyiriri dzichikurumidza kumbunyikidza vatori venhau kana munyika mukaita kusagadzikana. Nekuti dzinoziva kuti nhau dzechokwadi dzinopa vanhu simba uye vanhu vakawanawo simba vanokwanisa kuva pachikero chimwe nevatungamiri venyika."
VOA ndiyo nhepfenyuro huru inotepfenyuro mumitauro inosvika makumi mana nemashanu kuvanhu vanemukana mudiki wekunzwa nhau kana kuti vanombunyikidzwa.
Nhepfenyuro yeVOA yakaparurwa muna 1942 uye yakanangana nekuburitsa nhau dzechokwadi dzisina divi radzinorerekera. Hurumende yeAmerica kuburikidza nemitero inobhadharwa nevanhu vayo ndiyo inopa VOA mari kuburikidza nebazi re U.S. Agency for Global Media.
Chinangwa cheVOA ndechekuti iburitse nhau yakazvimirira. Izvi zvinoitwa kuburikidza nemitemo inodzivirira vatori venhau kubva kune vezvematongerwo enyika nevamwe vanoda kuvhiringidza mashandiro avo.
Muna 1976, vaive mutungamiri wenyika yeAmerica VaGerald Ford vakaisa ruoko rwavo pa gwaro regwara kana kuti VOA Charter vachiti nhepfenyuro yeVOA inotarisirwa kuburitsa nhau dzisina divi radzinorerekera nguva dzose uye dziri dzechokwadi dziine hudzamu.

Vanachiremba vanoti chimwezve chirwere chavanoti chakaita se Covid-19 asi chakanangana nevana, chave kunetsa mumatunhu mazhinji muAmerica neku United Kingdom.
Matunhu gumi nemashanu muAmerica anoti arikuongorora chirwere ichi, icho chiri kubata vana asi chisati chazivikanwa zvakakwana, vachiti chirwere ichi chakaita se coronavirus.

Zimbabwe Republic Police neChitatu yakaparura hurongwa hwehwaro hwekuyedza kudzivirira kutapuriranwa kwechirwere cheHIV/AIDS kwamutare. Hwaro uhu hwakananganga nekubatsira mapurisa ari pabasa uye vari pamudyandigere.
Hurongwa uhu hwave nenguva yakareba huchikwenenzverwa paine chinangwa chekuti panosvika gore ra2020 pange pasisina vanoshaya nekuda kwechirongwa ichi. Vanenge vaine chirwere ichi vanenge vachitarisirwa kuwana mapiritsi zviri nyore.
Mukuru wemapurisa mudunhu reManicaland, Assistant Commissioner Dorothy Kupara, avo vakaparura chirongwa ichi, vanoti zvakakosha kuti mapurisa ose aremekedze hwaro hwavapo kuitira kuderedza kuparira kwechirwere ichi. Amai Kupara vanoti hapana chinonyadzisa pakunoongororwa chirwere cheHIV uye pamwechete nekutora mishonga yacho sezvinodiwa.
“Chirwere ichi chakangofananawo neshuga, kana zvakubata gadziriswa, so my officer will ensure kuti zvashandiswa sezvinotarisirwa, uye my officer handifungi kuti pane vachange vachiramba kuzotestwa, uye basa richatowanda kune ma medical officers vachitesitwa.”
Mukuru wemapurisa uyu anotiwo hwaro huripo uhu hunobudisa pachena kuti vanenge vaine chirwere havaizotadziswa kusimudzirwa pabasa. Hwaro uhu hunotiwo vanenge varwara vanokwanisa kumbonozorora zvavo vachipora vachizongodzokera pabasa kana vave kunzwa zviri nani.
Mumashoko avo ekuvhara chiitiko ichi, mumwe mukuru wemapurisa Superintendant Kamanda vanoti hwaro hwavapo uhu huchabatsira mukufambisa basa ravo zvakanaka kunyanya kuvatungamiriri vemakamba kumatunhu ose emunyika.
“Ndinoti kumaDispols (District Police Officers) ose kana masangana nechinhu chiri medical chingakunetsai munongoti ko policy inoti chii? Endai munotitoreraiwo ende rinonzi rakatsetseka rinosuppotwa nePolice Act uye ne the current Labour Laws, tinoiti chii zviya, iSimbi yebasa!”
Mumwe wechipurisa anorarama nehurwere Sergeant Tawanda Mugeri vachipa huchapupu vanoti zvakakosha kuti munhu wega wega, kunyanya kuchipurisa, ararame achiziva paamire mushure mekuvhenekwa ropa.
“Panhau yekuudza vamwe vekubasa, inonzi chii zviya, inonzi disclosure, zviri nani inini ndavakuziva zvandiri zvitori right, ndikaenda kuhospital vave kutondishevedza nefirst name nekuti ndikanzwa parwadza ndotomhanya kuti ndizive kuti chii.”

“Chatiunganidza pano inyaya yeZRP AIDS Policy launch iyi, chirongwa chiripo pakuti National Aids Council yakapuhwa mutoro wekuti irwisane nedenda reHIV. Saka mukuita izvozvo tinoti vanhu vari pamabasa kuti vawanirwe nguva yekuitirwa ma programmes inoita shoma saka kambani ikaita policy yaino implemenda zvinobata vazhinji vanenge vari kumabasa toderedza huwandu hwemari yatinoshandisa pakurapa nekuti vanhu vanenge vadzivirira.”

Zimbabwe Football Association, Zifa, yapa Sunday Chidzambwa basa rekukocha chikwata chema Warriors, achitsiva Norman Mapeza, asi paine mutauro.
Gwaro rabva kumutauriri weZifa, VaXolisani Gwesela, rinoti Chidzambwa apihwa basa iri kwegore rimwe chete paine mukana wekuwedzera makore zvichienderana nekuti chikwata chake chatamba zvakadii.
VaGwesela vanoti Zifa inovimba kuti Chidzambwa achakwanisa kuendesa maWarriors kumakundano e2019 Africa Cup of Nations sezvo asina chinhu chinomukanganisa sekurairidza chimwe chikwata chisiri maWarriors.
Chidzambwa akasiya basa rake semurairidzi weZPC Kariba pakapera mitambo yemwaka uno.

Chidzambwa ndiye murairidzi wekutanga kuendesa maWarriors kuma Africa Cup of Nations finals mushure mekuita izvi muna 2004.
Asati asvika ipapo, Chidzambwa aive aendesa Dynamos mufainari yeCaf Champions League muna 1998 ndokusvitsa chikwata chimwechetecho muma semi fainari emakundano aya muna 2008.
Chidzambwa ndiye zvekare murairidzi ega kuchamhembe kwe Africa akwanisa kutora mukombe weCosafa Cup kanokwana katatu kusanganisira muna 2017.
Asi vakawanda vanofunga kuti yave nguva yemurairidzi mutsva kuti arairidzewo maWarriors.

Zinyange anoti mubasa rake anoshanda asina divi raakarerekera. Asi anoti akaisa mifananidzo yaakatora pakufa kwaVaTsvangirai padandemutande rake senzira yekuvapawo ruremekedzo rwake achiti anoona zvakakodzera nekuti vaive munhu akanaka.
Pamubvunzo wekuti iye ane maonero api pakuenzaniswa kunoitwa VaTsvangirai naVaMugabe, Zinyange anoti sevanhuwo vaviri ava vane zvavakagona nezvavakatadza.
Asi anoti VaTsvangirai vanofanirwa kurangarirwa semunhu akarwira kodzero dzevanhu vese zvisina vakawanda vakaita apo zvaive zvakaomesesa kuita izvi.
Zinyange anoti mutungamiri weMDC, VaNelson Chamisa, vane zvakawanda zvekudzidza kubva kuna VaTsvangirai.
Mubasa rake Zinyange anonyanya kufarira kutora mifananidzo ine chekuita nezvekodzero dzevanhu, zvemamiriro ekunze pamwe nekuchengetedzwa kwezviwanikwa.
Mumwe mufananidzo waakatora wemumwe musoja achirova mumwe wake kumusana achimurambidza kupfura vanhu pakuratidzira kwakaitwa muHarare muna Nyamavhuvhu gore rapera.
Mufananidzo uyu wakaita mukurumbira mukuru, sezvo wakaburitsa pachena zvakaitwa nemauto musi uyu.
Vanhu muBulawayo vatambira kufa kwevaimbove mutungamiri wenyika, VaRobert Mugabe, nemaonero akasiyana-siyana vamwe vachivarumbidza segamba chairo mukurwira rusununguko rwevanhu asi vamwe vachiti nyaya yeGukurahundi nehutongi hwehudzvinyiriri zvinoita kuti nhoroondo yavo isvibe.
Mumwe aive murwiri wehondo yerusununguko muZIPRA, Retired Colonel Baster Magwizi, vati haizi tsika yechivanhu kupembera kana munhu afa. Vati kufa kwaVaMugabe kunonyanya kuvarwadza zvikuru nekuda kwekuti vafa vasina kutongwa panyaya dzavo dzekuurayisa vanhu panguva yeGukurahundi.
VaMagwizi vati kufa kwaVaMugabe hakufanirwi kureva kuti nyaya yeGukurahundi haichataurwi nezvayo kana kugadziriswa.
Mutauriri webato reMDC inotungamirwa naVaNelson Chamisa mudunhu reBulawayo, VaSwithern Chiroodza, vatsinhirawo kuti mumatunhu eMatabeleland kunyanya, nyaya yeGukurahundi ndiyo inorangarirwa nevakawanda panhoroondo yehutongi hwaVaMugabe.
Mufundisi VaAnglistone Sibanda vati vanochema nemhuri yaVaMugabe pamwe nenyika yose nekufa kwaVaMugabe.
Vati VaMugabe vanogona kuve mumwe wevatungamiri vemuAfrica vakakosha zvikuru pakurwira rusununguko rweveruzhinji asi vatiwo nhoroondo yavo inokanganiswa nehutongi hwavo hwehudzvinyiriri kunyanya kumazuva ekupedzisira.
Mumwe wevechidiki muBulawayo, Bakidzanani Dube, ati mukoma wake akabatwa neGukurahundi zvekuti iye akapedza nguva akabatira VaMugabe chigumbu.
Asi ati akazovanzwira tsitsi akavaregerera pavakabviswa pachigaro nechisimba muna 2017.
Bakidzanani ati anoona VaMugabe segamba.
Mumwewo wechidiki, Muzvare Nomsa Mabhena, vativanorangarira VaMugabe nekuti vakaita zvirongwa zvakawanda zvekubatsira kusimudzira vechidiki vakaita saiye.
Mumwezve wechidiki angozvidoma nezita rekuti Elizabeth ati anoona VaMugabe semunhu aiziva zvaaiita uye akarongeka muhutongi hwavo zvisinei nekuti pane zvimwe zvavakanganisawo semunhu wenyama.
Elizabeth ati panguva yehutongi hwaVaMugabe, mitengo yezvinhu yaisagara ichikwira sezviri kuitika mazuvano, izvo zvatsigirwavo naAmai Rose Nyathi.
Amai Nyathi vati VaMugabe igamba chairo uye vanovayemura nekuti vairamba vakamira nezvavanenge vataura zvisinei nekuti vamwe vanhu vanofungei.
VaMugabe vakashaya nemusi weChina kuSingapore nye hurongwa hwekuvigwa kwavo huchiri kugadziriswa.
Chikwata cheZimbabwe chemaGems nhasi chapedza rwendo rwacho rweNetball 2019 Vitality World Cup chiri pachinhanho chechisere. New Zealand yakakunda Australia 52- kwa 51 ichibva yasimudza mukombe uyu.

Izvi zvinotevera kurohwa kwavakaitwa zvekare neNew Zealand, Malawi, Jamaica,nhasi neUganda, izvo zvavadzorera shure mumakwikwi avakashura mare zvaive zvisingatarisirwe.

Apo nyika yakatarisana nedambudziko remvura kunzvimbo dzakawanda nekuda kwekusanaya zvakanaka kwemvura, vagari vekumaruwa eshurugwi vanoti kuuya kwechirwere cheCoronavirus munyika kwowedzera matambudziko avo sezvo votya kubatirira hutachiona uhwu pazvibhorani zvavanoshandisa vakawanda.
Ongororo yakaitwa neStudio 7 inoratidza kuti matsime mazhinji munzvimbo iyi akapwa mvura izvo zvoita kuti mhuri zhinji dziraramire pazvibhorani zvishoma zviri mudunhu iri.
Asi vagari vakawanda venzvimbo iyi vanoti izvi zvave kuisa hutano hwavo panjodzi sezvo hutachiona hwecoronavirus uhwu huchigona kutapukira kuvanhu kuburikidza nekushandisa zvibhorani izvi zvavanenge vachibata vakawanda.
Muzvare Patricia Zhou vanogara muWard 11 kuShurugwai South vaudza Studio 7 kuti kunyangwe hazvo vari kuedza nepavanogona napo kuzvidzivirira kuchirwere cheCOVID-19 kuburikidza nekugara pamba pavo vati vanotyira kuti vanogona kubatirira hutachiona hwechirwere ichi pavanoenda kuchibhorani.
Izvi zvatsigirwawo naMuzvare Tatenda Mavedzenge avo vati vanhu vese vemubhuku ravo vanochera mvura pachibhorani chimwechete sezvo zvimwe zvese zvakapwa. Muzvare Mavedzenge vanoti vangafare vakawana dzidziso yekuti zvii zvavangaite kuzvichengetedza
Mumwe mugari wemudunhu iri VaFarai Gara vatiwo zvingavanakire vakawaniswa mishonga yekuchenesa maoko kuti vanhu vashandise vasati vabata zvibhorani iyo vati haiko kuzvitoro zvemudunhu ravo.
Vaimbove gurukota rezvehutano muhurumende yemubatanidzwa vari nhengo yeMDC Dr Henry Madzorera vati kurudziro yavo ndeyekuti vagari vekumaruwa ava vagare vachisuka mubato wechibhorani nemaoko nesipo kana mishonga inouraya hutachiona kune vanokwanisa kuiona
Asi mumwewo mugari wenzvimbo iyi, Amai Amber Mhuri vati nekuda kwekuoma kwezvinhu munyika, kuwanikwa kwemishonga inouraya hutachiona iyi kunogona kunetsa.
VaMadzorera vapawo yambiro kuvanhu vekumaruwa ava kuti kana pane anenge achifungidzira kuti angangodaro akabatira hutachiona asaenda zvachose kunzvimbo dzinocherwa mvura sezvo zvichigona kuisa hutano hwevazhinji panjodzi.
Vakurudzirawo kuti vari kumaruwa vapanane majana ekunochera mvura kuitira kudzivirira kuungana pazvibhorani izvi.
Mutauriri webazi rezvehutano, VaDonald Mujiri vaudza Studio 7 kuti titaure ne mukuru wezvehutano mudunhu reMidlands, Dr Simon Nyadundu nezvematanho avari kutora mudunhu ravo kuona kuti vanhu vachengetedzeka pazvibhorani.
Asi Dr Nyadundu vanga vasingadairi nharembozha yavo kusvika taenda pamhepo.
Chimwe chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chiri muguta reBeijing muChina, muzvare Samatha Sibanda, vanoti huremende yemunyika iyi yawedzera mazuva ekuti vanhu varambe vakavharirwa mudzimba dzavo kubva pazuva ra Kukadzi 17 kusvika medzi uno uya.
Vanoti hurumende yeChina yakaisa vanhu pamaghedhi enzvimbo dzinogara vanhu kuti vaongorore vanenge vachida kumbobuda vachitwasanudza makumbo munharaunda dzavanogara.
Chirwere ichi chinonzi charura munyika iyi uye sangano re World Health Organisation rakatara kuti chirwere ichi chitorwe sechirwere chavhiringa pasi rose chinofanirwa kutariswa nekukasika.
Muzvare Sibanda vanoti muzinda weZimbabwe wakabatana nehurumende yeChina varikubatsira vamwe vadzidzi vanobva kuZimbabwe nezvinhu zvakadayi sechikafu nezvimwe,
"Parizvino hatisati tanzwa kuti pane chizvarwa cheZimbabwe chakabatwa nechirwere ichi asi tirikuwana zvinyorwa kubva kumuzinda weZimbabwe uri muno muBeijing vachitizivisa nzvimbo dziri kuwanikwa rubatsiro kune avo vanenge vafungidzira kuti vabatira chirwere che Corona Virus," muzvare Sibanda vaudza Marvellous Mhlanga-Nyahuye weStudio7.
Chirwere che ‘coronavirus’, kana kuti covid-19 chirikuramba chichipararira mu America. Nhasi, matunhu makumi maviri emu America, azivisa kuti chirwere ichi chawonekwa mumatunhu avo.
Parizvino vanhu gumi nevaviri vafa nechirwere ichi mu America, vamwe vanopfuura mazana maviri vachinzi vanacho uye vari kurapwa.
Dunhu reMarlyland, iro rakabatana neguta guru reWashington D.C. razivisavo kuti pane vanhu vatatu vawanikwa vaine chirwere ichi munzvimbo yeMontgomery County inoganhurana neWashington D.C.
Pasi pose, chirwere ichi chauraya vanhu vanoita zviuru zvitatu nemazana matatu ane makumi masere nevashanu (3,385).
Nyanzvi munezvehutano, Dr Frenk Guni, vanoti paramende ye America yabvuma kushandiswa kwemari inopfuura mabhirioni masere emadhora mukurwisana nechirwere ichi mu America.
Sangano ravana chiremba re Zimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association rinoti nhengo dzaro hadzisi kuzodzokera kubasa kudzamara hurumende yagadzirisa zvichemo zvavana chiremba.
Sangano iri rinoti rakaramba kutambira mari dzakawedzerwa nehurumende pamusangano wakaitwa neChishanu, richiti zvikamu makumi matanhatu kubva muzana zvakanzi zviri kuwedzerwa nehurumende, zvishoma zvichienzaniswa nekukwira kwaita mitengo yezvinhu.
Vakafanobata chigaro chemutevedzeri wemutungamiri we Zimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association, Dr. Masimba Dean Ndoro, vanoti nhengo dzesangano ravo dzichadzokera kubasa kana sangano re Health Services Board ragadzirisa zvichemo zvavo.
Studio7 yakundikana kubata sachigaro weHealth Services Board, Dr. Paulinas Sikosana, sezvo nharembozha yavo yanga ichinetsa kubata.
Asi hurumende inonzi yazivisa vana chiremba kuti vanofanirwa kuenda kubasa nemusi weMuvhuro mangwanani sezvo yakawedzera mihoro yavo, pamwe nemari dzekubatsirikana.
Asi Dr. Ndoro vanoti vana chiremba vacharamba vachiramwa kubasa kudzamara hurumende yagadzirisa zvichemo zvavo.
Dr. Ndoro vanoti savanna chiremba vanonzwa tsitsi nekutambura kuri kuita varwere muzvipatara, asi havakwanisi kuenda kuzvipatara zvavanoshandira nepamusana pekushaya mari inoita kuti vararamewo zvakanaka.
Dr. Ndoro vanoti vanachiremba havagoni kuenda kubasa vaine nzara, nokudaro hurumende inofanirwa kuona kuti yagadzirisa dambudziko rakatarisana navana chiremba vemuzvipatara zvehurumende.
Vanachiremba vakatanga kuramwa mabasa musi 3 Gunyana vachiti vanoda kuti hurumende igadzirise zvichemo zvavo.
Vakafanobata chigaro chemutungamiri weZimbabwe Hospital Doctors Association, Dr. Peter Magombeyi, vakapambwa nevanhu vasiri kuzivikanwa musi waGunyana 14, vakatochwa zvakaipisisa.
Vakazowanikwa vari kuNyabira manheru emusi waGunyana 19, vakabva vaendeswa kuchipatara kuti vanorapwa.
Kupambwa kwaDr. Magombeyi kwakaita kuti vamwe vashandi mubazi rezvehutano varamwewo mabasa vachiti vachadzokera kubasa chete kana Dr. Magombeyi vawanikwa vari vapenyu.
Kunyange hazvo Dr. Magombeyi vakazowanikwa vari vapenyu, vana chiremba ava havana kudzokera kubasa.
Pari zvino Dr. Magombeyi vari kurapwa vari kuSouth Africa.
Sangano reNational Blood Services kana kuti rinoti mari yavakawana kutanga kwegore rino kubva kuhurumende yakavabatsira kuti vadzikise mutengo weropa pamwe nekuti madzimai akazvitakura vano batsirirwa muzvipatara zvehurumende vawane ropa iri pachena.
Vanoona nezvekufambiswa kwemashoko musangano iri, Muzvare Esther Masunda, vati NBS yakawana mari inoita mamiriyoni mana nemazana manomwe emadhora. Muzvare Masunda vati mari iyi ndiyo yakaita kuti vadzikise mutengo weropa kusvika pamadhora makumi mashanu papaindi imwe yeropa kubva pamadhora makumi masere muna Zvita.
Amai Masunda vati nekuda kwekudzika kwemitengo iyi vanhu vazhinji vave kukwanisawo kutenga ropa iri huye sesangango vari kutsvaga nzira dzekusimudzira huwandu hweropa ravanotengesa.
NBS ine mizinda mishanu inotengeserwa ropa inoti Harare, Bulawayo, Masvingo, Gweru neMutare. Muzvare Masunda vanoti nekuda kwemari yavakawana iyi vave kutsvakawo nzira dzekuti vawedzere mizinda inotengeserwa ropa iyi kuti veruzhinji vawanire ropa iri pedyo navo.
Munyori webazi rezvehutano, Dr Gerald Gwinji, vanotiwo vanhu vazhinji vanga vasiri kukwanisa kutenga ropa izvo zvinova zvakasunda hurumende kuti ibatsire nemari.
VaGwinji vanoti muono webazi rezvehutano ndewekuti mune remangwana ropa riwaniswe vanhu pachena. Vatiwo vari kutarisira kuti panozopera gore rino mutengo uye wadzika kusvika pamadhora gumi chete papaindi imwechete.
Sangano reNBS rinowana ropa pachena kubva kune vanobatsira asi vanoti kucheneswa nekuchengetedzwa kweropa iri kunoda mari zhinji uye havagoni kuderedza mitengo kusvika vawana anenge achivabatsira nemari.
Mamwe madzimai ane chirwere chegomarara anoti vakawana mukana wekurapwa chirwere ichi pachena kuMbuya Nehanda Hospital paParirenyatwa. Izvi zvinotevera michina nemishonga yakauya navana Chiremba vakabva kuChina.
Amai Dorry Chinyadza Gangasha ndemumwe wemadzimai vange vachirapwa pachena. Amai Chinyadza Gangasha, avo vanogara kumusha weDzivarasekwa Extension, vanoti vanofara zvikuru sezvo ivo vagara vasina mari yekurapwa chirwere chegomarara rechibereko.
Amai Mavis Chirara mumwe wevacharapwa vatendawo zvikuru vanobatsira hurumende mukuedza kurwisa chirwere chegomarara icho chinonzi munyika muno chiri kuuraya vanhu vanosvika chiuru chimwe nemazana mashanu pagore rega rega.
Chiremba wepaParirenyatwa, Doctor Ndabaningi Simango, vanoti michina yavakawana kubva kuChina inoshandiswa kunyika dzakabudirira mukudzivirira chirwere chegomarara rechibereko kuti chisadzika midzi. Vanoti hurongwa uhu huchabatsira kubvisa hupenyu hwemadzimai munjodzi.
VaSimango vanotiwo chipatara cheParirenyatwa change chiine michina mishoma huye vari kufadzwawo kuti mamwe madzimai ari kubatsirikana pasina muripo.
Munyori musangano re Zimbabwe Association of Doctors for Human Rights, Dr Evans Masitara, vanoti kunyange hazvo zvichifadzwa zvikuru kuti kune madzimai ari kuwana rubatsiro pachena, chinosuwisa inyaya yekuti izvi ndezve nguvashoma.
VaMasitara vanoti zvakakosha kuti hurumende iwanise vanhukadzi mikana yakawanda yekuongororwa gomarara kuburikidza nekuwedzera zvipatara zvinoongorora nekurapa chirwere ichi.
Mumagwaro akabuditswa neZimbabwe Cancer Registry zvinoratidza kuti mugore ra2014 pavanhu zviuru mazana manomwe vakabatwa nechirwere ichi, vanhu zviuru zvina nemakumi matatu ane vanomwe vaive madzimai.
Gomarara rechibereko ndiro raive pamusoro pemamwe magomara kubata madzimai.
Zvipatara zvehurumende zvinovheneka pamwe nekurapa chirwere chegomarara munyika zviviri chete, Parirenyatwa Hospital iri muHarare, pamwe neMpilo Hospital ku Bulawayo.
Vana chiremba vekuChina ava vari paMbuya Nehanda, Parirenyatwa kwemasvondo maviri vachibatsira madzimai kuongorora nekudzivirira chirwere chegomarara vakabatana nana chiremba vepachipatara ichi.

Mitambo pakati pezvikwata zviviri izvi inoverengwa pane mitambo mikuru munhabvu yemuAfruca zvekuti nhandare yeRufaro Stadium ichange yakazara nevateveri vezvikwata izvi vachitarisira kukunda.
Chikwata cheHighlanders hachisati chakunda Dynamos pamakore masère apfuura zvekuti mumwe muteveri wenhabvu, VaFarai Kambamura, vanoti kukundwa uku kuri kuita kuti mutambo uyu uve nemongo.
Kunyange zvazvo chikwata chavo chisiricho chiri kutamba musi uyu, mutsigiri weCaps United, VaMisheck Chisaga, vanoti vari kuona mutambo uyu uchinakidza zvikuru.
Vaimbove muridzi wepembe, VaSam Hamandawana, vanoti vachitarisa kusatamba zvakanaka kuri kuita zvikwata zviviri izvi, vari kuona mutambo uyu uchiita mangange.

VaHamandawana vanoti panzvimbo yekuripisa zvikwata mushure mekunge vanhu varwa, mitemo inofanira kusandurwa kuchisungwa vanokonzera mhirizhonga.
VaKambamura vanotshinirawo vachiti ivo nhabvu kutandara zvekuti veruzhinji vanofanira kuuya kunhandare nemhuri dzavo vasingatye.
